articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition Technology Based on Multimodal Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This research explores a human multi-modal behavior identification algorithm using deep neural networks. The algorithm leverages various deep neural networks tailored to different types of modal information to process diverse video data. By integrating these neural networks, the algorithm effectively identifies behaviors across multiple modalities. Data collection for this study utilized multiple cameras developed by Microsoft Kinect, capturing skeletal point data in addition to conventional images. This dual data collection method enables the extraction of motion features from the images. The synthesized behavioral characteristics from these data sources facilitate precise behavior identification and categorization. The proposed algorithm's effectiveness was validated using the MSR3D dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that behavior recognition accuracy remains consistent across various scenarios, indicating the robustness of the recognition process. The findings reveal that the algorithm substantially enhances the accuracy of pedestrian behavior recognition in video footage.

articleTitle: Research on Early Warning Model of Cardiovascular Disease Based on Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This project intends to study a cardiovascular disease risk early warning model based on one-dimensional convolutional neural networks. First, the missing values of 13 physiological and symptom indicators such as patient age, blood glucose, cholesterol, and chest pain were filled and Z-score was standardized. The convolutional neural network is converted into a 2D matrix, the convolution function of 1,3, and 5 is used for the first-order convolution operation, and the Max Pooling algorithm is adopted for dimension reduction. This paper sets the learning rate and output rate. It is optimized by the Adam algorithm. The result of classification is output by a soft classifier. This study was conducted based on Statlog in the UCI database and heart disease database respectively. The empirical data indicate that the forecasting precision of this technique has been enhanced by 11.2%, relative to conventional approaches, while there is a significant improvement in the logarithmic curve fitting. The efficacy and applicability of the novel approach are corroborated through the examination employing a one-dimensional convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Research on Disease Prediction Model Construction Based on Computer AI Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The prediction of disease risk factors can screen vulnerable groups for effective prevention and treatment, so as to reduce their morbidity and mortality. Machine learning has a great demand for high-quality labeling information, and labeling noise in medical big data poses a great challenge to efficient disease risk warning methods. Therefore, this project intends to study the robust learning algorithm and apply it to the early warning of infectious disease risk. A dynamic truncated loss model is proposed, which combines the traditional mutual entropy implicit weight feature with the mean variation feature. It is robust to label noise. A lower bound on training loss is constructed, and a method based on sampling rate is proposed to reduce the gradient of suspected samples to reduce the influence of noise on training results. The effectiveness of this method under different types of noise was verified by using a stroke screening data set as an example. This method enables robust learning of data containing label noise.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Natural Language Processing Model Based on Multimodal Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This project intends to study the image representation based on attention mechanism and multimodal data. By adding multiple pattern layers to the attribute model, the semantic and hidden layers of image content are integrated. The word vector is quantified by Word2Vec method, and then evaluated by word embedding convolutional neural network. The published experimental results of the two groups were tested. The experimental results show that this method can convert discrete features into continuous characters, thus reducing the complexity of feature preprocessing. Word2Vec and natural language processing technology are integrated to achieve the goal of direct evaluation of missing image features. The robustness of image feature evaluation model is improved by using the excellent feature analysis characteristics of convolutional neural network. This project intends to improve the existing image feature identification methods and eliminate the subjective influence in the evaluation process. The findings from simulation indicate that the novel approach have developed is viable, effectively augmenting the features within the produced representations.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Aided Diagnosis System of Medical Image Based on Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper combines Struts and Hibernate two architectures together, using DAO (Data Access Object) to store and access data. Then a set of dual-mode humidity medical image library suitable for deep network is established, and a dual-mode medical image assisted diagnosis method based on the image is proposed. Through the test of various feature extraction methods, the optimal operating characteristic under curve product (AUROC) is 0.9985, the recall rate is 0.9814, and the accuracy is 0.9833. This method can be applied to clinical diagnosis, and it is a practical method. Any outpatient doctor can register quickly through the system, or log in to the platform to upload the image to obtain more accurate images. Through the system, each outpatient physician can quickly register or log in to the platform for image uploading, thus obtaining more accurate images. The segmentation of images can guide doctors in clinical departments. Then the image is analyzed to determine the location and nature of the tumor, so as to make targeted treatment.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction Data Processing System for MRI of Brain Diseases Based on Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Most of the existing wavelet image processing techniques are carried out in the form of single-scale reconstruction and multiple iterations. However, processing high-quality fMRI data presents problems such as mixed noise and excessive computation time. This project proposes the use of matrix operations by combining mixed noise elimination methods with wavelet analysis to replace traditional iterative algorithms. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) of the auditory cortex of a single subject is analyzed and compared to the wavelet domain signal processing technology based on repeated times and the world's most influential SPM8. Experiments show that this algorithm is the fastest in computing time, and its detection effect is comparable to the traditional iterative algorithm. However, this has a higher practical value for the processing of FMRI data. In addition, the wavelet analysis method proposed signal processing to speed up the calculation rate.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent System of Medical Image Recognition and Disease Diagnosis Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designed and developed a mobile intelligent diagnosis system for gallstone disease based on deep learning. It can be used offline on Android phones to realize automatic recognition of medical images of gallstone disease. This project intends to take Xilinx company's newly released ZYNQ Super Scale+ MPSoC as the research object, and innovatively introduce it to the hardware and software platform. ARM and FPGA (Field Programmable Logic Gate Array) work together to achieve high-performance computing capabilities that Gpus common to machine learning cannot match. Experiments have proved that the Google network trained by transplantation can classify gallstones with an accuracy of more than 98%, which is comparable to experienced doctors. It can realize a full identification of gallstone disease and can be completed in 2 seconds. Compared with GPU, this algorithm has the advantages of fast processing speed, low power consumption, and good user experience. It is easy to carry and has a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Course Evaluation Comments in Chinese
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A wealth of comments that students provided with online course evaluations can be valuable in helping improve and refine the teaching. However, it is difficult for the computer to utilize these comments and understand student appeal because the comments, expressed in text format, cannot be effectively represented in a way that the computer can recognize and the meaning implied in the comments is always blurred that deepens the difficulty for the computer to understanding them. In this paper, we tackle the representation problem by projecting comments (including words) into a dense vector space, proposing to capture the meaning of the text by exploiting the Gated Recurrent Unit model (GRU) and a real-world dataset of five-year comments (during year 2013–2017) in a university's end-of-course evaluations for the Chinese language. The proposed model is evaluated on the ability to judge emotional tendencies of these comments, discovering useful suggestions and criticisms. Also, we improve the effect of judgement by putting GRU into a highly deep neuron networks and taking into account both the forward and backward association of words in the comment.

articleTitle: Improved Multi-Detection Head Target Detection Algorithm for YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the ever-advancing field of object detection technology, there is a growing demand for algorithms that combine high accuracy and efficiency. In this paper, an updated version of YOLOv8 algorithm is proposed. Its innovation lies in integrating multiple detection heads and adopting Wise-IoU loss function. The idea behind this approach is to improve the algorithm's performance in different sizes and complex environments, which is a major challenge for current object detection. Through the improvement of YOLOv8 architecture, a number of detection heads were added. Inspired by the dynamic head framework, the representation capability of the model was significantly enhanced without affecting the computational load. The addition of multiple detection heads enables the model to perceive objects of different sizes and their spatial distribution, which is very important for detecting objects with complex layout. Furthermore, the application of the Wise-IoU loss function is employed, constituting an innovative bounding box regression loss endowed with dynamic concentrating features. In contrast to conventional loss functions, Wise-IoU incorporates a dynamic non-linear focusing mechanism, altering the sole reliance on IoU for assessing the merit of anchor frames, thereby achieving a more sophisticated gradient allocation. This mechanism helps to reduce the competition between high-quality anchor frames, reduce the influence of poor samples, and improve the detection effect of general anchor frames. These improvements are particularly prominent in difficult scenarios such as semiconductor laser chip damage detection, where accuracy and speed of detection are critical. This paper introduces a major breakthrough in object detection technology. By integrating multiple detection heads and applying Wise-IoU loss function, the improved version of YOLOv8 developed has performed well in accuracy and efficiency, providing hope for a variety of application scenarios from autonomous vehicles to monitoring systems, ensuring the reliability and speed of object detection.

articleTitle: Calibration of Static System of K-Type Wire Thermocouple
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this study, a thermocouple of type K was calibrated and data were collected by a simple static calibration device, and subsequently the data were processed using origin software to derive the thermocouple's temperature difference function. The results of the study show a strong linear correlation between the thermocouple and the fixed point temperature. The static calibration device demonstrated good repeatability performance as verified by several experiments, and the resulting Seebeck coefficient of 40.99 μ<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V$</tex>/°cis highly consistent with that of the standard K-type thermocouple, indicating a high degree of accuracy. These findings provide reliable data to support the use of thermocouples, which is important for temperature measurement in laboratories and industries.

articleTitle: Research on Psychological Stress Recognition Algorithm Based on Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Given the rise of involution in different regions such as China, the evidence shows that the current populations of universities and college learners face higher stress levels. Research reveals that there is a correlation between the heightening cases and numbers of stress and the significant decline in the well-being of Chinese populations. Given this, monitoring the population and students' stress levels remains critical to improving their overall wellness at home or in learning institutions. Therefore, this paper researches psychological stress recognition algorithms based on computer deep learning. The findings of this research study reveal that stress recognition through an algorithm based on computer deep learning exhibited significantly higher levels of efficiency and proficiency in assessing and managing this condition. More importantly, the study's findings established that a system of positive impact was evident in using deep learning algorithms in assessing stress, a subject matter that aligned with the objective of this research study.

articleTitle: Application Research of the Number Prediction of Charging Piles Based on Stacking Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the scale of new energy vehicles, the number of charging piles is directly related to the popularization and use of new energy vehicles. In order to ensure the infrastructure construction, a stacking fusion prediction model based on ARIMA and XGBoost in LightGBM environment is proposed. This method uses the strategy of Stacking integrated learning: firstly, the basic learner of quantity prediction is constructed by ARIMA algorithm according to the time characteristics and historical stock data, and then the output results of the basic learner are fused by XGBoost and LightGBM algorithms, and then the predicted values of new energy vehicles and charging piles are output. MAPE and RMSE evaluation indexes are used to evaluate the model. The results show that the fusion prediction model constructed by this method has higher prediction accuracy than the single algorithm model, and provides theoretical guidance and practical value for more effective planning and deployment of charging infrastructure.

articleTitle: Design of Systematic Financial Risk Warning System Based on Integrated Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As financial markets become ever-more complex and risks steadily rise, the need for effective regulation becomes increasingly pressing. In this article, a financial risk warning system is proposed based on an interestedness classification algorithm. The objective is to speedily pinpoint the systemic financial risks and offer a warning so that investors 'interests can be protected, enterprise decision-making directed or finance supervised. An optimal hysteresis period and kernel function was determined through experimental comparison. The Twin SVM has greater predictive power, stability and generalization ability than other approaches. It can accurately forecast pressure information in the financial market. This proposed artificial intelligence based financial regulatory detection and collaborative decision-making system can precisely evaluate the amount of systemic risk in a given stage, provide early warning for possible dangers ahead, offer an important basis upon which provide a basis for investors, enterprise managers and financial regulators.

articleTitle: Analysis of Human Resource Intelligent Recommendation Method Based on Improved Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Integrating intelligent capabilities and behaviors into a computer system will result in the creation of an intelligent machine. This machine is expected to aid humans in decision-making, information retrieval, controlling complex objects, and ultimately comprehending the semantic content of language. Finding suitable job information can be challenging due to the complexity and diversity of job data. This study presents a targeted human resource intelligent recommendation system using gradient decision trees method to collect and analyze job seeker information. The gradient boosting tree is utilized for feature extraction, while the hybrid convolutional neural network provides improved targeted talent recommendations compared to other models. Results indicate significant improvements in recall rate and F1 score with this approach, demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing human resource recommendation quality.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Control System Driven by Artificial Intelligence and Its Application in Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In view of the difficulty of effective fusion of multi-source sensing data used in industrial production, a method based on multi-source sensing data fusion was proposed. A multi-sensor network model for real-time monitoring in industrial field is established. The key techniques of multi-dimensional data extraction, self-fuzzy inference, multi-dimensional group estimation and multi-dimensional grouping mechanism are studied by four-level data analysis method. This improves the control accuracy and effectiveness of the multidimensional system. This scheme is based on I2C bus structure and uses single chip microcomputer to control multiple sensor nodes, which improves the software reconfiguration ability and robustness, and reduces the maintenance and updating cost of the system. This project intends to establish an adaptive control model by combining FLMS and BP neural network. According to the system error, the weight coefficients of the two kinds of neural networks are determined. In the initial stage, the convergence rate of the neural networks is improved first, and then the nonlinear BP network is used as the main assistant to improve the control effect.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Tuning of PID Parameters Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A strategy for correcting PID parameters in real time for fuzzy control is proposed for the problem of the difficulty of correcting traditional PID control parameters. Exploring the effect of three PID control parameters on the control's quality was the initial step. Next, this paper imports the fuzzy control strategy and creates the fuzzy controller. PID parameters are adjusted in real time by fuzzy inference, fuzzy inference, knowledge base, non-fuzzy. Finally, an experimental comparison between traditional and fuzzy PID was made using Matlab simulation experiments. Test results showed that the fuzzy PID algorithm significantly reduces overclock response time compared to traditional PID algorithms, with a 20% response time reduction and a 10% overclock reduction. Fuzzy PID is a more ideal and efficient control method thanks to its excellent performance and adaptability to the control problems of complex systems.

articleTitle: Research on River Pollutant Detection System Based on Dynamic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The design and development of river pollutant detection systems remains a phenomenon that is based on the use of a dynamic simulation and modeling system intended to create an adaptable and efficient solution used in monitoring and controlling the quality of water. The design of this system primarily relies on the integration of a dynamic simulation model and technique that uses real-time data in modeling a river pollutant system that regulates water dispersion and its behavior within a river ecosystem. The designed river pollutant detection system (RPDS) will rely on sensor networks established and installed along riverbanks to abet the process of collecting varied environmental factors such as the dissolved levels of oxygen pH levels, and pollution concentration among other environmental factors. The system will be fed with data inputs through a dynamic simulation approach established to help in the prediction of pollution, thus enhancing the localization and timely detection of contaminants. The adaptability of RPDS in this case will rely on its ability to enhance the detection of changes in environmental conditions due to several pollutant sources. Through the use of systemic algorithms, RPDS facilitates a swift approach to decision- making that may be used in the mitigation of pollution, thus protecting human and aquatic welfare. This innovation will not only enhance the effective monitoring of riverbeds in China but provide a valuable approach that may be used in enhancing the sustainability and the management of rivers.

articleTitle: A Study of Crew Allocation Based on a Novel Heuristic Algorithm and Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper addresses the optimization of flight crew assignments by introducing a mathematical optimization model aimed at maximizing the allocation of flight crew to flights while minimizing overall occurrences and the use of substitute qualifications. The proposed approach involves route-based clustering, where flight routes are aggregated around hub airports to serve as the fundamental unit for matching flight crew. This transforms the problem of flight crew assignment into a route-based matching scenario. A mathematical programming model is established to minimize the number of unfulfilled crew assignments, flight occurrences, and substitute qualification usage, while also prioritizing these objectives. To enhance computational efficiency, a simulated annealing algorithm and a novel heuristic strategy are employed for solving. Results demonstrate the superiority of the new heuristic strategy over simulated annealing. Specifically, for dataset A, 202 flights were successfully scheduled with no crew occurrences or substitute qualification usage. For dataset B, 13235 flights were successfully arranged with zero crew occurrences or substitute qualification usage, and the program execution time was 0.32s.

articleTitle: Design of Highly Adaptable FAT File System in Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the embedded field, FAT32 file system with high portability and flexibility is needed to apply to a variety of hardware storage devices. Therefore, a file system design that meets the requirements is adopted. The whole design adopts hierarchical design and all parts are written in C language. There is no call related to any specific operating system API, and only a few standard C library functions are called, so that the code of the file system itself is not only separated from the physical hardware platform, but also stands alone in any operating system. This makes it easy and flexible to port to environments with or without operating system support.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Vehicle Speed Simulation Based on FARO Zone 3D Software
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Speeding is an important risk factor for road traffic accidents, so the judgment of vehicle speed is particularly important in the scene investigation of traffic accidents. Computer technology is used to simulate suspected speeding accidents. First, visual video image information reflecting the accident process such as accident site plan and monitoring data is collected, and then vehicle parameters and site trace characteristics are determined. Then FARO Zone 3D software is used to restore the motion state before and after the collision, and finally the collision speed is analyzed and output. This can generate a detailed visual animation presentation and accurate momentum analysis report. Through the simulation of traffic accidents, it is helpful to restore the formation process of the accident, evaluate the vehicle speed, and provide a more accurate basis for the identification of liability accidents.

articleTitle: Research on English Vocabulary Classification Method Based on Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This research seeks to research on English vocabulary classification method based on clustering algorithms. Vocabulary has long been the principal focus of teaching in undergraduate English studies as it is the essential component of the language. However, the outcomes could be better. The genetic algorithm fitness function will be used in the integration of clustering algorithms that may be combined with other frameworks in the classification of English vocabulary. The study found that traditional vocabulary teaching tactics could be more effective, college English students perceive word memory as a difficult learning task, and that etymology is widely misunderstood and seldom mentioned in lectures. Because of this, the study examines novel ideas and techniques for teaching vocabulary in college English from an etymological perspective.

articleTitle: Training and Algorithm Optimization of Stable Pendulum Motion of Cart Based on BP Neural Network and Gradient Descent Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: BP neural network is using gradient descent method to continuously adjust the weights and thresholds between the input layer and the hidden layer, so that the error decreases along the direction of the gradient, and the training stops when the variance between the actual output layer and the desired output layer reaches the minimum, and obtains the threshold of the best training performance. However, the drawbacks of the gradient descent method are reflected in the control training of the steady pendulum motion of the cart based on BP neural network and gradient descent method, that is, although the direction of the gradient descent is the direction of the fastest reduction of the loss function, this is not necessarily the direction of the fastest convergence. And at the same time, since the gradient descent method utilizes the local nature of the objective function, it is very likely to fall into the local minimum in the iteration. To address the above drawbacks, we compare the training results using gradient descent, Newton's method, and conjugate gradient method, and find that Newton's method as well as conjugate gradient method have faster convergence, higher recognition rate, and better training results.

articleTitle: The Application of Self-Attention Mechanism in Real-Time Micro-Expression Detection: A Case Study of rt-MESNet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Micro-expressions, fleeting and subtle facial expressions, possess significant application potential. However, their brief duration, low intensity, and localized motion pose challenges for traditional detection methods. Recent advancements in deep learning have shown promise in micro-expression detection, yet effectively capturing the spatiotemporal features remains a hurdle. The self-attention mechanism, adept at learning feature dependencies, has demonstrated effectiveness in various visual tasks. This paper provides a scholarly review of applying the self-attention mechanism in real-time micro-expression detection, illustrated by the enhanced model, rt-MESNet, and discusses prospective avenues for future research.

articleTitle: Deepfake Video Detection Based on Image Source Anomaly
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to detect the deepfake videos, most of the effective detection approaches need huge number of samples for training, including the real and fake samples. However, the fake samples are not easy to obtain. To find the solution, this paper proposes a deepfake video detection method based on image source anomaly, which only needs the real samples for training. The proposed method uses a neural network to extract features from the face region and its eight neighbor regions, and then uses another neural network to compare the similarity between the features from face region and each one of its neighbor regions. Finally, the average similarity score is utilized as the measure to detect deepfake video. The experimental results show that the proposed method has good detection performance, which achieved the HTER of 2.75% in the DFD dataset and 2.25% in the FF++ dataset, while it needs less samples for training. Moreover, the proposed method also has good cross-datasets performance. It had the HTER of 1.22% when training in FF++ dataset and testing in DFD dataset, which indicates that it can be used in many practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Vision-Guided Nucleic Acid Detection and Sampling Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: At present, the main method of nucleic acid sampling is oral throat swab sampling. In the process of nucleic acid detection throat swab sampling, medical staff need to be in close contact with the patient, and a large number of droplets or aerosols will be produced when the patient coughs and breathes hard, which will greatly increase the risk of cross-infection among medical staff in the sampling process. Robot technology and computer vision technology can restore the artificial nucleic acid detection scene, and on the premise of ensuring the detection accuracy and efficiency, it can effectively reduce the social labor cost of traditional nucleic acid detection methods. In this paper, based on the actual process of nucleic acid detection and sampling, combined with the application prospect and difficulties of robot technology in throat swab sampling, a target detection model of nucleic acid detection and sampling robot based on vision guidance is proposed. In this model, SSD algorithm (Single Shot Multi-Box Detector) based on attention mechanism is used to identify and locate tonsil region, and nucleic acid sampling and detection of human oral and respiratory throat swabs are realized under visual guidance. The experimental results show that the sampling robot designed in this paper has high detection efficiency and accuracy, which can provide technical support for the design of nucleic acid detection sampling robot.

articleTitle: Driving Risk Discrimination Based on Support Vector Machine Optimized with Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Driving risk situation identification is an important foundation for intelligent car risk warning systems, and many techniques, including Support Vector Machine (SVM) have been applied to driving risk situation identification. In order to address the issue of single evaluation criteria and low accuracy of intelligent car following risk identification in complex highway environments, research has been conducted on the driving risk situation identification method under the influence of multiple factors, and a multi-level driving risk situation comprehensive evaluation system based on “drive-vehicle-road-environment” collaboration and SVM has been established. In order to further improve the accuracy of SVM in driving risk identification, the Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (GOA) is introduced to find the optimal model parameters. The model is validated using driving data collected from a driving simulation experiment platform. The results show that the GOA-SVM model achieves an identification accuracy of 95.2% in driving risk situations on highways, and comparison with decision tree C4.5, PSO-SVM, and GA-SVM identification models demonstrates that GOA-SVM outperforms the other three methods in accuracy. This method can effectively identify driving risk situations and provide a basis for research on following safety identification systems in highway environments.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Management Optimization System for Electronic Devices Based on Hybrid Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: China's overall power has recently increased, leading to significant advancements in science, technology, and electronic devices, which have captured people's interest. Hybrid intelligence algorithms provide a versatile field with considerable use in power systems. Additionally, the dynamic management and optimization systems for energy and electronic devices is utilized to apportion the output power of both the fuel cell and the lithium battery. Under the optimized energy management approach, the experimental data indicates that the average fuel consumption rate for electronic devices is significantly decreased. The findings demonstrate that implementing a real-time energy management strategy using hybrid intelligent algorithm may significantly enhance conventional instantaneous energy management systems' in real-time, thus increasing the effectiveness electronic devices while simultaneously decreasing fuel consumption.

articleTitle: The Support Vector Machine Model and Application Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The support vector machine (SVM) model has been widely used in network security fields since it was proposed, but the original SVM model has some defects. In response to the limitations of Support Vector Machine models, numerous experts and scholars have proposed a variety of optimization methods, which have achieved favorable applications. The performance of a conventional SVM largely depends on the selection of its parameters, and manually selecting these parameters is often a time-consuming and inaccurate process. Based on this, this paper optimizes the penalty parameter and the kernel parameter of the SVM using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and applies it to the anomaly type detection in the KDDCUP dataset. Focusing on the intrusion detection problem of the KDDCUP99 dataset, this paper establishes a comparison between the conventional SVM model and the PSO-SVM model, analyzing the classification accuracy and convergence rate of the two models on the test set. The results show that the parameters obtained through Particle Swarm Optimization allow the retrained SVM to maintain sensitivity to abnormal traffic while reducing false positives for normal traffic. This indicates, demonstrating the effectiveness and practicality of the PSO-optimized SVM model. Furthermore, its application in network intrusion detection is expanded.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Location of Submersible Based on NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Under sea exploration is becoming a favorite sport, but there are safety hazards associated with this sport. We want to generate submersibles that will take humans to the deepest parts of the ocean, so safety measures are essential. The aim of this paper is to predict and equip the submersible with relevant safety equipment to improve the safety of the submersible. We collected data on the physicochemical properties of the Ionian sea water, based on the TEOS-10 equation published by SCOR/IAPSO WG127 and IUPAP, and simulated the trajectory of the submersible in different confined environments by cellular automata. The final trajectory of the submersible in the whole vector field is obtained. We use genetic programming path algorithms and Kalman filters to adjust the probability distribution in real time to make it more accurate in predicting the position of the submersible. Finally, we use NSGA-II algorithm for multi-objective optimization to pre-determine the position of multiple submersibles in the ocean. Through multiple iterations, the algorithm can find a set of optimal solutions to obtain the optimal deployment position of multiple submersibles.

articleTitle: A Study of Race Momentum Fluctuations Based on LightGBM and Logistic Regression Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In tennis, “momentum” represents a player's advantage during a match, influencing performance, emotional state, and scoring. Maintaining momentum is crucial as it boosts confidence, mental fortitude, and on-court success, enabling players to secure points efficiently. This study focuses on developing a predictive model to optimize decision-making in tennis matches by analyzing data from Wimbledon 2023 men's matches. Key factors impacting player performance, such as technical ability, fatigue, and real-time mentality, were identified and weighted to create a prediction model using machine learning algorithms like LGBM and logistic regression. The models demonstrated varying accuracies in predicting player scores and match outcomes. Results indicated complexities in score prediction due to the intricate nature of influencing factors. The research underscores the significance of strategic responses based on momentum fluctuations and player characteristics during matches.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Fire Source Parameters on Smoke and Temperature Distribution in Tunnel Fire
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to explore the influence of fire source parameters on the temperature and distribution of fire smoke in tunnel, the fire dynamics software FDS was used to establish the tunnel fire combustion model. The smoke and temperature distribution of tunnel fire under the coupling effect of fire source parameters (fire source scale, fire source area, fire source height) was numerically simulated. The results show that: ①With the increase of fire source scale, the maximum temperature increases and the maximum temperature increases slowly, while the maximum temperature decreases rapidly along the longitudinal arch; ② Under the same fire scale, with the increase of the fire source area, the maximum temperature of the vault and the visibility at the height of the human eye feature within 100m above the fire source decrease; ③ With the increase of the height of the fire source, the maximum temperature of the vault within 50m from the fire source increases obviously, and the time to reach the maximum temperature is about fast.

articleTitle: Design of Video Monitoring System Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the advantages of using edge computing technology to realize video monitoring function and gives the video monitoring system architecture based on edge computing, as well as the composition, function implementation and implementation method of video capture node and edge computing server. This system fully considers the trend of node intelligence, the advantages of edge computing technology, and the needs and problems of video surveillance application development. Taking typical application scenarios of road vehicle video monitoring as examples, specific methods for video processing and recognition in these two situations are provided, which has direct reference value for achieving typical road vehicle behavior, driver, and in vehicle behavior video monitoring.

articleTitle: A Hexapod Robot Design for Cave Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous studying of robot technology, some scholars have set their sights on bionics in designing robots. Spiders, as creatures that crawl quickly on six legs, have advantages in the field of exploration that many other creatures do not have, such as light but reliable legs, superior load carrying capacity at the same weight, and adaptability to all terrain. The purpose of this paper is to design a spider-like hexapod robot, which will be mainly used in the field of cave exploration, focusing on solving important cave exploration work that is difficult to carry out in extreme situations. In this paper, the dilemma of cave exploration will be studied through literature research, and the structure and material strength and stiffness required by the robot will be designed by qualitative analysis. Based on the prospects of hexapod spider-shaped robots in the field of robot exploration and robot transportation, this paper will propose a feasible exploration hexapod robot and improve its design. The resulting robot could help people in cave exploration and reduce the likelihood of danger for researchers.

articleTitle: Application of 5G Communication Technology in Real-Time Monitoring and Remote Control of Gas Reservoir Type Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A set of long-term, continuous and high-precision dynamic monitoring system for oil reservoirs has been developed. Using fiber Bragg grating (FBG) as a permanent sensor in deep Wells, the temperature and pressure of the target layer can be simulated and detected. A data acquisition and analysis device are set up in the well to realize the demodulation and digitization of the analog quantity. The system uses GPRS mobile communication system to transmit data to the database of the monitoring center. And it can be published on the Internet in web format. It also provides users with a browsing interface and an alert SMS message in case of data anomalies. The data of oil-liquid two-phase interface in gas storage were measured by optical fiber oil-oil interface tester. This project intends to use deep learning method to deeply analyze the information of oil and gas two-phase interface in salt rock reservoir, so as to realize the monitoring of oil and gas two-phase interface based on deep learning. This software can be used to monitor the reservoir remotely, in real time and dynamically, so as to make timely and accurate decisions for reservoir managers and technicians.

articleTitle: Balanced Vehicle Control Based on NMPC-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to achieve real-time and precise control of the balance vehicle, this paper proposes a control method based on the NMPC-LSTM model. Nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) solves the problem of traditional linear control methods not being applicable in large angle situations, and achieves precise control of balanced vehicles; Taking the position, angle, speed, and angular velocity of the car as inputs and the force obtained through NMPC controller operation as output, an optimal strategy is trained on the input and output data using a long short-term memory neural network LSTM. This strategy replaces the original controller to achieve real-time control, solving the problem of long NMPC computation time and inability to control in real time. Finally, simulation experiments were conducted in MATLAB to verify the rationality and effectiveness of NMPC-LSTM control.

Author Keywords: Long Short Term Memory Neural Network

articleTitle: Establishment of Multibeam Bathymetric Surveying Models and Optimization of Survey Line Paths in Deep Sea Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper establishes models for multibeam bathymetric surveying, focusing on the development of coverage width models and the optimization of survey line paths. The coverage width model addresses the overlap between adjacent swathes and the coverage width under the range of the acoustic beam. It defines the coverage width as the projection of the seafloor slope on the seabed plane and the coverage rate as the ratio of the overlapping coverage width of adjacent swathes to the former coverage width. Subsequently, a model is established and solved based on the defined relationships. Additionally, a dynamic coordinate system coverage width model for multibeam bathymetric surveying is developed. This involves establishing a spatial Cartesian coordinate system with the central point of the sea area as the origin, determining the angle between the seafloor slope and the x-axis as a replacement quantity for integrating seafloor slope and survey line direction angle, and deriving an expression for water depth to establish the coverage width model. Furthermore, the paper addresses the shortest survey line path problem. The analysis is conducted to determine the shortest path in the projection of the seafloor slope on the sea surface for different slope angles, resulting in the determination that the survey line direction is always parallel to the north-south direction within the rectangular sea area. By combining coverage width and coverage rate models, the shortest path length within this sea area is found to be 125936m.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Based on SAPSO-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wind energy, as a new energy source, has been widely used in recent years. However, wind energy is an unstable energy source, and this instability leads to the inability of wind power to provide a stable energy supply. So predicting the short-term wind power is particularly important for the grid integration of it. In this paper, a self-adaptive particle swarm optimization BPNN method based on tent mapping is proposed to predict short-term wind power. The method uses BPNN for wind power prediction, uses an adaptive particle swarm algorithm to optimize the initial weights and thresholds of the BPNN, and uses tent mapping to initialize the position and velocity of the particle swarm. The nonlinear properties of the tent mapping and the global search capability of the particle swarm algorithm were combined to improve the accuracy and stability of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Assembly Technology for Initiating Explosive Device Based on Intelligent Control and Disposable Electronic Components
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Initiating explosive device are a collective term for disposable electronic components and devices that contain gunpowder or explosives and undergo combustion or explosion upon external stimulation, in order to ignite gunpowder, detonate explosives, or perform mechanical work. To meet the automation requirements for loading and assembly of highly sensitive and low fluidity explosives. Research on intelligent control based micro precision positioning, precision control of charge, and automated assembly technology is conducted in this paper. We realize automatic loading and safe assembly of highly sensitive pyrotechnic agents, and automatic precision loading of low fluidity rate agents. A new intelligent control production system aimed at improving the automatic assembly process and product quality of initiating explosive device, ensuring the consistency of product performance and technical indicators, and shortening the product research and trial production cycle.

articleTitle: Power System Optimal Dispatching in Dynamic Constraints of CHP Unit Based on Adaptive Difference Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The use of fast electric output regulation of combined heat and power (CHP) units can enhance the flexible operation of industrial park electric-heat coupling system (IPEHS) and promote the use of new energy sources. This paper aims to achieve the minimum cost in industrial parks, and establishes an optimal dispatching model considering dynamic constraints. Subsequently, the discrete processing employs the sequential approach and finite element orthogonal collocation method, while the nonlinear planning problem is tackled using the adaptive difference evolutionary algorithm. The case results verify the high efficiency of the finite element orthogonal collocation method, improve the solution efficiency, and provides further evidence of the efficiency of the CHP unit in rapidly regulating electric output for IPEHS.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Multibeam Seafloor Measurement Efficiency Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the in-depth study of beam coverage and measurement efficiency of multibeam survey lines in submarine slopes. Firstly, a geometric relationship model is established, and the accurate calculation of water depth, coverage area and overlap rate is carried out by MATLAB software. Secondly, the model is optimized by combining with the acoustic line tracking algorithm to improve the accuracy of the measurement. Then, this paper successfully designed the shortest survey line scheme to cover the whole rectangular sea area by linear programming model, combined with genetic algorithm, which resulted in a total survey line distance of 44.08 nautical miles, required 22 survey strips, and achieved an average spacing of 315.54 meters between adjacent survey lines. Finally, the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the survey lines, and the optimal distances are 52.9 nautical miles and 61.1 nautical miles, which effectively reduces the proportion of missed survey areas and excessive overlap. Through these methods, this paper provides a set of efficient and accurate solutions for multi-beam measurements.

articleTitle: Design of Operational Effectiveness Evaluation System for Mountain Anti-Terrorism UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The research and development of mountain anti-terrorism UAV combat effectiveness evaluation system is aimed at scientifically evaluating UAV combat effectiveness and giving full play to the maximum potential of UAV. Firstly, the design concept of operational effectiveness evaluation system for mountain anti-terrorism UAV is described. Secondly, using the decision experiment and laboratory evaluation method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, the combat effectiveness evaluation model of mountain anti-terrorism UAV is established. Finally, based on the effectiveness evaluation model, the design scheme of the evaluation system is proposed, which provides ideas for the research and design of the effectiveness evaluation system and lays a foundation for the scientific evaluation of the effectiveness of the mountain anti-terrorism operation.

Author Keywords: Decision experiment and Laboratory evaluation Method

articleTitle: Analysis of Typical Thermal Defects of Power Equipment in Western Inner Mongolia Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The climatic environment in Mengxi area is relatively harsh, and outdoor high-voltage equipment is in the area with high pollution for a long time, which leads to frequent thermal defects of power equipment. According to the statistics of all kinds of faults in recent years, it is found that thermal defect faults can be divided into two types, namely voltage heating type and current heating type, and their mechanism is analyzed. By combining with the infrared accurate temperature measurement technology, the thermal defect map of two primary power equipment in work is analyzed, and the cause of the fault is preliminarily judged, and the judgment conclusion of the infrared map, namely the deterioration of the contact box and the oxidation of the contact surface, is respectively verified by combining with the field test. Through the innovation of inspection method and overhaul method, the defects are eliminated in time, which has certain guiding significance for the substation overhaul work.

articleTitle: Research on Light Pollution Assessment Based on LSTM Algorithm and Pearson Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study combines the light pollution evaluation model, LSTM algorithm, and principal component analysis with the aim of quantifying the impact of light pollution on stellar visibility and proposing effective mitigation strategies. The light pollution evaluation model was constructed by Pearson correlation analysis and entropy weighting method, and the LSTM algorithm was further utilized to predict the future trend of light pollution levels and assess the effectiveness of interventions. The study classified light pollution levels and identified key indicators such as river cover, vegetation cover and artificial light intensity through the principal component analysis. Results show that reducing the duration of nighttime lighting is the most effective light pollution mitigation strategy, while model sensitivity analysis demonstrates its stability and performance. This study is designed to develop a comprehensive assessment model to systematically evaluate light pollution in different environments and propose strategic interventions to mitigate light pollution. By combining the LSTM algorithm, this study provides a novel method to analyze the dynamic changes of light pollution and the development of effective mitigation strategies, which provides strong support for environmental protection and public health management.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of On-line Monitoring of Mechanical Characteristics of High Voltage Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: An essential switching element in the power system is the high voltage circuit breaker. The majority of high-voltage circuit breakers are flawed and have subpar mechanical qualities. Circuit breakers' operational reliability can be assessed, hidden risks can be found early, and equipment faults can be avoided by monitoring the mechanical properties of the breakers online. This paper explains the fundamentals of online monitoring technology for high voltage circuit breakers' mechanical properties, examines four important online monitoring technologies and three currently-emerging online monitoring techniques, and offers resources for additional performance assessment, fault prevention, and high voltage circuit breaker diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Local Position Compensation and Route Optimization Based on Low-Cost GPS and Odometer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: GPS can widely reflect location information for intelligent vehicle navigation and direction control. However, GPS positioning in small areas is slow, and the positioning accuracy is insufficient, resulting in delays in the directional control of intelligent cars. Therefore, this project uses low-cost GPS and odometer-based local route optimization and real-time position compensation to convert GPS global latitude and longitude maps to local-scale flat maps, improving real-time positioning accuracy while the car is driving. Additionally, the Dubins algorithm plans a local path to achieve the optimal driving path.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Improved Otsu Using Histogram Division-Calibration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Two-dimensional Otsu algorithm is applied widely in image processing and computer vision. However, there are many problems in the original two-dimensional Otsu algorithm. This paper proposes a novel two-dimensional Otsu improved method based on two-dimensional histogram division and calibration method on account of the problem of the improper region division in the traditional algorithm. In this paper, the two dimensional histogram is divided by histogram division and calibration method to demarcate the calculation region. On this basis, the two-dimensional Otsu method is modified to make it more reasonable. The experiments show that this improved two-dimensional Otsu method is more robust and less time-consuming than the algorithms before.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning to Intelligent Vehicle Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper combines the advantages of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM), and A* search algorithm in order to achieve efficient path planning for intelligent vehicles or robots in complex environments. In this framework, CNN is responsible for extracting key spatial features from environment-aware data by learning and recognizing potential obstacles, drivable areas, and other spatial information. LSTM, on the other hand, is used to process time-series data and make predictions based on historical path information and real-time dynamic changes in order to take into account possible future changes in the environmental state. Subsequently, the environment model is generated on the basis of CNN and LSTM and fed into the A* search algorithm. The A* algorithm utilizes a heuristic strategy that combines the actual cost with the estimated cost in order to efficiently explore and find the optimal path. It aims to optimize multiple performance metrics such as path length, security and real-time performance, and provide adaptable and efficient path planning solutions for the intelligences while satisfying the constraints.

articleTitle: Online Resources Demand Prediction for Cloud Applications by Combining ARIMA and Bi-GRU
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The advancement of cloud computing technology has precipitated an exponential growth in the scale and intricacy of cloud-based applications. Consequently, the ability to accurately predict computational resources demand has become extremely important. This paper introduces an innovative online estimation approach that employs the ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) model with a Bi-GRU (Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit) neural network to predict the computational resources demand of cloud applications. Initially, the ARIMA model is employed to analyze and predict trends from historical data, thereby capturing long-term patterns and seasonal fluctuations. Subsequently, these predicts are integrated into the Bi-GRU model, which specializes in refining predictions by harnessing temporal relationships and intricate data features. The Bi-GRU network is particularly adept at capturing the nuanced dynamics of the data. The experimental results show that the proposed method yields predicts of exceptional accuracy and reliability. It outperforms conventional prediction techniques by adeptly navigating the complexities and dynamic nature of cloud applications, thereby offering robust assistance for resource management and scheduling within cloud computing environments.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: A Study on Player Performance Prediction Based on LSTM Neural Network and Random Forest Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to help players grasp the direction of the game, this paper establishes a mathematical model to quantify and predict players' momentum. A momentum evaluation model was first built to quantify the factors affecting player performance and thus quantify the player's on-court performance. Then a score prediction model is built based on the above influencing factors using logistic regression to predict changes in court momentum. Finally, the LSTM neural network model was used to predict fluctuations on the court, and the determinants of the player's score were analyzed using the random forest regression model. Thus, a decision-making model is provided for players and coaches to develop game strategies.

articleTitle: Innovation and Improvement of Traditional Chinese Medicine Preparation Technology Combined with Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine preparation techniques have limitations in terms of efficiency and quality, which seriously restrict the development of the Chinese medicine industry. This article adopts an intelligent preparation method for traditional Chinese medicine compound formulations based on artificial neural networks and genetic algorithms, and studies the formulation and preparation process of compound formulations. By constructing a sensor network, key technical parameters during the processing of traditional Chinese medicine are monitored in real-time, achieving real-time monitoring and adjustment of parameters, and connecting various links in the monitoring and adjustment process. Cost analysis can be conducted on the production costs of traditional preparation and artificial intelligence technology preparation, including considerations of raw material costs, labor costs, energy consumption, and other aspects. The preparation method of artificial intelligence technology has also reduced energy consumption, from 800 yuan/batch to 600 yuan/batch. Combining traditional Chinese medicine preparation techniques with artificial intelligence can help reduce the cost of traditional Chinese medicine preparation.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation Algorithm Based on Improved Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the large-scale application of personalized recommendation system, the importance of user privacy protection has become increasingly prominent. Among them, collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm, as one of the widely used recommendation technologies, not only realizes personalized recommendation, but also draws attention to its potential privacy disclosure risk. Therefore, how to adopt effective privacy protection policies within the framework of collaborative filtering to ensure the security of user data has become one of the core areas of current research. Existing research generally adopts the method of adding noise to user-item rating data to protect user privacy, but this usually leads to a significant decline in recommendation accuracy. In order to overcome the problem that excessive noise may affect the quality of recommendation and even lead to the failure of recommendation, an innovative adaptive noise adding method is proposed in this paper. According to the similarity difference between users, this method specifically integrates different degrees of Laplacian noise into the user similarity matrix, aiming to accurately regulate the amount of noise injection, so as to minimize the interference to the original data while maintaining high recommendation accuracy. In order to further improve the efficiency of the algorithm, the algorithm also combines the optimized k-means algorithm to construct a more refined neighbor set by intelligent clustering of users. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has good performance and is compared with other privacy-protecting recommendation algorithms. The experimental results confirm the effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm, indicating that it can maintain high quality personalized recommendation effect while protecting user privacy.

articleTitle: A Highly Available Database System Based on Load Balancing Functionality
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article proposes a highly available database system based on load balancing functionality. The system achieves real-time data synchronization, eliminating the need for separate read/write operations at the application layer. Database read and write requests are distributed among nodes according to predefined rules, ensuring workload distribution. Keepalived and HAProxy are used to achieve high availability and load balancing of services, preventing single point of failure, and accomplishing high availability and load balancing of the database cluster. This architecture can serve as the backend database storage for business systems, providing high availability and ensuring data security.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of Driver Intent and Optimization of Vehicle Longitudinal Adaptive Cruise Control Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study focuses on driver intention prediction models and their application to adaptive cruise control (ACC) system optimization. Through a deep learning approach, we built a highly accurate and stable prediction model and implemented it in the upgrading of the ACC system. The experimental data show that the optimized ACC system has significantly improved in terms of response time, control strategy accuracy, and driving safety and comfort. At the same time, the study also points out the limitations of the model in dealing with unconventional driving behaviors and extreme conditions, and proposes directions for future improvement, including expanding the diversity and scale of driving data, enhancing the model's ability to deal with prediction uncertainty, and fusing multimodal information into the model. The research results not only highlight the advancement in the field of intelligent driving, but also provide strong support for the future development of automated driving technology and vehicle-road cooperative systems.

articleTitle: A Component-Based Event-Driven Architecture Design for Autonomous Flying Software
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Some satellites are designed to be capable of autonomous flight in order to be intelligent. However, many autonomous flight tasks need to be designed because of the complexity of satellite system, which brings heavy software development workload. A component-based event-driven architecture is proposed in this paper, which exacts software components from the complex system for reuse, and designs basic events for the event-driven architecture. This method simplifies the software development logic and significantly improves the development efficiency of autonomous flight software.

articleTitle: TFIDF Text Keyword Mining Method Based on Hadoop Distributed Platform Under Massive Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Keyword extraction is an important part of text mining. Keywords extracted from text can explore the theme of the whole text and be further applied to text recommendation or text search. Under the wave of big data, the traditional text keyword extraction algorithm frequently appears in the low efficiency of the training and testing process on a single machine. Based on this, this paper proposes the TFIDF text classification algorithm based on the distributed platform of Hadoop, and gives the specific process of the algorithm implementation. The parallel TFIDF text classification algorithm considering the position of words in the document is implemented by MapReduce programming model, and compared with the traditional serial algorithm, the experiment is carried out in single machine and cluster mode. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the performance of the algorithm significantly, and can realize efficient information extraction at high speed in the face of massive data.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence Performance of GaN-base Lighting Emitting Diodes Under Small AC Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this article, we try to discuss the optical research of light-emitting diodes from different samples. The Electroluminescence (EL) spectra of GaN light-emitting diodes (LED) driven by different forward currents and forward voltages are measured. Their dependence on current or voltage is discussed. The results show that the peak wavelength is blue shifted when the current is less than 28mA, and red shifted again when the current is greater than 28mA or 50mA. In addition, it is found that the EL spectrum is more significant at low frequency. When the frequency lower, the EL intensity changes greatly, and the EL intensity basically inclines to be saturated.

articleTitle: Design of English Teaching Quality Evaluation System Based on Deep Learning and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This research delves into the prospects of using deep learning and data mining to design an English teaching and quality system model. The paper first conducts a research and analysis on the relevant literature that examine the evaluation systems designed through data mining and deep learning algorithms. As presented in the findings, deep learning and data mining technologies that include the use of neural networks play a critical role in the development of English language assessment and evaluation systems. The findings equally establish that data mining algorithms and techniques significantly decrease the delay times caused in the traditional English teaching and evaluation system designed through the use of deep learning and data mining techniques.

articleTitle: Crowd Simulation for Semantically Augmented Virtual Cities Based on Improved HiDAC Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Visual media such as animation, movies, and games often require large urban crowds to support them, and large-scale crowd production relies on a great deal of work by professional artists and animators to achieve natural and realistic results. Crowd simulation, as a method widely used in visual effects, computer games and urban planning, has gradually become a research hotspot. The commonly used models in the existing methods can simulate most of the normal populations, but lack expressiveness for special groups. In this paper, we propose a method to simulate the behavior of crowd for semantically augmented virtual cities based on improved HiDAC model, which integrates psychological factors, rule set, and semantic cities, and constructs a multi-agent system. The behavior of the crowd is composed of low- level and high-level behavior modules, and the crowd generation method is based on groups, which achieves the real simulation effect of “micro-differentiation and macro- uniformity”, and is suitable for animation, movies, games and other visual media.

articleTitle: Air Conditioning System Design of Power Data Center Based on Automatic Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of emerging technologies such as cloud computing, big data and artificial intelligence, the importance of data centers has become increasingly prominent. As one of the core facilities of modern information technology, data center's operational stability and energy efficiency are crucial to the development of the whole information industry. The air conditioning system of the data center is an important link to ensure the normal operation of the equipment, and its performance and efficiency are also crucial. In this paper, based on automatic control technology, the air conditioning system of data center room is designed to improve its stability and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Colon Polyp Image Segmentation Method Based on CNN and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To solve the problem of low accuracy in traditional pure convolutional neural network models for intestinal polyp segmentation images, we propose a dual-branch multi-scale intestinal polyp segmentation model based on CNN and BiFormer. The model primarily consists of two main components: an encoder and a decoder. During the encoding stage, BiFormer employs a dual-layer routing attention mechanism as the multi-scale feature extractor in the encoder branch to capture global information. Simultaneously, a convolutional block is designed as the convolutional encoder branch to extract local semantic information and detailed features of polyp images. Additionally, an Enhanced Spatial Attention (ESA) mechanism is introduced in the convolutional block of each encoder layer to effectively utilize local spatial information and enhance the spatial localization accuracy of polyps, thereby further improving the model's segmentation performance. In the decoding stage, a Skip Fusion Block (SFB) is employed to comprehensively integrate semantic features from both the encoder and decoder, addressing issues such as discontinuous boundary segmentation and further enhancing segmentation accuracy. Our method was evaluated on the open-source datasets Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicDB, and CVC-ColonDB, achieving Dice coefficients of 0.888, 0.927, and 0.911, respectively, and mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) scores of 0.876, 0.902, and 0.860, respectively. Compared to traditional convolutional neural network-based models for intestinal polyp segmentation, our method demonstrates improvements of 2.1% in Dice coefficient and 2.5% in mIoU, highlighting its higher practical value.

articleTitle: Enhanced Sensitivity in Capacitive Pressure Sensors via Sawtooth Electrode Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The susceptibility and flexibility of pressure sensors offer promising prospects and market demand in the fields of bionic skin, human-machine interface, and intelligent wearable electronic devices. However, achieving optimal sensor sensitivity through a simple and cost-effective process remains a significant challenge. The present work proposes a sawtooth electrode based on the comb electrode, with an increased circumference while keeping the area at a fixed value, aiming to fully exploit the edge effect of electric field. Finite element analysis (FEA) was conducted to verify this the feasibility of model via COMSOL software. The results demonstrate excellent agreement between the analytical and finite element models, indicating that the proposed model exhibits superior sensitivity compared to the traditional comb capacitor within a pressure range of 0~20 kPa.

articleTitle: Combining Computer Simulation Visualization and Multi-Objective Optimization Algorithm for Urban Light Pollution Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study aims to solve the problem of urban light pollution by establishing a series of models to achieve the best balance between economy and efficiency. Firstly, we decompose the complex problem into a simple one and establish a light pollution risk level evaluation model, a light pollution threshold differential equation model, a lighting system optimisation strategy model and a Poisson process simulation model validation. In Model I, we use hierarchical analysis and Topsis algorithm, combined with multiple attribute data, to determine the evaluation indexes of light pollution risk level, and effectively classify the light pollution risk level of the area. In Model II, we used the differential equation model to find out the light intensity threshold, and the results showed the diversity of different regions. In Model III, a multi-objective optimisation algorithm is used to achieve the balance of time, light intensity threshold and light range through the lighting system optimisation strategy. Model IV combines the data from Beijing and Shanghai and calculates the number of times residents exceed the permitted use of light using a Poisson distribution.

articleTitle: Meteorological Message Information Satellite Communication Transmission Model
