publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study addresses the urgent transmission of meteorological messages in the event of terrestrial communication system failures, by constructing a bipartite graph prediction model to explore effective methods for sharing meteorological message information between main stations within a limited time frame. Initially, the study established a model that effectively predicts and optimizes the scheme for transmitting meteorological messages between N main stations within K minutes. Furthermore, in response to the high reliability requirement of ensuring successful transmission from at least one substation, this research proposed and validated transmission models under three scenarios of main station reception: no messages received, one message received, and two messages received. Additionally, the study enhanced the model's predictive accuracy and practicality across various scenarios through the use of weighted average and binomial distribution methods. Overall, this research provides a theoretical foundation and practical solutions for the rapid and accurate transmission of meteorological messages under extreme conditions, significantly enhancing the efficiency and reliability of meteorological information transmission.

articleTitle: Optimization of Control Rod Waveform Performance in RGL System Using Automatic Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Reactor Coolant Pump Loop (RGL) is rerecognition of RCCA to ensure the positioning accuracy of RCCA when it is plugged and lifted at low speed. According to the need of safety, reliability and operation procedure of unit equipment, a redundant reconstruction scheme of PPE cabinet I/O frame is proposed to solve the danger of unit grid withdrawal caused by the loss of control rod position information caused by the failure of a single plug-in. An experimental device for RGL rod-position channel rerecognition was developed. A PC system consists of a server, memory reflection card, and storage array. Among them, the memory reflection card ensures the high-speed data transmission between the upper and lower interfaces, and can also use the hard disk for high-speed streaming disk for data storage, and the PC for data playback, complex signal judgment and printing. The bottom system is composed of controller, signal acquisition card and memory reflection card, etc. The signal of Hall sensor and microphone signal are adjusted. Then it is transmitted to multiple data acquisition cards, and the signal is initially judged by the low controller, and then the signal is uploaded to the server through the memory reflection card in real time. The technology of the power cabinet is updated, the system can be rapidly upgraded and matched with it. So, this test system has a wide range of application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Target Recognition Algorithm Based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this study, in the HSV color space converted from RGB color space, the target recognition was carried out through different color channels and OpenCV. First, in this study, a color recognition and quantity estimation model was established to find the possible location of the target within the HSV range of different colors, reduce the noise and irregular edges in the image, and draw a histogram to visualize the distribution of the number of targets in all images. Secondly, this study establishes a target position recognition model, which recognizes different colors by setting a specific HSV threshold, then uses cv2.findContours to find the target contours, calculates its centroid as the target center point for each contour, and then converts the coordinates of the center point to draw a two-dimensional scatter plot and a scatter plot heat map, which visually shows the geometric position and distribution density of the target in the image. Finally, a target state evaluation model was established, which extracted the red and cyan parts of the target respectively, and calculated the ratio of the red pixels in each target to the sum of the whole target pixels, so as to plot histograms, box plots and cumulative distribution plots to show the distribution of states. In summary, this study uses OpenCV to achieve target color recognition and quantity, position and state estimation in the HSV color space, which provides a reference for other studies.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of New Energy Technology Innovation Panoramic Monitoring System Based on Big Data Mining and Knowledge Graph Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new energy operation monitoring and analysis system design based on knowledge graph technology. With rich semantic representation ability and flexible structure, this paper constructs an effective carrier for computer cognition of information and knowledge in the physical world. The process of establishing knowledge graph of new energy operation monitoring and analysis is put forward. By studying the data sources of power grid operation and maintenance, the relationship between operation and maintenance is obtained. Then, an operating system health evaluation method based on fuzzy evaluation is proposed. The weights of each index are determined by the method of expert evaluation. The member function of abnormal alarm is constructed by combining the distribution function of triangle and step type. The experiment proves that the algorithm can reflect the actual operation condition well. The paper plays a certain role in promoting the reliability of the operation and maintenance of the new energy operation monitoring system.

articleTitle: Enhancing Employee Digital Literacy Prediction: A Novel AG-LOA-Based Kernelized Extreme Learning Machine Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The Kernelized Extreme Learning Machine (KELM) has recently gained prominence in predictive modeling for its efficacy in addressing complex nonlinear challenges. However, concerns regarding convergence accuracy and speed have spurred exploration into optimization techniques. This paper introduces AG-LOA-based KELM, enhancing KELM using the Lion Optimization Algorithm's (LOA) Global and Local Search capabilities. The optimization process refines KELM's parameters, focusing on convergence precision and speed. Recognizing limitations in traditional LOA algorithms, especially in late-stage searches prone to local optima traps, an AG-LOA is introduced. This novel algorithm, combining adjustment factors and Gaussian mutation perturbation, forms a robust LOA framework, mitigating the risk of local optima. AG-LOA's effectiveness is evaluated through multiple test functions, assessing convergence speed and accuracy. AG-LOA is applied to the KELM model, resulting in AG-LOA-based KELM. Validation involves predicting the digital transformation of employees within enterprises. Comparative analyses highlight AG-LOA-based KELM's superior performance in accuracy, fitness values, and convergence speed. This study establishes the efficacy of AG-LOA-based KELM in predictive modeling, particularly for enterprise employee digital literacy prediction.

articleTitle: A Corpus System Study of Oral English Ability Improvement Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents a project that utilizes the WECCL (Chinese learners' oral English level) and COCA (native English speakers' corpus) datasets. Focusing on Chinese English learners and native English speakers, the project combines the SELL corpus with virtual reality to create an English learning and communication network platform. The system's hardware employs an ARM chip as the control center and TDA7498ETR in the sensor component for sound amplification. NRF24L01 is used for reading and writing language data to enrich the database. The platform establishes different output channels for sound signal output through retrieval and editing layers. Experimental results indicate that the developed deep neural network exhibits higher speech diversity, more accurate simulated speech, and stronger generalization in practice. The system facilitates AI character communication in various scenarios, enhancing learners' oral ability and language knowledge.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Study and Practical Deployment of Index Modulation Techniques in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper provides an insightful overview of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) technology, starting with a detailed explanation of its underlying principles. OFDM is a sophisticated technique that splits a single data stream across multiple separate subcarriers, thereby increasing spectral efficiency and combating multi-path distortion. It significantly improves the data transmission rate and quality, making it an essential element in various modern communication systems. A comparative analysis is then presented to distinguish OFDM from other multiplexing technologies. The unique advantages of OFDM, including its robustness to channel fading, high spectral efficiency, and the ability to handle high data rates, make it a compelling choice for digital data transmission. The paper further delves into the applications of OFDM in real-world scenarios, demonstrating its prevalence in diverse fields such as digital television and radio broadcasting, wireless networking, and 4G/5G mobile communications. These examples illustrate the integral role of OFDM in powering our connected world. However, despite its advantages, OFDM is not without limitations. The paper elucidates issues such as high Peak-to-Average Power Ratio (PAPR), sensitivity to frequency offset and phase noise, and the necessity for complex receiver algorithms. Overcoming these challenges is a key area of ongoing research.

articleTitle: Optimization Study on Line Layout of Multibeam Detection System Based on Greedy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: High-precision seabed topography and geomorphology information is essential to ensure the safety of marine vessel navigation and ship combat training and is also important basic information for many application fields such as ocean engineering, resource development and marine scientific research. Multibeam bathymetric system is one of the main means of seabed topography detection. In this paper, we first establish a two-dimensional multibeam bathymetric coverage width and the mathematical model of the overlap rate between adjacent strips, and then introduce the direction of the survey line and the seabed slope of the angle of the projection of the normal direction in the horizontal plane, turn to the three-dimensional multibeam bathymetric coverage width mathematical model. And finally, based on the idea of genetic algorithms and greedy algorithms in a north-south length, east-west length, the center of the sea area depth, the slope of the rectangle to be known, respectively, it is to find the optimum width of the sea area to be measured. Finally, based on the idea of genetic algorithm and greedy algorithm, in a rectangular sea area with known north-south length, east-west length, depth at the center of the sea area, and slope, the optimal direction of the line, the optimal initial distance and the optimal interval between the lines are found out. Thus, the optimization of line placement for multibeam bathymetric system is realized.

articleTitle: Research on Primary Equipment Information Retrieval of Intelligent Substation Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, a new object-oriented semantic inference algorithm, logical knowledge graph, is studied. Firstly, the information set is obtained by sorting out the primary equipment data of intelligent substation. Then, the framework of unstructured device information extraction is defined to realize the efficient extraction of device information corpus. This project intends to build a logical map based on labels and associations in the sample map. The Dijkstra diagram method is used to find the correlation between samples, thus speeding up Cypher's search in the sample map. In order to break the limitation of traditional 2D semantic table, the equipment information is displayed visually and the limitation of 2D semantic table is broken. The information management system of intelligent substation primary equipment based on “knowledge map” is proposed. The feasibility of this algorithm is proved by 6 real image retrieval examples.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Power Generation Prediction Based on LSTM-Informer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation has become a highly anticipated choice due to its pollution-free and renewable characteristics, the penetration rate of distributed photovoltaic power stations in the power system has been increasing year by year. In order to improve the power prediction accuracy of distributed photovoltaic power stations, a photovoltaic power generation prediction based on LSTM-Informer is proposed. On the basis of LSTM and Transformer neural networks, informer proposes a probabilistic sparse self-attention mechanism to filter the main query matrices and calculate attention values; it proposes a self-attention distillation operation that uses one-dimensional convolution and pooling layers to reduce the dimensionality of feature vectors and reduce model parameters; it proposes a generative style decoder that can obtain prediction results in just one step. Using the measured data of photovoltaic power plants in Texas in 2022 as an example, the photovoltaic power generation at different time periods within a day was predicted and compared with the measured values. The verification results indicate that the prediction error of this method is less than 5% at all-time scales, making it suitable for power prediction in distributed photovoltaic power plants. This method can effectively improve the accuracy of distributed photovoltaic prediction and has certain practical value.

articleTitle: EcoPredict: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Forecasting Energy Consumption in Cloud Classrooms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As traditional teaching methods are gradually shifting towards online education models, cloud classrooms, as a new type of teaching infrastructure, have brought energy consumption management to the forefront as a key issue. To address this challenge, this study introduces a deep learning framework named EcoPredict. EcoPredict integrates Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTMs) and Dense Networks to effectively process and predict dynamic changes in energy consumption, thereby supporting more rational energy allocation strategies. This research utilized actual energy usage data from a university cloud classroom in China for its experiments. The results demonstrate that the EcoPredict framework significantly outperforms traditional prediction models, achieving an accuracy rate of 93.74%, which is considerably higher than the performance of using either Dense Network or LSTM models alone. Through in-depth analysis of the EcoPredict framework, this study not only improves the accuracy of predicting energy consumption in cloud classrooms but also provides effective technical support for the rational allocation of online education resources.

articleTitle: English Oral Automatic Translation System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The design and establishment of an English translation system, addresses the element of low accuracy in the learning of English, poor instances of English translation system, as well as the element of long translation. Given this, the design of an English phrase corpus was created, its part of speech was determined, and the phrase antecedent and postscript probability were calculated using the quaternion cluster in the updated GLR technique. The features method of extraction and technique is based on the recognition outcomes to extract the optimum contextual characteristics. Based on this, the attention mechanism and the conventional neural network that are combined to create a deep-learning neural machine translation model as seen in this study.

articleTitle: Development of a Data Platform for the Intelligent Connected Vehicle Industry Chain Based on Elasticsearch Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the era of big data with a significant increase in information volume, especially in the intelligent connected vehicle sector, it is crucial for users to better utilize the services of the China Automotive Industry Information Network. Firstly, this paper collects four types of intelligent connected data: vehicle-related data, user-related data, vehicle network and cloud service-related data, and data related to the upstream and downstream of the intelligent connected vehicle industry. Then, based on Elasticsearch search engine technology, an intelligent connected vehicle industry chain data platform is constructed, which includes a seven-layer business architecture comprising user entry, front-end UI, business layer, data layer, underlying database, and operating environment. Finally, the system is tested using three approaches: MySQL, Elasticsearch, and a hybrid of Elasticsearch and MySQL. The results show that the hybrid technology of Elasticsearch and MySQL performs better in terms of system retrieval time and efficiency. Therefore, the intelligent connected vehicle industry chain data platform proposed in this paper, based on Elasticsearch technology, can bring a new experience to users and serve them better.

articleTitle: Design of Student Management System Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Datamining is a new tactic that has become popular recently. Important information hidden inside the data may be unearthed through data mining, providing strong support for various business choices with a sound scientific basis. This study mines student evaluation data, creates student assessment information modules using data mining technologies, and looks at the relationships between different factors that impact students' development. Additionally, it uses data mining technologies in colleges' student information management systems. Predictive knowledge assessment and tailored instructional decision-making set the groundwork. The proposed improved genetic fuzzy clustering technique follows a comprehensive review of fuzzy and genetic algorithms. The strategy's effectiveness described in this research is compared with the modified evolutionary fuzzy systems and clustering algorithm. After that, this system will be a platform and data source to modify the performance analysis clustering strategy. In the end, the experimental results show that combining the student scores with a clustering method based on a fuzzy genetic algorithm improves the analysis of the student scores and helps instructors and departments that are important to make decisions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Oral English Intelligent Platform System Based on 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of 5G network technology, real-time and efficient distance education and intelligent systems become feasible. This paper introduces anoral English Intelligent system based on 5G platform. The system takes advantage of the high speed and low latency of 5G network to achieve real-time capture, transmission, processing and intelligent of users' spoken English. The system uses advanced speech recognition technology combined with deep learning algorithm to accurately evaluate the user's pronunciation, intonation, fluency and other dimensions. In addition, the system integrates natural language processing technology to understand and respond to user queries and provide personalized learning recommendations. The experimental results show that the system can not only ensure the accuracy, but also significantly improve the user's learning experience and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study of Predictive Analysis of Community Transportation Demand Based on Gravity Model and Computer Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As urbanization progresses around the world, it is crucial to mitigate and avoid traffic congestion problems in city roads. This necessitates making reasonable predictions on traffic distribution and conducting in-depth research with appropriate forecasting methods to assess the rationality of the road network. In this study, a community was taken as an example to calculate the total travel demand and the total traffic production and attraction of the community based on road network and land use planning. Secondly, utilizing the gravity model and TransCAD software, the future origin-destination matrix of the community was computed. Finally, by combining the road network, origin-destination matrix, and impedance matrix, traffic flow was allocated to the road network to obtain the final road network traffic volume prediction results. Through analysis, it was found that the “high density, narrow road width” road network structure of the community could effectively accommodate traffic flow, but congestion might occur in certain local areas in the future, requiring improvements. The above findings validated the effectiveness and feasibility of using the gravity model for predicting traffic distribution, providing strong support for subsequent urban road planning and design.

articleTitle: Design of Chinese Programming Language Compiler Based on LLVM Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As a basic technology in the Internet industry and even the entire computer industry, programming has been increasingly valued by the entire society. Through traditional lexical analysis, top-down grammatical analysis, and docking with LLVM backend, this paper designs and completes a Chinese programming language compiler that uses expressions that can be evaluated as the basic structure and supports functions, recursion, and loops. It is a completely open-source, Chinese, Turing-complete, process-oriented Chinese programming language with simple syntax. It supports functions including: basic expressions, binary expressions, process functions, control flow, loop flow, function recursion, JIT support. The realization of this compiler can improve the popularization of Chinese programming language and play a certain role in promoting the development of Chinese compiler.

articleTitle: Rotary Kiln Wall Thickness Detection Method Based on Infrared Temperature Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Rotary kiln, as an industrial equipment, is widely used in building materials, metallurgy, and chemical industries [1]. In the process of chemical ironmaking, the rotary kiln serves as a core device, and the formation of rings inside the kiln can seriously affect the ventilation and heat transfer effects within the kiln. The ring material will blocks the flow of materials inside the kiln, resulting in poor gas flow and subsequently affecting the uniform distribution of heat. This leads to uneven ironmaking reactions and reduces ironmaking efficiency, and may also cause some raw materials to fail to react fully, affecting the purity and quality of iron. With the continuous accumulation of ring material, the kiln wall may be subjected to uneven thermal stress, leading to deformation or cracks in the kiln body. This not only affects the service life of the kiln body, but also may lead to safety accidents such as kiln body rupture, causing significant economic losses to the enterprise. The cleanup of ring material is also a complex and time-consuming task. Since the ring material often exhibits high adhesion and hardness, special tools and chemical reagents may be required during the cleanup process, which not only increases production costs but also poses a potential threat to the safety of operators. Therefore, during the production process of the rotary kiln, by comprehensively scanning the surface temperature of the kiln body, the collected temperature data is mapped into a one-dimensional temperature curve model and unfolds a two-dimensional thermal image model of the surface of the rotary kiln [2]. Real-time analysis of all temperature data is conducted, and positions of anomalies such as highest and lowest temperatures are calibrated and displayed for monitoring personnel to observe, enabling them to promptly understand changes in the kiln wall and determine whether there are abnormalities in the rotary kiln. Then the above functions have been uploaded to the built rotary kiln temperature analysis system to complete the real-time analysis and monitoring of the rotary kiln.

articleTitle: Aspect-Level Sentiment Analysis Based on Aspect Tree and Syntactic Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Graph convolutional network models based on syntactic dependency trees have been shown to be useful for aspect-level sentiment analysis, but the existing models do not make full use of syntactic structure information. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an aspect-level sentiment analysis method based on aspect tree and syntactic matrix. The original syntactic dependency tree is reshaped into an aspect-oriented tree, retaining the dependency types that are directly related to the aspect. At the same time, in order to effectively integrate syntactic and semantic information, syntactic matrices are used to equip attention matrices. Experimental results show that the new graph convolutional network model based on aspect tree and syntactic matrix shows better analysis performance on multiple public datasets than the baseline method, and the accuracy of sentiment classification on Laptop, Restaurant and Twitter is as high as 79.91%, 85.97% and 76.07%, respectively, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Monitoring and Early Warning System of Lightning Protection and Grounding System Based on Computer Intelligent Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the study of real-time monitoring and early warning of the application of intelligent sensors to lightning protection and grounding system, an innovative work is to combine Graph Neural Networks (GNN) and Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm based on Decomposition, MOEA/D) combined to build a new hybrid model called Graph Evolutionary Networks (GEN) to address the challenges in monitoring complex systems. With its efficient processing of network structure data, GNN can effectively capture and analyze the topological relationship and real-time data flow between lightning protection and grounding system sensors, and achieve accurate evaluation and prediction of system status. In view of the fact that the real-time monitoring and early warning of lightning protection and grounding system involves a number of mutually dependent objectives, such as response speed, monitoring accuracy and energy consumption, the researchers introduced the MOEA/D algorithm to seek the balance point between the objectives by decomposing the multi-objective problem into multiple single-objective sub-problems for synchronous optimization, so as to ensure the overall optimal operation of the system. The GEN model successfully combines the advantages of GNN and MOEA/D: GNN is used to analyze the complexity of sensor networks and obtain critical information in real time; MOEA/D is used to coordinate and optimize multiple performance indicators in system monitoring and early warning. Therefore, the GEN model can not only realize real-time and accurate system condition monitoring, but also make reasonable tradeoff decisions between different performance objectives, which significantly improves the safety and reliability of lightning protection and grounding systems. This interdisciplinary innovation opens up a new technical path for the application of intelligent sensors in the field of complex system monitoring and early warning, which has wide practical value and far-reaching industry development significance.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Spatio-temporal Dynamic Modeling Prediction and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid model integrating deep learning methods and classical epidemiological theories. Under this framework, the simplifying assumptions of the original SEIR model are extended, and by integrating heterogeneous data from multiple sources, the prediction accuracy of future disease development trends can be enhanced by training and optimizing the CNN-LSTM model, especially when confronted with complex scenarios such as nonlinear growth, sudden changes, and evaluation of the effects of interventions. Through comparative analysis, the CNN-LSTM-optimized SEIR model shows stronger adaptability and accuracy in reflecting the real epidemic dynamics and guiding the prevention and control strategies compared with the traditional numerical simulation methods.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Sea Search and Rescue Based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo Method and Hungarian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Exploring the depths of the oceans with deep-sea submersibles is becoming increasingly popular. However, the unpredictability of the deep ocean poses a significant safety risk to the submarine mission and its crew. Therefore, we developed an efficient and scalable submersible localization model. By integrating the effects of various factors on missing submarine localization, the optimal path of the model is solved using genetic algorithm. The forces acting on the missing submersible in both directions are analyzed, and a position and time-dependent differential equation is established, which enables us to predict the descent of the submersible. Secondly this paper integrates the multi-attribute decision analysis method of EWM-TOPSIS to create a model for evaluating search and rescue equipment. The MCMC method is then used to simulate potential distribution points and the optimal search trajectory is designed using GA and its probability distribution is determined using KDE.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Rural Smart Tourism System Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The travel industry is undergoing profound changes with the continuous development of information technology. One such emerging technology is cloud computing, which boasts powerful computing power, massive storage space, and efficient resource sharing capabilities. Based on Ali-Cloud's ESC and Baidu-Cloud's EasyDL cloud computing platform, this paper focuses on the definition, functions and architecture of cloud computing to explore how to design a rural smart tourism system to assist the development of rural tourism.

articleTitle: Research on EMI Electromagnetic Interference Test System of SIP Reactor Protection Cabinet in Nuclear Power Plant Based on Statistics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The SIP cabinet undertakes the calculation and threshold triggering functions of the reactor protection channel and is one of the most important cabinets in nuclear power plants. This pioneering study developed a set of EMI testing methods and standards for SIP protection cabinets, which improved the anti-interference ability of SIP protection cabinets in nuclear power plants, ensured the reliability of SIP protection systems, and effectively avoided the occurrence of reactor trip events. The statistical analysis method is also a breakthrough and innovation in the prevention of electromagnetic interference in important systems such as SIP, providing solutions for other on-site interference problems in nuclear power, and has important reference significance.

articleTitle: Research on Badminton Movement Machine Learning Model Based on Computer Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper aims to explore an innovative method combining computer vision and machine learning to accurately identify and analyze various movements in badminton. This paper first summarizes the application prospect of computer vision in the field of sports analysis, and introduces its specific application scenarios in badminton in detail. By constructing a complete technical framework of image preprocessing module, feature extraction algorithm and deep learning model, the complex movements of badminton players such as swing, stroke and moving pace are captured and analyzed. In the research process, we used multi-view image fusion and key point detection technology to accurately extract action features in badminton, combined with convolutional neural network (CNN), recurrent neural network (RNN), long term memory network (LSTM) and other deep learning models to efficiently learn and model these features. Thus, the automatic classification and recognition of badminton movement can be realized. The experimental results show that the model has significant accuracy in badminton action recognition, good generalization ability and practicability, and can be effectively applied in the badminton teaching and training process of athlete performance evaluation, competition data analysis and other aspects. This research result not only expands the practical application of computer vision technology in the field of badminton, but also provides new ideas and tools for further promoting the development of sports intelligence and digitalization.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of University Library Borrowing Behavior Based on Big Data and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The use of machine learning algorithms for deep data mining is aimed at improving the efficiency of public library borrowing recommendations. According to the characteristics of users' reading behavior, a heuristic recommendation method which is more suitable for users' use behavior is designed. Using RBF network to predict the information of book borrowing, a method to predict the number of book borrowing is constructed. The method is compared with other prediction methods. The results show that this method can estimate the quantity of collection accurately and reduce the error rate of estimation. The prediction method proposed in this paper is effective. The recommendation algorithm model shows high application efficiency in simulation test and trial run test, and the subjective evaluation results are given by members who have used the new system. Through the analysis of literature retrieval results, empirical evidence confirms the viability of the search process paradigm predicated on heuristic discovery presented within this document.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Binary Classification Dataset Based on Integrated Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The binary classification problem is a fundamental and core problem type in machine learning, and many machine learning algorithms, such as logistic regression and tree models, are widely used to solve binary classification problems. Based on the Kaggle open-source binary classification dataset, a prediction model for binary classification data was established using five different machine learning algorithms, namely KNN, decision tree, gradient boosting tree, random forest, and extreme random decision tree integration. The parameters of the models were determined through relevant theoretical analysis cross-validation methods, and the test accuracy of the five integrated learning models were compared, and the experimental results showed that the test accuracy of the gradient boosting tree and random forest models reached 93.23%, which indicated that these two models had the best prediction performance in solving the binary classification problem. In addition, these two models also have high stability. Therefore, this study provides strong support to the field of machine learning and demonstrates the potential of gradient boosted trees and random forests in solving real-world problems.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Building Network Structure Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm and Data Set
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence algorithm is the key technology to realize the automated and intelligent design of building structures. However, due to the lack of constraints of physical rules, artificial intelligence algorithms sometimes generate unreasonable results in practical engineering applications. Therefore, by integrating the structural design rules into the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) in the form of neural network modules, a new intelligent design method of building structure layout (FrameGAN-sym) is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Beam Deep-Sea Survey Based on Geometric Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the acoustic multi-beam deep-sea measurement technology is systematically studied in order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of deep-sea measurement. Firstly, based on mathematical geometry, this paper establishes a geometric model of the coverage width by Angle transformation and sine theorem, and calculates the coverage at different distances. Then, in view of the special case of rectangular sea area, this paper uses the projection principle and trigonometric function to reduce the dimension of the three-dimensional problem to two, and solves the coverage width at any position and Angle. On this basis, this paper further considers more variables, and uses three-dimensional modeling and two-dimensional coordinate system to obtain the depth distribution of the entire sea area. Combined with the previous model, the route layout of the survey ship is optimized, and the total length is minimized. Finally, through the processing and analysis of the actual data, this paper identifies the submarine topography features, and on the premise of ensuring the overlap rate is less than 20%, the optimal layout of the survey line is obtained by using genetic algorithm. The total length is 265 nautical miles, the missing survey area only accounts for 2.39%, and the overlap area does not exceed the permissible range. This series of research not only improves the efficiency and accuracy of deep-sea measurement, but also provides a valuable reference for the research in related fields.

articleTitle: Comparison of Decoupling Algorithms for Six-Dimensional Force Sensors Based on Least Squares Method and RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of dimensional coupling, this paper proposes a decoupling method based on the least squares method and RBF neural network. By comparing the force matrix before and after decoupling, the error matrix E is calculated to obtain the measurement errors of Type I and Type II after decoupling. The RBF neural network decoupling algorithm reduces the Type I error to within 1% and the Type II error to within 2%. Whether it is Type I or Type II error, the decoupling effect of the RBF neural network algorithm is better. By using the decoupling algorithm, the dimensional coupling can be minimized, thereby improving the linearity and measurement accuracy of the six-dimensional force sensor.

articleTitle: An Integrated Energy Optimized Scheduling Strategy for VPPs Considering Electric Heating Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated energy optimized scheduling strategy for virtual power plants (VPPs) considering electric heating conversion to meet the needs of VPPs participating in multiple types of electricity market transactions. This strategy takes the regulation characteristics of energy conversion equipment, distributed energy, energy storage equipment, and user demand response as relevant constraints, with the objective function of minimizing the comprehensive operating cost of VPP, including operation, energy purchase, and demand response. The simulation results show that the proposed model can improve economic efficiency through load response strategy, and is a feasible method to solve the internal integrated energy optimization scheduling problem of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: A Study of Tennis Momentum Factors Based on Neural Network Learning and XGBoost Regression Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The aim of this thesis is to explore the role of momentum in tennis and to investigate this through a range of data analysis and modelling methods. Firstly, data pre-processing was carried out, key features were identified using wavelet analysis and t-SNE non-linear dimensionality reduction, and the optimal stage of a player's appearance was identified through XGBoost regression analysis. Secondly, a momentum model was constructed based on the Adam optimisation algorithm, which confirmed the relationship between momentum and match wins and losses. Subsequently, a prediction model was constructed using the Random Forest algorithm to confirm the key factors affecting momentum. On this basis, suggestions for players were made through Bayesian optimisation. Finally, the accuracy and generality of the model were verified through parameter testing and actual game data. The paper concludes with recommendations for coaches, such as strengthening psychological interventions and studying psychological tactics to motivate players to achieve better performance. These research results provide an important reference for the understanding and application of momentum in tennis.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Evaluation of Transmission Tower Damage Under Disaster Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The high structure characteristics of transmission towers make it easy to be damaged by wind load, and wind disaster is the most widespread natural disaster. Compared with other natural disasters, wind disaster occurs more frequently and has a wider impact, which is one of the main reasons for the damage to transmission tower structures. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the damage to transmission lines under strong winds, simulate the deformation of components under strong winds, and comprehensively evaluate the emergency capacity of transmission towers. In this paper, the finite element numerical model of a typical transmission tower structure is constructed, static and modal analysis is carried out, basic disaster resistance such as the strength of the transmission tower is evaluated, the wind load time history of the transmission tower under the action of strong winds is simulated, and the transient dynamic analysis is carried out to simulate the deformation of components of the structural system under the action of strong winds is realized. The results have a certain guiding significance for the comprehensive evaluation of the emergency capacity of transmission towers.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Analysis of Relay Protection System Based on Computer Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: An improper functioning of systems related to stability of power systems and protective relays through circuit breakers remains a factor that jeopardizes the stability as well as the safety of power systems. This research provides a fault-tracking approach based on computer intelligence algorithms widely used in the establishment and the design of proper fault anomaly detection and analysis models and systems. First, the study is performed to determine the reasons for a fault diagnosis analysis of a fault diagnosis and relay system of protection, efforts driven toward establishing its erroneous functioning. Due to this, challenges that include a conciliation of the logic circuits as well as the complex issues and cases of communication and troubleshooting significantly hamper the functioning of the system. To this effect, the model is equally meted with several communication flaws from message delivery pathways. The fault diagnosis analysis system for a relay anomaly and protection system in a circuit breaker is in this case classified, thus creating a critical feature. The fault diagnosis system is then developed using upgraded and trained computer intelligence algorithms. To this effect, the testing findings show that the approach can correctly monitor failures in the design of the relay anomaly protection system in a circuit breaker, aiding the proper functioning and optimized functioning and maintenance of the systems.

articleTitle: Smart Pricing and Replenishment Decision Making Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the management of fresh food supermarkets, making optimal replenishment decisions for various vegetable categories daily is crucial when the specific items and purchase prices are not accurately known. To assist supermarkets in selecting reasonable sales combinations, this article formulates intelligent pricing and replenishment strategies for vegetable products using clustering, random forest models, and machine learning algorithms for modeling and problem solving. The main research contents are as follows: For problem one, data preprocessing is conducted initially. The distribution patterns of various categories are explored using wavelet analysis, leading to the conclusion that most data exhibit strong periodicity. The interrelationships among various categories are determined using the elbow method to identify the optimal parameters, followed using K-means clustering and hierarchical clustering to roughly divide the sales volumes of various categories into two classes. Upon finding that the data does not conform to a normal distribution, the Spearman correlation coefficient analysis method is applied for data processing. To analyze the distribution patterns of individual vegetable products, seasonal decomposition is used to analyze their periodic characteristics and certain anomalies. The interrelationships among individual vegetable products are evaluated using the Granger causality test, which shows that there is a significant impact on the sales volumes of most vegetable products, with only a small portion of the data showing weaker sales volume impacts between products. For problem two, a weighted sales unit price model is established based on the differences in sales unit prices of individual vegetable products. This is followed by constructing an XGBoost machine learning algorithm embedded with grid search to predict the sales volumes of various vegetable categories in the coming week, and the model is evaluated for six categories, showing excellent fitting effects. Subsequently, an LSTM-RF time series forecasting model is built to predict the cost of various vegetable categories in the coming week. An objective function is established with the aim of maximizing supermarket profits, and the optimal daily replenishment total and pricing strategy are obtained using a genetic algorithm. For problem three, the category problem is further subdivided into the problem of daily replenishment quantity and pricing strategy for individual products based on the work conducted for problem two. Some modifications are made to the weighted sales unit price model, and a grid search-based XGBoost random forest prediction model and LSTM time series prediction model are continued to be established to predict the daily sales volume and cost price of vegetable products. The optimal daily replenishment quantity and pricing strategy for individual products are then determined using the particle swarm optimization algorithm. For problem four, the multiple factors considered in the models established for problems two and three are addressed. Relevant data collection is proposed to address the shortcomings of the models, such as seasonal factors, promotional factors, and market factors. Furthermore, model optimization and parameter adjustments are made to enhance the flexibility of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation System of Library Collection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This project intends to use deep neural network technology to study the personalized information recommendation method for digital library. First of all, the hardware of the platform is optimized, and then the personalized recommendation model of users is established by deep learning method. The platform is integrated with the management of database and teaching resources, and the software development of the platform is finally realized. The characteristics of deep neural network are studied and applied to the user portrait of digital library. According to the characteristics, behaviors and preferences of users, a user feature model is established. The feature of user image is mined, and the time-sequence association between user and data is fused by deep learning to achieve effective matching between user and data. The resources of digital library are recommended and tested individually. Experimental results the maximum AVC reaches 96.41%. The research results of this paper will provide useful reference for users in the network environment of personalized service.

articleTitle: Research on Detecting Unknown Cyber Security Threats in Power Systems Using Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: During the digital construction of electric power enterprises, new technologies of IT specialty have been widely applied, including the Internet, the Internet of Things (IoT), and big data analysis, providing convenience. However, with the deepening application of digital technology, significant cyber security issues have also emerged for power grid enterprises. These include spread of malicious files, which pose severe cyber security risks due to their unpredictability. Traditional techniques struggle to monitor these threats effectively. This article combines the models and institutions of data mining technology to study the use of digital mining to detect unknown security threats in the cyberspace in the development of digital technology in power enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of the Distribution of Heliostats in a Solar Field Based on the Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The heliostat mirror field is the core component of the tower-type photovoltaic power plant. In this paper, we use three-dimensional geometric analysis, vector modeling, establishment of coordinate system and coordinate system transformation to analyze the research objectives. By utilizing the solar right-angle coordinate system and the projection between different coordinate systems, we establish a model whose efficiency is related to the solar altitude angle and solar azimuth angle. After integrating the functional form, the known data are preprocessed and the model is corrected to derive the relationship between efficiency, power and various parameters of the heliostat field. The PSO algorithm is then used to adjust the system parameters to optimize the annual average thermal power output per unit mirror area of the heliostat field while satisfying constraints such as achieving the rated power.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Transmission Line Inspection System Based on High Sensitivity and High Gain Ultraviolet Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The current insulator fault diagnosis methods based on UV images are mostly based on the single frame image evaluation of the moving image, lack of comprehensive evaluation of the integrity of the moving image. Aiming at the difficulty of quantitative evaluation of insulator dynamic image irradiated by light, this project intends to develop a single-frame parallel overlay technology for insulator dynamic image detection. This paper presents an algorithm for filtering moving images based on morphology. The same order variance decomposition method is used to separate the insulator and UV crown to get the features of a single frame motion image. The method of single frame overlapping is used to synthesize the moving image. Visual radar map of image data is established. It is proved that this detection method can not only ensure the integrity of dynamic image evaluation of insulators based on the characteristics of moving image, but also comprehensively analyze the motion image and radar map of various insulators. The method proposed in this paper is of guiding significance to the actual insulator charging test.

Author Keywords: single-frame overlapping algorithm in the same position

articleTitle: Design of Legal Judgment Prediction on Knowledge Graph and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Legal judgment prediction (LJP) remains a critical task designed through legal artificial intelligence systems. LJP plays a crucial role in predicting judgment results in legal systems. Over the past few years, LJPs have attracted significant attention in Courts in China, given their convenience in optimizing legal processes. This article, therefore, seeks to design a legal judgment prediction system based on knowledge graphs and deep learning. To enhance the designed model's inference speed and prediction accuracy and significantly cut down on memory consumption, this article proposes the design of LJP based on knowledge graphs and deep learning, establishing the importance of using the BERT knowledge distillation system that will reduce the element of resource consumption in the design of the model. In this regard, the designed system will play a critical role in the transfer of knowledge through a systemic process that is efficient and faster than the traditional system.

articleTitle: Design of Lion-Headed Goose Supply Chain Traceability System Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, China's lion-headed goose industry has been developing rapidly, but the links in the lion-headed goose supply chain are relatively separated, and its supply chain traceability mechanism is incomplete, which prevents consumers from knowing the source of their products and the production process, and makes it difficult to establish trust in the products. In this paper, using IoT RFID technology and blockchain technology, we propose a decentralized, tamper-proof, and able to cover the links of raw goose breeding, slaughtering and processing, logistics and sales, to establish a lion-headed goose supply chain traceability system, which helps to improve consumers' trust in the quality and safety of the corresponding meat supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Methods for Angle Precision and Accuracy of Vehicle Mounted Lidar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Lidaris an important sensing component of the intelligent connected vehicle. Its performance is critical to the safety and reliability of automated driving system. Angle precision and accuracy are key performance indexes of lidar. Accurate testing is of great significance for improving the performance and safety of the automated driving system. This paper proposes three testing methods for the angle precision and accuracy of lidar, namely plate method, pyramid method and average method. By selecting key indicators, analyzing errors, and comparing advantages and disadvantages of these three methods, recommended testing methods for lidar with different scanning methods are provided, providing reference for the testing of lidar and its application in vehicles.

articleTitle: A Study on Esports Hotel Price Prediction Based on Random Forest Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of the esports market, esports hotels, as an emerging sector, have their prices influenced by various complex factors, including but not limited to geographical location, facility configurations, esports event schedules, and customer behavior patterns. This paper proposes a price prediction framework for esports hotels based on the Random Forest model, aiming to address the challenge of forecasting price fluctuations in the esports hotel industry through advanced artificial intelligence technology. Through meticulous parameter tuning and cross-validation, a high-performance Random Forest prediction model was constructed. The model not only takes into account traditional factors but also incorporates esports-specific variables such as event heat index and player preferences, significantly enhancing the accuracy of predictions and the model's generalization capability. Empirical analysis results show that compared with conventional prediction models, the Random Forest model proposed in this study excels in predicting price volatility in esports hotels, particularly demonstrating clear advantages in handling nonlinear relationships and high-dimensional data. Furthermore, the feature importance analysis of the model provides valuable insights for hotel managers, facilitating decision-making.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent System for Soccer Motion Recognition Based on Data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study endeavors to pioneer an advanced football motion recognition intelligent system, founded upon cutting-edge data analytics techniques. Through the framework of deep learning, the system adeptly manages intricate data, extracting pivotal insights. The adoption of the LAMP network architecture ensures both processing speed and stability. Leveraging the Vue framework, significant enhancements in interactivity and user experience are achieved across the system's front and back ends. The pivotal innovation lies in the integration of skeletal and depth features for behavior recognition, a technique that notably enhances the accuracy and efficiency of motion identification through canonical correlation analysis and support vector machine (SVM) algorithms. The design, development, and testing of this system showcase the immense potential of applying artificial intelligence technology in football training and matches, furnishing coaches and athletes with real-time, precise motion feedback, thereby elevating the quality of training and on-field performance.

articleTitle: Research on Tennis Ball Prediction Based on Multilayer Perceptron Model and Support Vector Machine Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: There are many factors that affect the outcome of a match, and it is hypothesized that momentum is one of the most important factors. In this paper, by building a connection-specific multilayer perceptron model, a comprehensive analysis of the game is conducted, and it is concluded that momentum is a comprehensive factor that can affect the game in many ways and reflect the players' athletic status. Second, this paper introduces a real-time Support Vector Machine Correlation Suggestion Model (SVM-Corr) that is able to predict future probability of winning points through data mismatches, which further validates the correctness and robustness of the model, which encourages us to apply the model to other matches. The model in this work will provide fascinating insights into analyzing and predicting matches, as well as providing suggestions for player form and tactics.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Cloud Platform for 5G Era
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper studies an artificial intelligence cloud platform for the 5G era, specifically involving the fields of artificial intelligence, cloud computing and big data, including heterogeneous distributed cloud platforms, which take the distributed mobile cloud computing collaborative architecture as the basic architecture; Distributed mobile cloud computing collaboration architecture includes intelligent terminal, mobile network, distributed mobile cloud computing server, collaboration controller and end-to-end terminal computing offload service quality assurance mechanism system. This paper establishes a 5G oriented distributed mobile cloud computing collaboration architecture and an end-to-end terminal computing offload service quality assurance mechanism, which can reduce the network interaction signaling overhead of the terminal in the computing offload, as well as the CPU utilization and energy consumption of the terminal resident decision process; The distributed deep learning platform, which ensures the end-to-end service quality and supports the customization and expansion of deep learning models and algorithms, can avoid the huge load and energy consumption brought by traditional mobile cloud computing to the WAN.

articleTitle: Race Swing Prediction and Importance Analysis Based on LSTM Recurrent Neural Network and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Contest swings are influenced by multiple and complex factors, which makes accurate prediction a challenging task. This study aims to utilize the advanced LSTM recurrent neural network with the random forest algorithm to make predictions of race swings and analyze the related important factors in depth. The experimental results show that the LSTM recurrent neural network can effectively capture the swings occurring in the contest and the high accuracy of the model is confirmed through relevant metrics. In addition, the analytical results of the random forest model not only determine the importance of each factor to the fluctuation of the competition but also propose corresponding coping strategies, which provide an important reference basis for further coping with the fluctuation. These findings provide important empirical support for a deeper understanding of the complexity of race swings and the development of effects.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Scheduling Strategy of Smart Grid Based on Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Firstly, this paper analyzes the power grid operation from three aspects: natural aging, health state and load. A mathematical model of optimal dispatching of power grid is established by integrating the optimal design of power flow in two cases of power grid and isolated island. The power network planning method based on zoning is proposed and solved. The time domain adaptive adjustment algorithm is adopted to ensure that the parameters in each partition do not change. In this project, the dynamic regulation strategy of power system based on island state is proposed to ensure the safe and reliable operation of the system. The mathematical model established in practice can adapt to the actual demand of smart grid, and can dynamically adjust the length of time cycle and interval, so as to achieve intelligent regulation of power system. The simulation results show that the method can consider the actual working condition of the power system well and dynamically adjust it. It is a safe, stable and reliable guarantee for the realization of smart grid.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Algorithm System of Electric Vehicle Battery State Estimation and Health Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This project aims to solve the problem that the high dependence of conventional extended Kalman filter (EKF) in accurate modeling conflicts with the inaccurate acquisition of battery dynamics modeling accuracy, and researches a new method for estimating state of charge (SOC) over the lifetime based on the fully data-driven modified EKF algorithm. This algorithm can effectively overcome the accumulation errors in traditional algorithms, while maintaining the dynamic performance of the system. At the same time, the traditional method over relies on the deficiency of the unit, and maintains the good robust performance of the unit. A black box system with internal voltage serves as output and battery internal impedance as time-varying parameter. Through dynamic identification, the actual operating status of the power battery is obtained, and its accurate and dynamic changes are ensured to achieve SOC estimation over the entire life cycle. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Negative Emotion Suppression in Higher-order Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The study focuses on the spread of emotions on the Internet, particularly negative emotions, and its impact on society and individuals. It introduces the S2E2I model, an improvement over the traditional SI model, which incorporates a latent estate and suppression rules for extreme emotions. The model was validated using real Weibo data, showing its effectiveness in simulating emotional propagation in real networks. The research highlights the importance of high-order network structures and suppression rules in controlling negative emotion spread and fostering a positive online social environment.

articleTitle: Research on Travel Route Recommendation Algorithm Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the complexity and diversity of tourism information processing, this paper proposes an innovative graph neural network method for the study of tourist route recommendation. In this study, a heterogeneous graph model system is constructed, in which the nodes cover three key elements: users, tourist attractions and tourist attraction types, which are interwoven through diversified links such as users' travel history behavior, the theme content of scenic spots and their thematic associations among each other. In this model, the user node reveals the individual's unique travel preferences and behavior patterns, the scenic spot node carries the detailed feature description of the scenic spot, and the tourism theme node highly summarizes the content, characteristics and style attributes of various scenic spots. By constructing a Graph structure that integrates the multi-dimensional relationship between users, attractions and topics, the proposed GC-GA (Graph Convolution with Graph Attention) algorithm is used to capture and integrate these rich and diverse information. In the actual application scenario, GC-GA adopts hierarchical learning strategy, and firstly uses multi-level graph convolutional neural network to deeply explore the characteristics of different types of nodes. Each level of GCN focuses on exploring and refining the unique attribute information contained in specific types of nodes, which may correspond to multiple levels of semantic understanding such as the user's focus of interest, the intrinsic quality characteristics of scenic spots, or the content of tourism themes. With the increase of the number of convolution layers in the graph, the model gradually understands and learns the embedded expression of each node in the complex graph structure environment from the local to the whole. Then, after completing multi-layer graph convolution learning, the graph attention mechanism is further integrated to effectively fuse different types of node features. The experimental results show that the travel route recommendation algorithm based on graph neural network performs significantly better than the traditional recommendation method on a series of tourism data sets, especially in the travel route recommendation scenario with strong personalized needs of users, it can more fully reflect the efficient use of complex association information and in-depth analysis ability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Terminology Recognition and Translation Memory Optimization in Computer-Aided Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In today's increasingly broad scope of translation work, the proportion of technological texts in translation work is also increasing. The construction of a deep learning model includes steps such as data preparation, building a deep learning model, model training, model evaluation, and optimization. During the optimization process of translation memory, based on the matching results of convolutional neural networks, the translation memory is updated to improve matching accuracy and efficiency. This article aimed to study the impact of different scale datasets and translation memory matching on small-scale, medium scale, and large-scale datasets. The term recognition accuracy of this method on large-scale datasets was 95.0%, and the translation memory matching accuracy was 92.0%. In contrast, in small-scale datasets, the accuracy of term recognition and translation memory matching were 85.0% and 80.0%, respectively. The effectiveness of intelligent terminology recognition and translation memory optimization on large-scale datasets is superior to that on small-scale datasets.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Indoor Fire Safety Detection System Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As the economy surges forward, people's lifestyles accelerate, leading to increased instances where homes are left unattended for extended periods due to longer working hours. This shift has heightened the frequency of fire incidents and gas leaks, raising concerns over residential fire safety hazards. To mitigate these risks and maximize the safety of life and property, this paper presents the design and implementation of an indoor fire safety detection system. Developed on an ARM core board and programmed in C language, the system integrates multiple sensors for detecting CO, smoke, and flames, along with the SIM800 messaging module, offering a comprehensive monitoring and alert solution to effectively ensure user safety.

articleTitle: Design of Teacher Portrait System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper takes the junior high school education administration system, human resource management system, student system and official website as the research object. Then the knowledge graph is used to study the multi-attribute teacher image. The system has intuitive material integration function, powerful interactive creation function, rich variable, function and program control function. The process line is used to connect each icon, which greatly improves the speed and quality of multimedia software development. The process of building the whole model is given in this paper. The image acquisition and analysis are completed. This paper extracts and generates feature entity and association information to generate portrait model. Finally, the design and implementation of the whole experiment are completed based on knowledge graph and Neo4j development environment. The joint recommendation method of knowledge graph based on multi-level structure is studied. The feature transformation matrix is removed during node updating in each level convolutional network, and its own connections are selectively maintained or removed. Through the real teaching data set, the analysis and application of teachers' teaching portraits are completed.

articleTitle: The Construction of Science and Technology Knowledge Map in New Energy Field Under Deep Learning Technology and Its Application to Deep Mining of Innovation Elements Association
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This project studies the knowledge map of spatiotemporal convolution dynamics of a new energy consumption. Firstly, through the four-element dynamic modeling of a large amount of new energy consumption data accumulated in the power system, the correlation of time and space in the process is clearly indicated. In this method, the local spatiotemporal image is quickly retrieved and extracted by using a rolling window and is used as a subgraph database. The mechanism knowledge in the energy consumption knowledge graph based on graph convolutional network is studied to guide its modeling, and the subgraph parallel optimization method is used to improve its learning performance to realize the efficient solution of the problem. This paper takes a certain province as the research object to carry out numerical simulation and experimental research. It is proved that this algorithm can avoid complex mathematical modeling and numerical calculation effectively, and is superior to the conventional algorithm in evaluation accuracy and calculation efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Ship Object Detection in Optical and SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Ship object detection is one of the key technologies in the fields of maritime traffic monitoring, maintenance of maritime rights and interests, and coastal defense early warning detection. Optical remote sensing data contains rich texture information, which is conducive to target recognition, but it is highly depends on light and can only be used during the day. The influence of light on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data is negligible, so it can be used all-weather, but it is difficult to accurately distinguish ship targets due to the lack of texture information. In order to comprehensively utilize two different data and fully leverage their respective advantages, a multimodal ship object rotated detection algorithm is proposed. Feature extraction is conducted separately for optical and SAR data, and an intermediate fusion strategy is adopted to achieve the fusion and detection of optical and SAR features. The introduction of CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) in the backbone facilitates automatic identification of the weight of each feature channel during the learning process, which enhances the effect of feature extraction and suppresses noise and irrelevant information. The proposed multimodal detection algorithm has been validated on the constructed QXS-SAROPT-SHIP dataset. Compared with typical horizontal bounding box detection and single-modal detection algorithms, the accuracy rate of the proposed multimodal detection algorithm has been significantly improved. Specifically, the accuracy of the multimodal detection algorithm with CBAM module has been increased by 1.73%, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Construction and Real Time Update Mechanism of a Multi User Personalized Electricity Consumption Behavior Model Under Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: It is a troublesome problem to model the user's electricity consumption behavior and add an update mechanism. Traditional models have challenges in real-time and personalization, so the introduction of real-time update mechanism has become a key method to improve model performance. Based on deep learning technology, this research constructs a multi-user personalized electricity consumption behavior model, and introduces a real-time update mechanism. First, a large number of user electricity consumption behavior data is used for training to establish the predictive power of the model, and then through the introduction of a real-time update mechanism, the model can respond to new data in a timely manner, and perform parameter updates and prediction result generation. Through experiments, it is evaluated that the prediction accuracy rate of this method is between 89% and 98%.
