The electricity consumption behavior model with a real-time update mechanism is better than the model without a real-time update mechanism in terms of prediction accuracy and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Automated Prediction and Sustainable Management of Global Warming Impact on Power Systems: A Hybrid ARIMA-BP Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The advent of the industrial revolution marked a transformative era for power systems, yet its repercussions on global warming are undeniable. The rampant combustion of fossil fuels has unleashed vast amounts of greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide and methane into the atmosphere, perpetuating the greenhouse effect and precipitating a surge in Earth's surface temperature. This climatic perturbation has set forth a cascade of calamities and obstacles. In this paper, we propose an automated approach to address these challenges and steer power systems towards sustainable automation. Leveraging data from a climate prediction weather station spanning January 1900 to December 2023, we conduct an in-depth analysis. The Shapiro-Wilk normality test exposes the non-normal distribution of the data, necessitating outlier detection through box plot analysis and subsequent removal. Employing the Newton interpolation method, we interpolate missing data points to ensure data continuity. We then introduce an innovative ARIMA-BP neural network model augmented with residual correction methodology to forecast global annual average temperatures over the next five years. Our hybrid model combines the predictive prowess of ARIMA for projecting global monthly mean temperature over the ensuing 60 months with the refinement capabilities of the BP neural network for forecasting residual series, culminating in the estimation of average annual global temperatures for the upcoming five years. Through this analysis, we delineate the trajectory of global warming and offer cogent recommendations for fortifying the future of automated power systems in tandem with sustainable development imperatives.

articleTitle: Exploring Meibomian Gland Dysfunction Grading: A Comparison of Machine Learning and XAI Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This research investigates the effectiveness of employing a machine learning methodology and an Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tool for the assessment of Meibomian Gland Dysfunction (MGD). Utilizing ResNet34, a convolutional neural network (CNN), trained on a diverse dataset comprising images depicting varying degrees of MGD severity, the machine learning approach endeavors to classify MGD severity into four distinct grades (0, 1, 2, 3) by leveraging extracted characteristic features. Findings reveal comparable accuracy between ResNet34 and the XAI tool, with ResNet34 achieving a slightly lower accuracy of 99.1% in contrast to the XAI tool's 99.4%. However, ResNet34 demonstrates marginally higher precision and F1-score at 98.2% and 98.45%, respectively, suggesting a nuanced advantage in precision-recall equilibrium. Conversely, the XAI tool maintains a commendable precision of 97.2% and an Fl-score of 97.94%, alongside a recall of 98.7%, underscoring its effectiveness in discerning positive instances. Noteworthy is that ResNet34 operates as a black-box model, providing limited interpretability, while the XAI tool emphasizes transparency by furnishing clinicians with understandable MGD grading elucidations derived from meibomian gland segmentation and atrophy analysis. This transparency enhances trust and comprehension, which are integral for clinical acceptance and decision-making. Furthermore, the utilization of XAI heatmap generation facilitates data quality enhancement, as evidenced by instances of erroneous artifact identification, emphasizing the imperative nature of artifact elimination for the refinement of MGD grading procedures.

articleTitle: A Three-Phase Closed-Loop PLL Algorithm and Model Based on Optimized Second-Order Generalized Integral Adaptive Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Although the dual second-order generalized integral adaptive filter can achieve phase locking when the power grid voltage is unbalanced, it still cannot accurately lock in the presence of DC components and high-order harmonics. In view of this, an optimized design method and algorithm are proposed to add a low-pass filter LPF to the subtraction channel, making the phase locking more adaptable to the power grid. The adaptive filter algorithm model mentioned in this article can be implemented in engineering through embedded platform software such as DSP, FPGA, or PLC, with reliable performance, and is particularly suitable for the engineering application of power grid connected converters of various power levels.

articleTitle: Intelligent Insurance Actuarial Model Under Machine Learning and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Traditional actuarial methods in insurance are inadequate and have low computational accuracy when dealing with massive amounts of information in the modern insurance industry. This article intended to screen out features that play an important role in insurance actuarial analysis by applying information gain, mutual information, and other means, and screen input variables to avoid dimensional disasters. In order to improve the learning speed of intelligent insurance actuarial models, methods such as backpropagation algorithm, shared weights, and parallel operations were adopted. This article compared different types of deep learning models used in the model, such as CNN (Convolutional Neural Network), RNN (Recurrent Neural Network), and analyzed their performance advantages and disadvantages to help insurance companies choose appropriate model solutions. Model 1 (CNN+vehicle image) has an accuracy of 0.85, a recall rate of 0.80, and an F1 score of 0.82; Model 2 (RNN+text description) has an accuracy of 0.75, a recall rate of 0.72, and an F1 score of 0.73. This article presents an intelligent insurance actuarial model based on machine learning and data mining, which helps to achieve accurate prediction and pricing of insurance actuaries.

articleTitle: Improved Thermal Dome Structure Optimization Design Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This research introduces an optimized design methodology for thermal domes, which realize thermally invisible. Unlike traditional thermal cloaks that demand exceptional material properties and are environmentally inflexible, the proposed thermal domes employ an open structure for ease of installation and reconfiguration, adaptability, and internal heat source accommodation. The study utilizes a neural network model trained with the Levenberg-Marquardt optimization algorithm to correlate the thermal conductivity of the dome's layers with its performance. The model training involves a dataset derived from finite element simulations, with a focus on optimizing the minimal value of a defined evaluation function to identify the optimal layer configuration. Results show that the neural network model achieves high predictive accuracy, as well as the following validation through the finite element simulation. The combination of the trained neural networks and the additional design samples generated rapidly through Latin hypercube sampling enable efficient and swift evaluation of thermal dome configurations. The cloaking functionality of the neural network-designed thermal domes is validated through comparative temperature field and isotherm distribution analyses. In conclusion, the integration of theoretical analysis with neural network modeling has led to the development of a robust framework for intelligent thermal dome design. The approach not only streamlines the design process but also expands the potential design schemes for thermal domes, offering a versatile solution for advanced thermal device design across various applications.

articleTitle: Classification and Disease Prediction of Heart Rate Signals Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Intelligent analysis techniques based on random forest for heart rate signals enable effective interpretation of electrocardiograms, assisting in the prediction, early warning, and management of cardiovascular diseases. This study extracts time-domain and frequency-domain features to construct a random forest model for the classification of heart rate signals and the prediction of anomalies. Experimental results demonstrate the accurate identification of common arrhythmias and high accuracy in predicting heart rate abnormalities, providing monitoring and intervention support for cardiovascular diseases. The effectiveness of the method is verified through ten real-life electrocardiogram cases. This research offers high-performance machine learning solutions for the processing and analysis of complex physiological signals, expanding the application of random forest in the field of life sciences, and providing technical support for intelligent prediction and management of cardiovascular diseases.

articleTitle: Design of a College Student Management System Based on Computer Technology and B/S Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Student management systems provide a data processing approach that universities in business processing widely use. Given the challenge of data storage and risks, weak concurrency and single-function controls are often faced with the traditional university management processes and systems, establishing the rationale behind this research paper that proposes the design of a college learner management system based on computer technology and B/S architecture. The system is primarily designed through computer technology and B/<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S$</tex> architecture, which are driven toward testing the significant performance of the designed system in running an institution's process. The findings of this study reveal that that running delays and times of the designed system were significantly reduced as opposed to the traditional student management system, hypothetically justifying the efficiency of the designed system.

articleTitle: Visual Encoding Method for Industrial VR Interface Prompts Supporting Well Drilling's Suction Process
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To shorten the training time of well sinking construction personnel and enhance their operational proficiency, a visual encoding method for industrial VR interface prompts has been designed and developed to support the suction process during drilling. Based on the HTC VIVE Pro 2 external device and utilizing virtual reality and human-computer interaction technologies, this method achieves the training objectives for well sinking operations. Through natural interactive operations and visualized simulations of virtual events, it provides users with an immersive educational experience, reducing the gap between theoretical instruction and practical operations in traditional training models, and facilitating easy knowledge acquisition by users.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Route Planning Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are of great significance in the inspection of key areas, and route planning is a key link for UAVs in performing their tasks. To this end, an optimal route planning method for UAVs based on the ant colony algorithm is proposed to solve the multi-UAV scheduling problem in the inspection of key areas. First, the ant colony algorithm is used to find the approximate Hamilton circle of each key area, and then the shortest inspection time of each area can be found. Then, 0–1 linear programming is applied to find the optimal flight route from base H to each focus area and the minimum number of UAVs. Further, the UAV coverage problem is solved using classical generalization approximation to find the minimum number of 3 UAVs required with 95.7270% coverage and the optimal flight routes. Finally, to ensure that the time interval between two adjacent inspections of the above inspected places is not greater than 3 hours, the rectangular orbit model as well as the time-drone numbering model are solved in three steps. Finally, a minimum of 78 UAVs are required, and the flight time and route of each UAV is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Road Pothole Recognition Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the urban road pothole detection problem and develops a computer vision-based pothole detection model using deep learning methods. First, a pre-trained EfficientNetBO convolutional neural network is used as a feature extractor and combined with a target detection framework to learn and test the road images; second, the generalization ability of the model to unknown data is effectively improved by image enhancement techniques such as random cropping, rotating, and flipping; lastly, experiments show that the model has an accuracy of more than 90% on a number of test sets, and especially in the complex scenes outperforms traditional methods, showing good robustness and generalization ability, which provides important technical support for smart city management.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Transmitter-side Electrochemical Energy Storage on the Commutation Failures at the Receiver-side in UHVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: One of the most frequent errors in UHVDC transmission systems is commutation failure. Following the commutation failure, the DC current will dramatically increase and DC voltage will abruptly decrease, which seriously affects the normal work of the system and even interrupts the transmission. Existing large-scale wind energy bases are installed with energy storage power stations, whose energy storage technology has the potential to suppress commutation failure. Therefore, based on the CIGRE-HVDC model, this paper investigates the influence factors of commutation failure from three aspects: energy storage output under the absorbed power and emitted power, energy storage capacity, and failure degree in different storage capacity configured with different failure degrees, and find that the energy storage capacity with a standard value of about 0.8 can achieve better results, and when commutation failure happens, the absorbed power of the energy storage may help to inhibit it.

articleTitle: A Design for an Intelligent Washing Machine Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As living standards improve, so as do the expectations of consumers regarding washing machines. This study proposes a design scheme for a smart washing machine system with intelligent identification and control based on the washing needs and care requirements of fabrics made from different materials. The identification module uses RFID technology to recognize the types of materials being washed, and it controls the RFID chip through a Cortex-M3 processor to obtain the washing information. The system collects laundry data and automatically selects the optimal laundry mode, thereby avoiding any adverse effects on laundry items made of different materials.

articleTitle: Circuit Object Detection and Standard Cell Recognition in IC Images Based on Semantic Segmentation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Recently, semantic segmentation techniques have been applied to inverse analysis of IC chips, specifically to detect circuit components. However, these techniques have not yet fully considered the challenge of balancing global and local information when automatically detecting IC components with varying sizes. This work proposes an optimized Nested U-Net network to address this challenge for accurate circuit component detection in IC images, obtained from SEM. Experimental results have demonstrated that by combining semantic segmentation model with image processing techniques, the performance of standard cell recognition and classification in IC images can be improved significantly.

articleTitle: Power Study of Dropping and Swinging Longitudinally Swinging Float Type Wave Energy Converter Based on Differential Equation and MATLAB Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the energy conversion efficiency of wave energy and aims at solving the maximum output power of a wave energy conversion device. By establishing the equations of motion of the pendulum float and the oscillator, this study firstly solves the pendulum displacement and velocity under constant and non-constant damping coefficients, and further solves the maximum output power and the corresponding optimal damping coefficients using MATLAB. Secondly, when the damping coefficients and damper coefficients are constants, the float vibrator motion model and the optimal damper coefficient model under the longitudinal oscillation of float pendulum are established respectively. Finally, the maximum power of the conversion device and the corresponding optimal damping coefficient are calculated from the solution model in this paper, which provides a certain reference for the analysis of wave energy conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Improvement of Vehicle Detection Algorithm Based on UAV Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper aims to address the issue of poor performance of conventional detection methods in detecting small targets. Based on the Yolov8 detection model, three improvement strategies are proposed. Firstly, a lightweight BiFormer sparse dynamic attention module is added to the backbone network of Yolov8 to enhance the ability to extract features of small targets in the feature map[1]. To tackle the problem of detail and texture information loss during the upsampling process of the feature map in Yolov8, a lightweight upsampling operator CARAFE module is used to replace the original nearest-neighbor linear interpolation upsampling method[2]. In response to the sensitivity of the IOU series as a metric method to deviations in the positions of small targets in images, a novel NWD loss function is employed. Experimental results show that the detection speed of the proposed improved Yolov8 model is slightly reduced compared to before the improvement, but both precision and recall rates have improved. This indicates that the improved Yolov8 model enhances the detection of small vehicle targets from the UAV's perspective.

articleTitle: Clinical Nursing Intelligent Interaction System Based on Virtual Augmented Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a new medical diagnosis method. It uses computer technology, image processing and visualization tools to simulate the environment, and converts the visual information seen by the patient during the doctor's examination into the data required by the human tactile system. This paper introduces the design of an interactive system based on virtual reality technology, which is based on virtual enhanced simulation technology. The system uses MATLAB software for data processing, and combines relevant literature to model the device. In the course of research, it was found that the system can realize human-computer interface interaction, patient information display and other functions; The patient management operation is simple, convenient and fast, and the virtual verification is completed after the patient parameter modification and diagnosis results are clear and accurate. The experimental results show that the clinical nursing intelligent interaction system based on virtual augmented reality technology can improve the efficiency of doctor-patient communication and also enhance the speed of information transmission.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Infrared Image Processing Technology in Strength Detection of Building Steel Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This project intends to use YOLOv5 to realize intelligent detection of pulsed electromagnetic field information of subsurface damage. Firstly, a dynamic detection head based on attention mechanism is added to the head network. Then the attention mechanism between levels is proportional perception. Spatial interval attention mechanism is used in spatial perception. The attention mechanism in the output channel is used in task recognition. This method focuses on the detection of relevant background objects. MPDIOU is used instead of CIOU edge box loss function, which improves the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm. The lightweight network Faster Net is added to the C3 module at the neck end and the real-time modeling is improved. The technology can automatically measure sub-surface damage of gold-containing components without stripping the coating. In this paper, the intelligent identification of corrosion, crack and deadhesion damage of the subsurface of coated steel is realized, while maintaining the integrity of the coating. The four types of sub-surface damage of the metal-containing components are demonstrated. For 4 different kinds of faults, the correct rate can reach 96%, 97%, 95%, 93%. The algorithm meets the requirement of real-time test.

articleTitle: Dimension-Agnostic Task-Adaptive Subspace Learning for Few-shot Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Few-shot classification aims to classify unknown samples with very few labeled examples. Many recent methods create feature subspace mappings for different few-shot tasks, but they all pre-specify the dimensionality, which does not meet the practical needs. In this paper, we propose a transductive approach that searches an adaptive feature subspace for each few-shot task by quantifying the influences of dimensional change without fixing the dimensionality. Moreover, we develop a clustering-based prototype rectification approach to fully use the task-related information in the subspace. We conduct extensive experiments on miniImageNet and tieredImageNet. Our method achieves competitive performance with the previous state-of-the-art approaches in various settings and datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Train Operation Optimization Based on Simulation and Multi-Objective Optimization Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To realize the energy-saving operation of urban rail transit, we propose an energy-saving train operation optimization strategy based on a multi-objective optimization model. The differential equation of the train in the three stages of traction, cruise and braking is constructed, the shortest time for the train to arrive at the platform is obtained by solving the equation. Different time periods are added to the shortest time, so as to inversely solve the distance and the functional relationship between each parameter. On this basis, considering the influence of different speed limits and ramp conditions on different road sections of the train during actual operation, the multi-objective optimization based on genetic algorithm is used to achieve the goal of solving the shortest time and fixed running time under the condition of ensuring minimum energy consumption. In addition, the differential equation model of the train encountering delay in the case of emergencies is established to realize the real-time update of the train state during operation, so as to realize the optimal solution under multi-objective, so that the energy saving strategy is more effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Driving System of Electric Vehicle Path Planning Based on Computer Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A human-machine sharing control method based on the automatic driving of electric vehicles is proposed. The system consists of steering system, braking system, vehicle acceleration system, PLC system and external environment sensing system. This paper uses binocular stereo vision and multithreading technology to realize the sense of the surrounding environment. Siemens S7200PLC is used as controller to realize automatic control and human-machine conversion. The goal of this project is the shortest path, the shortest waiting time for charging, the minimum additional energy consumption and the maximum battery life. A multi-dimensional path planning method based on path selection, battery discharge threshold and charge stop time is constructed with the restrictions of path selection, battery discharge threshold and charge stop time. The calculation results show that the proposed algorithm can provide the user with the optimal energy consumption and mileage. The designed low speed electric vehicle intelligent driving system control is relatively stable. The system is relatively inexpensive and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation Mechanism of Traffic Virtual Reality Teaching Resources Based on Computer Big Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In view of the existing problems in the road transport industry, in this study, an educational framework tailored for road transport professionals is established, leveraging data mining techniques. The research also envisions a bespoke content suggestion engine for vocational training in the transportation sector, powered by deep learning algorithms. The user data of traffic training and education resources are obtained by using crawler technology, and the characteristics of both are extracted and integrated. The correlation between vehicle driving training course data and user behavior characteristics based on deep neural network is constructed to achieve personalized recommendation of vehicle driving training course resources. Results indicate that the algorithm's recall rate, precision, and normalized loss exhibit significant cumulative growth, and it has good recommendation performance. The system proposed in this paper provides an effective way to further improve the training and education of highway traffic management personnel. It can improve the safety of drivers and reduce the incidence of car accidents.

articleTitle: Study of Heliograph Alignment Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm and Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the relationship between different factors, such as the size and arrangement of heliostats, and the optical efficiency and output power is modeled to optimize the distribution of heliostats. The modeling procedure is used to calculate the annual average optical efficiency and thermal power output of the heliostat field, as well as the size of the annual average thermal power output per unit mirror surface area. Finally, the model is set up and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is applied to find the optimal arrangement of the heliostat mirrors and improve the output power. And the advantages and disadvantages of the model and suggestions for improvement are given.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Object Detection Algorithm Based on Deep-Learning in Photo Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Traditional image management adopts manual comparison between the real situation after maintenance and the photos in the standard atlas, which has a large maintenance workload and inaccurate detection effect. In view of this situation, this paper puts forward a method of comparing photos with the YOLO V4 algorithm using deep-learning, which uses self-made data set to train the model. A comparative analysis is carried out with the previous algorithm. The research results show that the method with YOLO V4 algorithm can achieve better results in the average accuracy of photo comparison.

articleTitle: Wargame Multi-Target Path Planning Optimization Using A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The traditional path planning problems typically focus on a single objective, whereas in the field of Wargame, it is crucial to consider trade-offs and compromises between multiple objectives. To address this issue, we propose a multi-objective path planning method based on the A* algorithm. By integrating multiple targets into a unified framework and evaluating node priority characteristics using the A* algorithm, our approach can identify the Pareto front that satisfies all target requirements optimally. In order to validate the feasibility of our results, we construct experimental scenarios and analyze the performance and effectiveness. The experimental findings demonstrate that the multi-objective A* algorithm exhibits excellent applicability and potential in Wargame applications, providing decision makers with enhanced support and guidance.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Label Classification of Chinese Text Based on Word-Label Probability and DistilBERT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Multi-label text classification is a fundamental task in the field of natural language processing. Currently, there are issues in the Chinese multi-label text classification tasks, such as insufficient extraction of text label features and a lack of learning about the correlations between labels. To address these challenges, we proposed a Multi-label Text Classification Model based on DistilBERT and Word-Label Probabilities (DBWL). The model consists of a metric space module that integrates word-label probabilities and a deep neural network module based on DistilBERT. Firstly, the trained Labeled Latent Dirichlet Allocation (Labeled-LDA) model is utilized to obtain the probabilities of words associated with labels, which are then used to calculate the text mapping vectors and map them into the same metric space as the labels. Similarity measurement is employed to extract features between text-label pairs and label-label pairs. Then, in the deep neural network module, DistilBERT is employed to jointly embed texts and labels, capturing rich semantic information about text labels, followed by feature extraction using TextCNN. Finally, the features extracted from both modules are weighted and fused for label prediction. Experimental results on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms current mainstream multi-label classification models in terms of key performance metrics.

articleTitle: Research on LiDAR Based on Embedded Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rise of intelligent robots, driverless cars and other emerging technologies, the application of lidar is becoming more and more widely used, and intelligent unmanned devices have become a very critical problem for the surrounding environment perception. This paper designs a small two-dimensional lidar detection system developed by using embedded microcontroller, consumer lidar module, industrial capacitive touch LCD screen and MATLAB host programming. This paper analyzes and discusses the principles of the hardware circuit and software part used. This paper introduces the program design idea and develop ent process in the form of overall flow chart and division program block diagram. Finally, the drawings are designed. The housing was made for the system. We completed the production and commissioning of the finished device of the lidar detection system. At the same time, the lidar system and the innovation points of the design, the future improvement ideas and development prospects are discussed. The radar detection has the real-time detection function of the plane 360 environment, and has the advantages of intuitive operation and display, compact size, low power consumption and low cost.

articleTitle: Implementation of Intelligent Student Management Evaluation Algorithm Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Computer technology in China and the world is developing day by day, and software applications in various fields, such as military equipment, aerospace, and people's daily business and activities, have an increasing influence. At the same time, the complexity and diversification of software functions make the structure of software. The increasing complexity and scale have resulted in an increasing number and types of potential defects. Defective software will cause failures during operation, which will increase development and maintenance costs and reduce customer satisfaction. It can also bring unforeseen results and heavy losses. The main reason is that the student management data is relatively complex and there are certain errors and deficiencies, so it cannot accurately and effectively evaluate the student management. Aiming at the shortcomings of current software project risk assessment algorithms, this paper introduces BP neural network into software project risk assessment, and proposes a software project risk assessment method based on BP neural network. The simulation results show that the use of BP neural network to evaluate software project risks can effectively reduce the impact of human factors on the evaluation accuracy. There is a certain degree of improvement in the above, which can greatly improve the evaluation accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an E-Commerce Micro Course Teaching Platform System Based on Mobile Terminals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper seeks to design and implement an E-commerce micro course teaching platform system based on mobile terminals. Individuals have different learning capacities, yet schools educate them in the same classroom. Controlling learning capacities might be challenging. This issue is addressed by integrating learning strategies into this online course management system. Therefore, this effort aims to create adaptive e-learning software that will allow the learner to solve issues or respond to questions according to their level of competence. The desire to address severe concerns and raise knowledge about the optimal ways for learners to learn drives this study. This project creates an adjustable online learning environment where students can complete tasks at their speed or aptitude. In addition, it offers an online classroom that will function in tandem with the conventional classroom. Combining the caching technique with the thread pool technology would improve the UI user experience while preventing unnecessary network resource usage.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Spectrum of Cumulant in Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Noise suppression is one of the most important and challenging problem in SAR image edge detection. To provide a precise SAR image edge detection method, a novel mathematical statistic, called Fractional Order Spectrum of Cumulant (FOS-C), is proposed to suppress the heavy tailed and signal-dependent non-Gaussian noises that can be described using Symmetric <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> Stable (SaS) distribution. In the proposed SAR image edge detection framework: 1) Fractional Order Moment (FOM) is estimated for further calculation of Fractional Order Cumulant (FOC). FOC is obtained based on mathematical relation between FOC and FOM; 2) The proposed FOS-C is calculated to construct a FOS-C image; 3) The gradient of the FOS-C image is calculated to detect edges in the original image. The noise suppression ability of FOS-C is proved mathematically. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms two state-of-the-art edge detection algorithms for SAR images.

articleTitle: Regional Hazard Prediction Model Based on LSTM Recurrent Neural Network and TOPSIS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper introduces a Real Estate Development Evaluation Model that integrates advanced predictive and evaluative techniques to prioritize areas for real estate development. Initially, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models are employed to forecast the incidence of disasters in various regions over the next decade. Subsequently, the Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) method is utilized to conduct a comprehensive evaluation based on multiple indicators, with the goal of assessing the suitability of construction and development in each area. As a result, ten priority areas are identified, with North Carolina emerging as a key region for real estate development.

articleTitle: A Study on Analyzing the Direction of Wordle Puzzle Results Based on ARIMA Prediction and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is a popular puzzle currently offered daily by The New York Times, and it has gained popularity among players from various countries and regions in a short period of time. In this study, by analyzing and studying the data of Wordle puzzles provided by The New York Times, we predicted the number of reported results of Wordle in the next two months, and comprehensively summarized and analyzed the word characteristics. First, an ARIMA prediction model was established and the trend of the number of Wordle reported results was simulated. Second, four attributes of words were extracted: word frequency, initial letter frequency, letter repetition rate, and number of words, which were analyzed using multiple linear regression model, correlation analysis, and ADF test. Then, the word attribute data were collected and organized and analyzed using an iterative random forest model, which showed that the model fit was good and there was no overfitting. Next, the words were classified by difficulty using the RSR comprehensive evaluation method, and the classification results were trained and tested using the machine learning decision tree classification model, with an average accuracy of 85%. Finally, the obtained data of the word “ERNIE” was used to predict the difficulty, and the conclusion was “easy”. The number of attempts for each word was analyzed by S-W test and K-S test and found to be normally distributed. This study provides an in-depth understanding of the future development trend of Wordle and word characteristics, and offers new methods and ideas for related research.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Image Recognition and LiDAR Localization of Green Onion Harvester Under Mechanical Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In light of the pressing need for large-scale automatic green onion harvesting, as well as the short lifespan of excavation mechanisms and susceptibility to backwater at the front end, this study has developed a double-twisted dragon scallion harvester. This innovative harvester utilizes intelligent image recognition and LiDAR positioning technology to identify the optimal path, resulting in improved efficiency and performance while enhancing the user experience through enhanced human-computer interaction. The mechanical analysis of the mining component is presented along with a brief description of the design concept. Simulation testing using 3D software and EDEM indicates an enhancement in soil flow conditions and loading capacity of the digging shovel, with an optimal working angle identified at 30°. Field experiments demonstrate clutter rates and average damage rates at 3.43% and 3.91% respectively, significantly reducing backwater conditions and indicating more efficient soil particle flow leading to improved harvest efficiency after optimization.

articleTitle: A Study of Player Performance Prediction Based on Data-Driven LOGISTIC Test and Multi-Machine Algorithmic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the index system based on players' individual technical ability, first-hand advantage, game mentality, fatigue level and offensive aggressiveness was constructed and the players' scores were evaluated and visualized. The significance test of the indicator system and players' scores was conducted through LOGISTIC to analyze the performance-related indicators. Based on the previously derived results, the Spearman correlation between the probability of a player's score and the actual score was examined and a linear regression model was constructed to explore the effect of momentum on a player's score. Then, the indicators were clustered to analyze the relationship between indicators and players' performance, the features were aggregated, the correlation between indicators was tested by LOGISTIC, and the MLP model was selected for modeling by 5-fold cross-validation. Finally, according to the importance of each indicator, reasonable suggestions were provided for players. Four games were randomly selected, and the “momentum” of the games was comprehensively measured by machine learning algorithms and visualized by ROC curves and AUC values. The technical strength of the competitors was factored into the future model. By analyzing the generalization performance of the model constructed by testing the 2015 Sudirman Cup match between Lin Dan and Tohma Ueda, it can be obtained that the model constructed above has good generalization performance for badminton, which may be due to the fact that there are many similarities between these two sports; the decrease in the model's performance may be due to the fact that tennis is more of a test of endurance while badminton is more of a test of explosive power. The reason for the decrease in model performance may be that tennis is more endurance-testing while badminton is more explosive-testing.

articleTitle: A Coil Detachment Protection Method Suitable for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to ensure efficient and stable wireless charging of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) under offset conditions, and timely turn off the power when the UAV coil's leaves the charging area, this paper adopts bottom charging method to charge UAVs wirelessly. A flat solenoid coil structure is designed, which can enable UAVs to charge efficiently and stably even when offset. The secondary side detects whether the UAVs has left the charging area, providing protection for the disconnection process of UAVs Charging. Simulation verification show that the maximum power of the system reaches 211W, the energy transmission distance can reach 3cm, the optimal charging efficiency can reach 92%, and the maximum lateral offset is 5cm, which can meet the wireless charging needs of UAVs.

articleTitle: Optimizing Logistic Regression for Predicting Teacher Job Satisfaction: An AI-Driven Approach to Faculty Development
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study focuses on the development and optimization of a logistic regression model to predict teacher job satisfaction, emphasizing the role of artificial intelligence technology in enhancing the accuracy of educational data analysis. By applying Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and Random Forest algorithms to enhance and optimize data from 453 teacher surveys, this research demonstrates the effective use of computer models in addressing complex educational issues. The optimized model not only excels in predicting teacher satisfaction but also provides insights for educational management, aiding in the improvement of teachers' working environments and professional development. This work not only proves the potential of deep learning technologies in the field of education but also offers a new perspective and tools for future educational research and practices using artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Learning to Reconstruct Flow Fields from Limited Measurements
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: We study the problem of perception and reconstruction of flow fluids with limited measurements. Deep learning-based approaches have outperformed traditional methods in this setting due to the capacity and generalization of deep learning-based approaches. It still lacks a principle for designing neural architectures. Inspired by Erichson [1], this paper takes multilayer perceptron as an example and explores the neural architecture search under the guidance of traditional principles. Lots of experiments have been conducted and the results demonstrate the validity of the neural architecture search.

articleTitle: The Capacity Optimization of the Microgrid System Based on Security and Reliability Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the increase of renewable energy penetration in the microgrid, the microgrid of renewable energy faces limited consumption capacity and lower security and reliability. In this paper, the capacity rationing of the microgrid is developed to solve the limited consumption capacity under security and reliability constraints. To consider the wind turbine, photovoltaic turbine, microturbine unit, and energy storage system as a whole system, the operation planning of the model is established to analyze the security and reliability of the system under different occasions. The power exchange mechanism with the larger power grid is considered in the optimized capacity rationing strategy of the microgrid. The optimized capacity rationing of the model is established by using MATLAB and YALMIP. Through the model simulation, compared with other traditional methods, the proposed model in this paper improves the utilization rate of renewable energy and also ensures the security and reliability of the microgrid, and reduces the operating cost of the microgrid.

articleTitle: Research on Expression Recognition Algorithm Based on University Students' Mental State
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of higher education in our country, the number of college students is increasing year by year. There are more and more campus accidents caused by college students' psychological problems, which has aroused people's great attention to college students' psychological problems. Many scholars have conducted in-depth research on college students' psychological problems. To solve students' psychological problems, we must first find out the problems in time. With the improvement of the level of social information, face recognition technology integrates multiple key technologies such as computer vision, artificial intelligence, and deep learning, which has been widely used in different fields of society. However, there are few researches and applications on the mental health status of college students. Therefore, this paper combines the expression recognition technology with the psychological problems of college students, fully excavates the static and dynamic features of dynamic expression behavior through convolutional neural networks, establishes a facial expression recognition model, and conducts comparative experiments through open data sets to verify the accuracy of different algorithms, so as to timely discover the psychological problems of college students. The method of expression recognition is used to control the psychology of college students.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Impact of Light Environment on Drivers' Visual Load in Dense Tunnel Section
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To investigate the correlation between alterations in a driver's visual characteristics and the safety of driving in dense tunnel sections., we have analyzed the regulation of pupil area changes as drivers traverse tunnel entrances and exits. To capture the phenomenon of visual changes during repeated tunnel entries and exits., we introduce the concept of 'load repeat accumulation effect'. We utilize the maximum transient velocity of pupil area., denoted as Vω(t), as an evaluation metric to describe the dynamics of a driver's visual load. Specifically, the maximum transient velocity value of pupil area, abbreviated as MTPA, and the duration of visual turbulence transitions serve as the foundation for assessing the magnitude of the driver's visual load. An evaluation system is established to assess drivers' visual comfort at tunnel entrances and exits, and based on this system, we determine the visual load. Ultimately, this approach enables us to quantify the degree of influence that tunnel entrances and exits are on traffic safety. The research findings indicate that our methodology is viable, suitable for evaluating visual loads of drivers in dense tunnel sections, and provides valuable insights for enhancing safety measures at tunnel entrances and exits.

articleTitle: Athlete Score Prediction and Influencing Factors Analysis Based on SVM, RF and BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The study develops a score prediction model to evaluate player performance. The model is established with two metrics (one-step accuracy and five-step accuracy) to measure its precision. Three different algorithms, including Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and BP neural network, are tested. Results indicate that the optimal method is the Random Forest algorithm, achieving the highest five-step accuracy of 84.12%. Additionally, player performance visualization in the context of finals is presented, enhancing the analytical process. Furthermore, two approaches are used to examine whether an athlete's score is related to momentum. The findings suggest that momentum and scores do not conform to a random distribution. The study also highlights the importance and correlation of all factors. The pearson correlation coefficient between momentum and the last 5-point score is found to be 0.255, ranking third among the simplified 9 indicators, only surpassed by historical rankings and servers. This implies a correlation between momentum and player performance.

articleTitle: Fruit Classification Identification Research Based on VGG16 Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To address the limitations of traditional fruit classification methods that rely on manual extraction, this study proposes a network model utilizing VGG16 architecture and the fruits-360 public dataset. Initially, the fruit types are categorized and annotated, encompassing a total of 16 distinct varieties. Subsequently, batches of fruit images are fed into the VGG16 network for model training following parameter optimization. The experimental findings demonstrate superior performance compared to conventional fruit classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Fault Based on Least Square Support Vector Machine and Kernel Principal Component Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Based on the current mainstream research and analysis methods on internal fault analysis of large power transformers at home and abroad, this paper proposes the extension of least square support vector machine, which can transform quadratic programming problems into linear equations. This method reduces the computational complexity, improves the convergence speed and accuracy, and has a strong ability to deal with multiple classification problems. Combined with engineering practice, the original data of the transformer is non-linearly dimensionally reduced. Subsequently, the Harris hawk optimization intelligence algorithm is adopted to make the parameters of LSSVM have better performace to achieve a higher accuracy in transformer fault diagnosis. This approach addresses the challenge of determining LSSVM parameters. The paper presents a method for transformer fault recognition based on kernel principal component analysis and an improved Harris hawk algorithm to make LSSVM have better performance. This method holds significant implications for real-time monitoring and operational status analysis of power transformers.

articleTitle: Application and Optimization of Machine Learning-Based Ensemble Learning Methods in Sailboat Valuation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the growing sailboat market, accurate valuation of sailboats is crucial for both buyers and sellers. This study proposes an ensemble learning method based on machine learning to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of used sailboat valuation. Through an in-depth analysis of the sailboat dataset, we first conducted data preprocessing, including cleaning missing values and outliers, as well as constructing a database and quantifying indicators. Building on this foundation, we employed three different machine learning algorithms Random Forest, BP Neural Network, and XGBOOST to build individual predictive models. To further improve predictive performance, we adopted an ensemble learning strategy, training a linear regression model as a secondary learner using the predictive results from the aforementioned models. This Stacking approach not only combines the strengths of each base learner but also enhances the overall model's generalization capability by optimizing hyperparameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the integrated and optimized model excels in sailboat valuation tasks, achieving higher accuracy on both training and test sets compared to individual models. Additionally, we explored the impact of regional economic factors on sailboat prices, finding a significant correlation between economic indicators of different regions and sailboat prices.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transformation of Toy Production Line Based on Collaborative Robot Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To support the goals of ‘China Smart Manufacturing 2035’, a toy production line had undergone intelligent transformation. The transformation was based on the characteristics of collaborative robots, the flow and layout of the production line. Combined with the relevant process situation, the process was simplified and merged. Intelligent clamping operation by collaborative robots cooperates with the sealing machine to complete the cartoning and other processes. This paper combines part of the processes and changes the production layout of the assembly line to a ‘U’ type layout. The production capacity of the assembly line had been greatly improved. Before the transformation, the production line required 14 workers to assemble, with a daily output of 1,533. After the transformation, only 2 workers and 1 collaborative robot were required to assemble. The production balance rate was increased from 54.17 % to 94.33 %, resulting in an increase of 40.16 %. Additionally, the cost of single-piece assembly had decreased by 30 %. Through analyzing efficiency, cost, and production balance ratios. It was shown that the toy production line that had been intelligently retrofitted could improve productivity by 114.29% and production balance by 40.16 %. The transformation could also reduce the single piece assembly cost by 30 %. It could better help the enterprise to create economic benefits.

articleTitle: A Study on Momentum Evaluation of Tennis Matches Based on EWM-Topsis Model and LightGBM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of tennis, the existence or otherwise of momentum, a kind of energy that can change the situation, has always been a doubt in people's mind. In order to better reflect the impact caused by momentum in tennis matches, this paper digs deeper into the characteristics of momentum hidden behind the tennis game based on the 2023 Wimbledon match dataset. In this paper, the importance of different indicators in players' momentum is derived by establishing the EWM-Topsis model, then the turning point of players' momentum is extracted by using the CUSUM algorithm, and the fluctuation of the tournament is predicted based on the LightGBM algorithm, and finally the objective planning function for maximizing the momentum is solved by the genetic algorithm, and optimization of the players' strategies is proposed. By predicting the player's momentum changes in the future matches, coaches can adjust the match tactics in time to win the matches.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Battery Liquid Cooling System Based on Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the significant heat generated by high power density batteries in the process of charging and discharging at high current, a design and optimization scheme of battery liquid cooling system based on sliding mode control is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the paper deeply analyzes the important role of the battery thermal management system in ensuring the safety of the battery pack, extending the service life and improving the overall performance, and establishes the effectiveness and superiority of the liquid cooling method. In this study, an efficient and dynamic response liquid battery cooling system was designed. The system uses the fluid cooling medium to directly contact the inside of the battery, and effectively absorbs and takes away a large amount of heat during the battery operation by precisely regulating the flow rate and temperature of the coolant. The core is the introduction of sliding mode control theory, according to the real-time change of battery temperature, dynamically adjust the control strategy of the cooling system, to ensure that the battery temperature is always maintained in the best working range, to prevent overheating phenomenon. In the experimental part, the design process, key parameter selection and simulation verification process of the liquid cooling system based on sliding mode control are described in detail. The results show that compared with the traditional constant cooling strategy, the system has significant advantages in rapid response, temperature stability and energy efficiency. In addition, this study also discusses the problems and challenges that may be encountered in the practical engineering application of the liquid cooling system, puts forward the corresponding solutions, and looks forward to its application prospects in new energy vehicles, energy storage power stations and other fields. In summary, this paper not only provides a new method of battery thermal management, but also provides theoretical basis and technical support for the optimization design of battery liquid cooling system based on sliding mode control, which has important theoretical value and practical significance for promoting the development of China and the global new energy industry.

articleTitle: Research and Application of ARIMA Model and BFGS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the key variables that have an impact on the object of study are initially estimated. Then, the optimal model is derived by calculating the optimal plan through utilizing the BFGS algorithm with the aid of a time series model as well as a poisson distribution model. The employment of the method involving infinitesimals and the cost-effectiveness approach is utilized to analyze the influence on the final results when the significant variables undergo changes. Moreover, the model presented in this paper is stabilized via sensitivity analysis, which facilitates more robust design and decision-making in the presence of uncertainty. This allows for a more stable and reliable model, enabling better decision-making and design in various situations where uncertainty exists.

articleTitle: Research on Art Design Algorithm of ADKGAN Antique Bowl Bottom
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article proposes an ADKGAN (Adaptive bottom layer adversarial generation network) algorithm for simulating the integration of the bottom art information and modern design in a large number of traditional ancient ceramics. Because of inheriting traditional elements, this algorithm provides many modern applications design solutions that are different from traditional ones for the diversity and aesthetics of ceramic substrates. This algorithm mainly consists of two parts: the preprocessing RH module and the ADKGAN two-layer module. In the first stage, the front-end hardware perception system is responsible for sensor data collection and camera data, and uses an improved version of the Yolo network to store and effectively preprocesses and analyzes the data. Then the data enters the second stage ADKGAN algorithm module, which achieves precise shape and effect generation matching of multi style base text through the addition of adaptive modules. The experimental design of this algorithm has been proven to be effective and reliable through practical applications in multiple workshops.

articleTitle: Research on Korla Fragrant Pear Grading Method Based on Random Forest and MLP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In response to the problems of uneven quality and unstable accuracy caused by manual grading in the grading process of Korla pear, a Korla pear grading method based on random forest and MLP is proposed, aiming to further optimize the above problems using machine vision methods. This paper collects left and right views and top views of pear images. Using a combination of K-means clustering and threshold segmentation to achieve background separation; This paper constructs the minimum bounding rectangle for the left and top views of Xiangli to obtain its longitudinal and transverse diameters; Based on the measurement difficulty of pear weight, a pear weight prediction model based on random forest model is constructed using pear diameter parameters; This paper constructs a pear grading model using MLP neural network. The experimental results show that the proposed Korla pear grading method based on random forest and MLP has an accuracy of 99.69% in the training set and 98.75<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> in the test set, verifying the feasibility and accuracy of this method.

articleTitle: Reactive Voltage Optimization of Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic power supply exhibits cost-effectiveness, simplified installation procedures, reduced expenses, independence from terrain limitations, thereby augmenting its share in the distribution network and the massive in scale integration of grid-connected distributed photovoltaic power systems significantly impacts the electrical quality. The model for optimizing voltage of reactive power in a dynamic distribution network, based on the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), is established to address the issue of exceeding the permissible voltage limit caused by distributed photovoltaic power supply connecting to the system. This model takes into consideration the reactive power compensation capability provided by distributed photovoltaic power supply in order to minimize active power loss in the system. This paper firstly analyzes the influence of distributed photovoltaic power on the voltage of distribution network by constructing a simple dynamic distribution network. According to the relationship both active power and reactive power of photovoltaic inverter, it is concluded that the inverter can effectively improve the node voltage, so an inverter control strategy is introduced. Above all, the enhancing productivity of PSO in optimizing wattless-power voltage strategy for active system is validated using the IEEE-33 network. By comparing the data before and after optimization, it can be inferred that this approach demonstrates significant efficacy in mitigating distribution losses and voltage exceeding limits.

articleTitle: BP Neural Network Optimization Considering Computational Resource Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: BP neural networks have a wide range of applications and can cope with a variety of problems. In the past, many scholars have applied neural networks to various problems. However, BP neural networks require a large number of resources for computation during training, which leads to problems such as long computation time when the problem is more complex. In order to solve this problem, this paper limits the number of running iterations of the neural network by considering the condition of limited computational resources. To enhance prediction accuracy, when employing the genetic algorithm for optimizing the BP neural network, the forward propagation process of the neural network is utilized to compute the fitness of each iteration. This approach serves to enhance the optimization efficiency of the algorithm. Experiments show that the IGABP algorithm designed in this paper has a better prediction performance in all three indexes: MSE, MAE and MAPE.

articleTitle: An Instrument Tone Recognition System Based on Artificial Intelligence and Feature Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Instrument tone recognition systems have over time had the highest application value and significance in information retrieval. Notably, the traditional systems and methods often rely on convolutional neural networks (CNN) that serve as fundamental through reportedly, have a poor performance. To this effect, this work seeks to examine a resent artificial intelligence (AI) and a feature recognition system in instrument tone recognition. A proposed model in this case is integrated in an interactive system of humanoid robot. The findings of this study reveal that the proposed resent artificial intelligence (AI) and a feature recognition system in the design of an instrument tone recognition system outperforms the traditional model in terms of recognition accuracy and tonal loss rate. The findings of the research therefore providing methods and ideas that may be used in instrument tonal recognition.

articleTitle: Automatic Configuration Scheme of Network Security Protection Based on Configuration Management Database
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the increasing of network security incidents makes the security operation and maintenance more and more difficult. Aiming at the problems in the process of network security operation and maintenance, such as weak cooperative configuration ability of equipment, non-uniform configuration technical standard, lack of security operation and maintenance personnel, and many repetitive operation and maintenance work, this paper puts forward a solution of automatic configuration of network security protection based on configuration management data base, and develops a configuration system for promoting automatic disposition of network security events. The scheme uses API connection to realize the collection, processing and utilization of asset information, standardizes the technical standards of equipment configuration of each brand, analyzes the relevance of network equipment, excavates the cause of events, and assists to realize automatic configuration. According to the analysis of practical application effect, the scheme shows good expandability and maintainability, which not only improves the running efficiency of the system, but also ensures the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on the Secondary Power Optimization Strategy Based on Virtual Oscillator Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the context of the high proportion of new energy development, grid-forming energy storage technology has been widely studied. However, existing methods have not fully considered the operating costs of heterogeneous energy storage, resulting in lower operational efficiency of the system. Therefore, based on the cost model of heterogeneous energy storage units, this paper comprehensively considers the operating cost of heterogeneous energy storage and establishes an optimized economic model for multiple energy storage power stations. On this basis, a secondary power optimization strategy based on virtual oscillator control is proposed. Simulation experiments show that this strategy can optimize power flow reasonably, effectively reduce the operating cost of the system, thereby extending the service life of energy storage and improving the efficiency of energy storage power plants.

articleTitle: Optimization of Encryption Efficiency for Nutritional Medical Image Data in High Concurrency Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the field of clinical medicine or nutritional medicine, it is usually necessary to encrypt and decrypt a large amount of nutritional medical image data to protect the health privacy of patients. If each encryption and decryption operation takes a long time, the system response speed will decrease, affecting the patient experience. In high concurrency environments, the security of medical image data is crucial. Optimizing the efficiency of encrypted data plays an important role in protecting data security and reducing system load. There are also efficiency issues in image data encryption and decryption. Encryption algorithms add a lot of noise or randomness to images, making image processing faster than traditional symmetric and asymmetric encryption algorithms. This article proposes a Coin algorithm based on Logistic chaotic mapping. This algorithm dynamically generates keys and utilizes the characteristics of chaotic mapping to generate pseudo-random sequences, which are used to generate keys and encrypt messages, solving the security and randomness issues of data. Secondly, this article deploys a highly available, concurrent, and high-performance system to improve server performance. The experimental results show that compared with traditional logic algorithms, the throughput per second is reduced by 4.8 times, the average decryption time is increased by 67 milliseconds, the retrieval efficiency is improved, and the key space is larger.

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis and Simulation of Four-degree-of-freedom Serial Sampling Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In experiments, it is often necessary to use a mechanical arm to complete the sampling work. However, the traditional mechanical arm usually has only two to three degrees of freedom, which has the disadvantages of poor flexibility and weak space obstacle avoidance, and it is difficult to accurately complete the sampling of experiment samples. In view of the above problems, a four-degree-of-freedom series sampling mechanical arm is designed in this paper, which is composed of three joint steering gears and an end-effector for mobile motion. The kinematics model of the sampling manipulator is established by Denvit-Hartenberg (D-H) method, and its forward motion and inverse motion are analyzed to determine the relationship between the joint variables and the end sampling actuator of the manipulator. Secondly, the correctness of the forward and inverse kinematics equations is verified by using the MATLAB robot toolbox. Finally, the Monte Carlo method is used to simulate the workspace of the manipulator to verify the rationality of the structural design of the manipulator. The analysis results indicate that the manipulator can satisfy the requirements of experiment reagent sampling, and plays an important role in ensuring personal safety and reducing labor intensity. It provides a kinematic model and theoretical basis for trajectory planning and motion control of the sampling manipulator.

articleTitle: Predicting and Analyzing Match Fluctuations Based on Random Forest Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper investigates the prediction of match fluctuations using the Random Forest Regression algorithm. To explore indicators for predicting match fluctuations, we first conduct feature engineering. Through Spearman correlation analysis and mutual information methods, we establish 12 feature indicators and 1 target variable to evaluate match fluctuations. Subsequently, we build the TMSP (Tennis Match Situation Prediction) model based on the Random Forest Regression algorithm. After model training and testing, the model's Mean Squared Error (MSE) and R-squared are found to be 8.15 and 0.90, respectively, indicating a high prediction accuracy. Furthermore, the model intuitively displays the predicted values and actual values for multiple matches. We also provide player recommendations based on the varying degrees of correlation among features.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of Competition Fluctuations Based on LSTM Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis and prediction of competition fluctuations using a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network. The study begins by establishing a comprehensive evaluation scoring model. Data processing results from feature extraction yield 10 features, which are clustered into service indicators, score indicators, and error indicators for the purpose of establishing an evaluation model. The features undergo KMO and Bartlett tests, demonstrating their suitability for factor analysis. The extraction of common factors employs principal component analysis with varimax rotation, and subsequently weighted using entropy weighting to construct a comprehensive scoring model. Subsequently, a “fluctuation” prediction model is developed, with “momentum” as the dependent variable and the 10 extracted features as independent variables, using an LSTM prediction model. The predictive results are promising. Sensitivity analysis involving a 5% perturbation of each factor reveals that perturbations in the leading game rounds have the most significant impact on the predictive results. Recommendations for players' gaming strategies are provided based on sensitivity analysis and a correlation-based ranking of factors, derived from relevant literature.

articleTitle: Research on Open Architecture Security Evaluation and Optimization Strategy for 5G Network Functions Based on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As 5G technology enters a new era, network security issues are becoming increasingly prominent, especially in the open architecture of network capabilities. This paper discusses open architecture security evaluation and optimization strategy for 5G network functions based on fuzzy logic. First, the fundamental theories of fuzzy logic and 5G network security are introduced. Second, the application of fuzzy logic in the open architecture of 5G network capability and the role of fuzzy neural networks in security evaluation are analyzed. Furthermore, this paper studies the application of principal component analysis in fuzzy decision trees. Through the analysis of numerical examples using fuzzy logic, we will discuss the security identification method based on fuzzy neural network, the influence of the value range of fuzzy logic on the security evaluation of the sample library, the influence of various fuzzy rules on the security evaluation result, the security optimization of fuzzy neural network. In the last part, we propose an open architecture security evaluation and optimization strategy for 5G network functions. In summary, strengthening the application of fuzzy logic in network security evaluation and optimization can provide strong support for the high-quality development of 5G networks.
