articleTitle: Competition Score Prediction and Analysis Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study delves into the elusive yet palpable concept of momentum within professional tennis matches. Through rigorous statistical analysis, including correlation and regression techniques, a robust correlation (Pearson's r = 0.8274) was established between the momentum score (MS) and the likelihood of winning subsequent points. Visualization of match flow was achieved through a combination of stream graphs and scatter plots, offering a comprehensive display of the normalized MS. Addressing skepticism about momentum's influence, the relationship between momentum and sequences of consecutive success within a match was explored, revealing a substantial average correlation (0.7877) across all players. Moreover, factors precipitating shifts in match dynamics were investigated, highlighting key predictors of momentum changes using advanced machine learning algorithms. This study solidifies the significance of momentum in shaping match outcomes and offers a novel approach to quantifying and visualizing this critical determinant of success in professional tennis.

articleTitle: Dynamic Resource Allocation Strategy Based on K-Means
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to improve the utilization and user experience of large cloud computing center resources in the mobile edge computing (MEC) environment, a dynamic computing resource and spectrum resource allocation algorithm (KDSAA) based on the K-means algorithm is proposed. The algorithm analyzes the current status of the traditional average resource allocation method and virtual machine allocation method, studies the user's comprehensive needs, simulates resources as “fluid”, uses an auction algorithm to allocate, and the optimal values of edge cloud throughput and transmission delay are linearly solved. Experimental simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively improve edge cloud throughput and reduce transmission delay.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Assessment and Forecasting of Express Service Based on TOPSIS and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and the e-commerce market, online shopping has become an important part of daily life, and accurate prediction of the demand for courier services is crucial for courier companies to optimize their warehouses and transportation networks. In this paper, a comprehensive model of evaluation, prediction, and optimization is constructed for express demand and transportation problems. Firstly, the important cities were screened out by preprocessing the data and analyzing them in four dimensions: the receiving volume, the shipping volume, the trend of changes in the number of expresses and the correlation with other cities, calculating the weights of the indicators using the entropy method, and conducting a comprehensive evaluation using the TOPSIS method. Secondly, the time-series changes of express delivery volume were counted, and the identification of periodicity was optimized by establishing the SARIMA model, which improved the prediction accuracy of the model, and the value of R ²reached 0.86. Finally, the LSTM neural network was successfully used to predict the route cargo volume. This study provides an effective data analysis and forecasting tool for the express service industry.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence-Based Computer Vision and Speech Recognition in Intelligent Automation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the use of SIFT algorithm for visual feature extraction, and innovatively deeply integrates visual information with voice commands to enable accurate control of intelligent automation systems. Firstly, the robustness and efficiency of SIFT algorithm in complex environment is deeply discussed, and it is applied to target object recognition, scene understanding and other visual tasks to effectively extract key visual features. Further, the audio-visual fusion model is researched and constructed, and the visual features extracted by SIFT algorithm are cleverly integrated with the voice commands processed by advanced speech recognition technology. The synchronous analysis and collaborative decision-making of dual-mode information are realized through artificial intelligence means such as deep learning. The purpose of this model is to improve the comprehensive understanding and response ability of the automated system to multiple and heterogeneous input data, so as to ensure that it can accurately identify user intentions and perform accurate operations in complex environments. Experimental results show that this strategy can significantly improve the environment adaptability, interaction naturalness and task completion accuracy of the intelligent automation system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Tracking System for Hearing-Impaired Athletes Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, deformation correction, feature extraction, image filtering, particle manipulation and other steps are used to achieve the relative positioning between the objects. The visually-assisted image processing process is implanted into the virtual instrument to achieve real-time location and tracking of moving objects. It can help the hearing-impaired communicate from sign language to emotional speech. The system includes gesture recognition, expression emotion calculation, speech emotion synthesis and other modules. And it can carry out sign language synchronous transmission, two-way interaction, emotional expression. The test results show that in the space of 1.2 m*1.2 m, the positioning accuracy achieved by this algorithm is about 1 cm, and the root-mean-square error is 0.3 cm, The system can easily transform gesture language into emotional language. This system can make the hearing-impaired people and healthy people have more direct communication. Therefore, the translation of sign language by deaf athletes is no longer just to maintain a neutral tone, but to add more emotions.

articleTitle: The Research of BIM Model Structure and Integration System of Building Electromechanical System Improved by Automatic Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The automatic extraction of the logical relationship between construction machinery and electrical equipment is an important technical core of BIM from construction to operation. This project aims to solve the problems of incorrect physical connection between equipment and pipeline in BIM model, and it is difficult to automatically extract logical association of equipment, and research a new idea of automatic repair and efficiency optimization of physical association between equipment and pipeline for construction site. Three types of problems such as breakpoint, misalignment and wrong direction in cross-document are precisely defined. Then this paper studies the efficiency of mechanical and electrical integration automation repair, and realizes the batch extraction of BIM modeling and the efficient automatic extraction of information association. The research results of this project will provide technical support for the transformation of building BIM model to operation model. The research theory is helpful to promote the operation and maintenance management of electromechanical equipment based on BIM.

articleTitle: Stock Prediction Under GRU, LSTM and GNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The stock market is not only a stage for investors to grow their wealth, but also an important indicator of a country's economic health and development. Deep learning techniques offer new possibilities for accurate stock market trend forecasting. The purpose of this paper is to explore the application of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM), and Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) in stock market forecasting. By comparatively analyzing their performance, this paper aims to reveal which algorithm better captures complex fluctuations in the stock market. This paper shows that the gated recurrent unit (GRU) model exhibits superior performance compared to the LSTM and the RNN in the long-term stock price prediction task. In addition, it was found that in comparison experiments conducted with 100 and 500 training cycles, the LSTM model showed a significant performance degradation after 500 training cycles, revealing its potential shortcomings in handling long-term training tasks. These findings have important implications for understanding the adaptability and efficacy of various types of recurrent neural networks in complex prediction tasks.

articleTitle: Optimization and Energy Conservation of Heating Systems Based on Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of urbanization in China, urban construction has been paid more and more attention, especially the problem of heating. The research on heating system from the aspects of big data and artificial intelligence has become a hot spot. This paper briefly describes the current optimal control system of heating energy saving, and discusses the optimization and energy saving of heating system based on big data and artificial intelligence. The key factors affecting the energy saving of heating system are optimized by RF (random forest) algorithm, and the heating load is predicted to achieve the purpose of energy saving and emission reduction. The results showed that in the prediction model, the RF (random forest) algorithm had a significant effect on the load prediction model of the heating system. The results showed that the input-output model established using the RF algorithm had higher output and better predictive performance than ordinary models (the error of the load prediction model based on the RF algorithm was between 0 and 4GW.h, which was much smaller than the ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Model) algorithm for load prediction.

Author Keywords: Heating System Optimization and Energy Conservation

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Large-Scale Centralized Access to Power Grid of New Energy Based on PSASP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Heilongjiang Province's good ecological environment and land resources provide space and carrying capacity for the development of new energy, with the goal and vision of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” proposed, based on the development status of Heilongjiang power grid, there is a scenario of new energy access to weak AC power grid in some areas. This article is based on power system analysis synthesis program, taking a new energy source in Heilongjiang as an example. It is of great significance to analyze the stability of the power system caused by the “centralized development and collection and transmission” of new energy by means of short-circuit ratio and stability calculation, which is of great significance to guide the grid connection and operation of new energy.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Model of Audience Viewing Behavior of New Media Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to deeply explore and build a new media audience viewing behavior prediction model based on big data technology. With the rapid development of information technology, the audience's viewing behavior in the new media environment is increasingly complex and changeable, which poses new challenges to the traditional audience rating analysis and prediction methods. Based on big data, this paper collects, integrates and mining massive user behavior data on new media platforms of radio and television, including multi-dimensional information such as viewing time, content selection and interactive comments, to explore the audience's viewing behavior pattern and its influencing factors. First of all, the paper introduces the application background of big data in the media field and the characteristics of the audience's viewing behavior in the new media of radio and television in detail, and systematically combs and evaluates the existing viewing behavior prediction models. Then, combining machine learning and deep learning theories, a big data-driven prediction model combining time series analysis and neural network algorithm is designed and implemented, in order to more accurately capture and predict the audience's personalized viewing needs and dynamic trends. The experimental results show that the model can not only effectively improve the accuracy of the prediction of viewing behavior, but also provide in-depth insight into the influence of different program types, time periods, social hot spots and other factors on the audience's viewing choice, so as to provide scientific basis for the planning, arrangement and promotion of radio and television programs, and further promote the transformation of radio and television media from traditional content production to precision and intelligent services. Finally, this paper discusses the practical application effect and optimization direction of the model, and looks forward to the broad application prospects of big data in the future development of new media of radio and television.

articleTitle: Research on Heartbeat Temporal Signal Recognition Based on Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The rapid development of AI technologies, such as machine learning and deep learning, has provided new directions for medical research. With extensive data mining and learning, AI has demonstrated strong potential in tasks like heartbeat signal recognition and image diagnosis. This study utilizes real heartbeat signal samples from hundreds of thousands of instances to research heartbeat signal prediction using various machine learning and deep learning algorithms, including LightGBM, XGBoost, and CNNs. The results indicate that two CNN models, CNN_1 and CNN_2, achieved accuracies of 99.10% and 99.21% on the test set, significantly outperforming XGBoost's 98.79% and LightGBM's 98.97%. Through further data optimization and model fusion, under a weighted average fusion strategy, the evaluation metric for the CNN models was improved to a maximum of 99.53%. The experimental results of this paper provide data support and a feasible solution path for the auxiliary diagnosis of medical big data.

articleTitle: A Wide Coupling Range UAV WPT System Based on Voltage Regulation and Phase Shift Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wireless power transmission (WPT) technology is a new charging technology and has been widely used. Aiming at the problem that the output power of UAV WPT system is easily affected by offset, a control strategy based on voltage regulation and phase shift is proposed in this paper. The output voltage is dynamically adjusted by adjusting the input voltage and the phase shift angle in layers, so that the output voltage can keep stable transmission. The control strategy based on voltage regulation and phase shift is described in detail. The input voltage detection circuit and the input voltage switching circuit are given. The concrete method of phase shift control is given. The output voltage is further controlled by PI phase shift angle to achieve the purpose of phase shift control. Simulink simulation model is established to simulate the deviation of UAV WPT system. The feasibility of the control strategy based on voltage regulation and phase shift is proved by the two-stage switching of input voltage at 80V and 130V combined with phase shift control.

articleTitle: Research on Laser Divergence Angle Measurement Method in Free Space for Large Optical Beam
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a semiconductor laser power measurement circuit for specific wavelength and emission angle. The design encompasses three main components: a free-space optical power meter positioning device, an optical power meter, and a power supply and communication device for the optical power meter. Grounded in the principles of free-space optical measurement, this method combines measurement techniques with instrumentation to quantify the laser power at a specific wavelength and spatial position. Leveraging a microcontroller-based signal processing system, it assesses performance metrics such as laser divergence angle, uniformity, and power. The proposed optical power measurement device is characterized by its user-friendly operation, high level of visualization, and structural reliability, making it a valuable tool in the field of optical measurement instruments.

articleTitle: A Forest Harmful Plant Goldenrod Detection Method Based on Enhanced YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The challenge of removing detrimental forest weeds like goldenrods remains unresolved, with weed detection playing a pivotal role in solving this issue. Factors such as irregular light distribution in wooded areas and the variety of weed characteristics frequently result in reduced precision during weed detection. To address these issues, this paper proposes a deep learning weed detection algorithm based on enhanced YOLOv5. Specifically, more accurate anchor boxes are obtained using the latest clustering algorithm K-means||, the location error of bounding boxes is reduced by improving the SIoU loss function, and the model's anti-interference capability is enhanced by incorporating the squeeze-and-excitation network (SENet) mechanism in the data preprocessing stage. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm outperforms the original YOLOv5 algorithm with an increase of 10.1%, 12.8%, and 11.2% in mean average precision (mAP), precision, and recall, respectively. Moreover, the utilization of the enhanced algorithm in weed detection within the project's demonstration forest yielded a detection accuracy of 99%, validating the effectiveness and superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Camera Pan-Tilt System for Underwater Detection Robot Based on Dual-Axis Motion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the key role of camera robot in underwater exploration is discussed, and a two-axis motion frame system is designed. The core of the system is its highly integrated hardware architecture and intelligent software algorithms, aiming to improve the efficiency and quality of underwater image acquisition. In the aspect of hardware design, the STM32 microcontroller with high performance is selected as the Brain Center, which is responsible for the unified scheduling of various functional modules. CMOS industrial camera serves as image acquisition unit, its excellent low-light performance and rapid response to ensure that the underwater environment, clear and stable image acquisition. With the introduction of stepping motor, the translation and tilt of the camera platform can be controlled accurately, so that the camera can rotate flexibly in the horizontal and vertical directions to meet different detection requirements. In order to ensure the stable operation of the system under extreme underwater conditions, the optimization of PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom-RRB-control circuit and the integration of temperature and humidity sensors are especially emphasized in hardware circuit design, these measures effectively guarantee the reliability of the equipment. At the same time, the intelligent control mechanism of output power also ensures the efficient use of energy. In the structural design, all the joints are equipped with precision seals to prevent seawater intrusion, further enhancing the waterproof performance of the equipment. On the software level, the system adopts the advanced orthogonal iteration algorithm to optimize the image acquisition process. This algorithm can adjust camera parameters through iterative calculation in complex underwater environment, so as to achieve the best image stabilization effect. The experimental results show that the camera robot works well in the turbulent region, and has many advantages such as multi-angle rotation, precise positioning and real-time transmission. In addition, its compact structure, high reliability and high protection accuracy make it an ideal tool in the field of underwater exploration.

articleTitle: Analysis on Simulation Dynamic Process of Power Regulation of Large Water Turbine Generator Set
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of the Times, especially in recent years, the electric power grid capacity continues to increase, and the capacity of thermal power and hydroelectric generating units continue to break through. The active power generated by the generator set is directly connected to the power grid after being boosted by the booster transformer. The power mutation and normal power regulation of the generator set directly affect the safe and stable operation of the power grid. It is of great significance to study the dynamic process of electric power regulation of large generating units to ensure the stability of the units themselves and the power grid. In this paper, a power regulation model was established by taking a unit of Pubugou Hydropower Station (single capacity 600MW) as an example, and the simulation model algorithm optimization was carried out. Finally, based on relevant parameters, the example analysis and simulation were carried out in SIMULINK to show the dynamic process of power regulation of a large hydropower group, and the conclusion was drawn.

articleTitle: Research on Purely Azimuthal Passive Localization of Drone Clusters Based on Triangulation Intersection Model and Random Deviation Experiment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents a study on the precise positioning of a drone cluster using the Triangulation Intersection Model and Random Deviation Experiment. Initially, a mathematical model is constructed to accurately locate drones with deviations, utilizing three known non-deviated signal-emitting drones as well as other drones as passive receivers. By applying the methods of Triangulation and Triangulation of Three Circles, the mathematical model determines the coordinates of the drones to be located based on the received angle and distance information from the signal-emitting drones. Furthermore, the study evaluates the effectiveness of the positioning approach under the assumption of a specified deviation range.

Author Keywords: Precise positioning of a drone cluster

articleTitle: Research on Remote Monitoring Model of Livestock Health Based on Computer Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A livestock individual status information acquisition device is established and integrated with a visual virtual simulation application. The serial port transmission completes the work of transmitting to the MT7688 system. In this paper, a wireless LAN based on 4 GEC204G is proposed, which realizes real-time transmission to 4G network by Socket. The identification of animals is obtained through personal identification of animal images on the cloud platform. The animal ID was obtained from the image data through the individual recognition model, and the health indicator information was evaluated to obtain the health status of the livestock. VGGNet-16 and ResNet-50 are used to learn ImageNet respectively, and then they are adjusted according to the selected samples, and finally the model is fused by means method. Remote access to the database was obtained with the authorization of the user account and password. The data collected by the sensor is viewed and analyzed and processed on the client page. This study provides a useful basis for regulating the feeding environment, monitoring the movement state and health status of livestock.

articleTitle: Research on Road Pothole Recognition Based on AlexNet Modeling and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this thesis, for the problem of road pothole recognition, based on image processing and deep learning ideas, a picture recognition model is established by determining the pixel value, RGB color pattern, image texture and other indexes with the objectives of accuracy, recall, precision and F1 score. Considering the limitations of traditional image recognition techniques in terms of classification accuracy and processing speed, this paper firstly carries out image feature extraction by AlexNet model and preprocesses the original 301 images. Not only the extraction of features, but also the visualization of feature extraction is realized. Considering the influence of different pixel versions and different recognition models on classification accuracy, the training set and test set are constructed according to different pixel versions, and then the BP neural network and XGBoost model are used for training. After the model training, the model performance is evaluated using the evaluation indexes such as accuracy, recall, precision and F1 score, and it is found that the model with 440x440 pixels outperforms that with 330x330 pixels, and the model with BP neural network outperforms that with XGBoost. After comparing the accuracy, the pixels of 440x440 are selected in the present study, and the training model using BP neural network is used for the classification prediction. The model achieves 99.0% accuracy on the test set.

articleTitle: Research on Mental Health Problem Identification Algorithm of College Students
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the gradual acceleration of the social rhythm, anxiety and depression have appeared in college students, which have aroused wide attention from schools and society. How to find college students' mental health problems in time and take preventive or intervention measures in time has become a hot issue in current research. Traditional mental health problem identification is mainly carried out by questionnaire survey, which is less efficient and less reliable. Therefore, this paper uses multi-source data to explore a neural network algorithm for college students' recognition, which improves the recognition effect of college students' mental health problems. Through feature extraction and convolutional neural network, different types of college students' behavior data are analyzed, training sets are established, and a variety of classification algorithms are used for verification and evaluation. The results show that the identification effect can be improved by analyzing various behavior data of students. The research of this paper can better understanding, facilitate the timely help and targeted intervention of college students, and avoid the further deterioration of college students' mental health.

articleTitle: Research and Verification of Motion System on EtherNet/IP Carried by 5G Non-Public Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the context of the booming development of mobile communication technology, the 5G network is deeply integrated with various vertical industries. In order to solve problems such as large transmission latency, low speed, small coverage area, poor flexibility, and data privacy risks in traditional communication methods, technologies such as 5G Non-public Network and 5G LAN-type service proposed by 3GPP are actively promoted and applied. However, the depth of 5G application in the industrial field remains to be expanded, and further research is needed on its level of PLC motion control. Therefore, this paper takes EtherNet/IP as an example and designs a network transmission scheme for carrying the motion system on EtherNet/IP over a 5G SNPN from the perspectives of clock synchronization and CIP message transmission. In this paper, a real network environment is constructed using this network scheme, in which the 5G SNPN carries motion system on EtherNet/IP. It explores the differences between 5G networks and traditional wired networks in actual transmission, providing a reference for the future 5G-enabled PLC control field.

articleTitle: Research on Geomagnetic Data Fusion and Prediction Project Based on GPS and IMU and Complementary Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper introduces a first-order complementary filtering algorithm, which is used to fuse the data of an inertial measurement unit (IMU), global positioning system (GPS), and magnetometer to improve intelligent vehicles' positioning and navigation accuracy. It takes advantage of the high frequency of the IMU and the high precision of the GPS to combine the three types of data through complementary filtering algorithms. At the same time, IMU drift and GPS noise are compensated and corrected. This study used a smart car platform to collect IMU, GPS, and magnetometer data, and the positioning effect of IMU or GPS was compared. The experimental results show that the complementary filtering algorithm can effectively improve the positioning accuracy of smart cars and reduce positioning error, which is suitable for complex road environments.

articleTitle: A Study on Tennis Ball Momentum Prediction Based on Backpropagation Neural Network and Grey Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Within the realm of sports competition, “momentum” may decisively influence the outcome of a game. Therefore, this study explores and examines “momentum” by utilizing real game datasets. First, this paper constructs a model based on the cumulative score density during a match to capture the dynamics of the match. Second, in the calculation of cumulative momentum, the “inner area method” is innovatively adopted to mitigate the effects of unstable momentum fluctuations. Finally, gray relational analysis (GRA), wavelet analysis, and backpropagation neural network (BPNN) models are used to model and correlate the momentum prediction in tennis. The final experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has strong validity and reliability.

articleTitle: Production Management System for Water Pump Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the realm of industrial production, an efficient, intelligent, flexible, and reliable production management system is paramount. This article delves deeply into the application of such a system in a water pump factory, aiming to simplify management and production processes in the water pump manufacturing industry. The system offers a comprehensive solution by integrating functions such as inventory control, quality assurance, and automatic scheduling. By automating and optimizing these processes, the system enhances production efficiency, reduces costs, and improves overall productivity. The paper also discusses the design and implementation of the system, highlighting its significance and practical effects in the water pump manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Audit Software Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: According to the needs of auditing work, efforts are made to develop suitable computer-aided auditing software to gradually change or enhance traditional auditing techniques and methods, which can better play the role of audit supervision. The purpose of this paper is to study the design and optimisation of computer-aided audit software based on fuzzy clustering algorithms. By analysing the technical difficulties of computer-aided auditing, this paper proposes the design concept of the project software. The improved fuzzy C-mean clustering algorithm DFCM and the fast audit steps of the project based on improved fuzzy clustering are specifically introduced, and the data processing methods of the system are described in detail, and the specific application of the project software is also presented. The experimental results show that the computer-aided audit software in this paper can be applied to calculate the audit price of the project to be audited and the software is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Individual Recognition of Psychological Crisis Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The common psychological problems of college students mainly include environmental stress, self-cognition disorder, interpersonal relationship disorder and emotional instability, which seriously affect their own study, life and personal safety, and have attracted wide attention from school and society. In particular, college students with psychological crisis have a higher risk of mental illness and may have serious psychological disorders. The traditional mental health detection method mainly uses psychological scale to identify college students' psychological crisis individuals, which leads to a high misidentification rate to some extent. The appearance of CNNs has greatly improved the performance of natural language processing, and is widely used in machine translation, image recognition, and speech recognition. Therefore, the method of individual identification of psychological crisis based on graph neural network is used to identify individual psychological crisis of college students by preprocessing the data of psychological questionnaire and using the relationship information among students. Experiments show that the recognition accuracy of GCN based method is better than that of mental scale and other machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Neural Architecture Search Based on Simple and Parameter-Free Attention for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Recently, neural architecture search (NAS) methods have demonstrated remarkable results in hyperspectral image (HSI) classification. However, deep network structures often require consideration of model overfitting, and highly similar spatial-spectral features make HSI inefficient feature description. To tackle this issue, we propose a NAS method based on a simple and parameter-free (Sim) attention module (SimAM), called SAM-NAS, to effectively enhance classification accuracy by leveraging spatial-spectral details. To be more precise, SAM-NAS utilizes the SimAM to highlight the linear divisibility of each pixel in HSI along the spatial-spectral dimensions, highlighting the validity of sensitive pixels. SimAM can add attention weights to HSI three-dimensional datas simultaneously while allowing the module to maintain a lightweight attribute. Then, the weighted spatial-spectral features are fed into the NAS to obtain the final neural network classification model. Our suggested method shows encouraging outcomes in classification by examining two genuine HSI datasets.

articleTitle: Prediction and Modeling of Reservoir Properties in Ultra-Low Permeability Reservoirs with Edge and Bottom Water Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The reservoir properties of reservoirs in edge and bottom water reservoirs have complex and nonlinear characteristics, and traditional prediction methods have low accuracy and cannot accurately predict them. This study adopted a CNN algorithm based method for predicting the reservoir properties of reservoirs in edge and bottom water reservoirs. Firstly, a large amount of reservoir data was collected and prepared, including physical properties and geological features. Then, CNN models were used for feature learning and predictive modeling. The model performed deep learning and feature extraction on the data through convolutional and pooling layers, and predicted attributes through fully connected layers. The experimental results showed that the prediction accuracy range of CNN was 95%-99%. The prediction model has achieved significant results in predicting reservoir properties in reservoirs with edge and bottom water. It can accurately predict reservoir properties and achieve lower error rates in both positive and negative class predictions.

Author Keywords: Prediction of Reservoir Properties in Permeability Reservoirs

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanical Properties of Axles Based on Neural Networks and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology, many advanced algorithms and technologies are continuously being researched and applied more extensively in engineering design. This paper focuses on the mechanical properties of axles, first establishing a neural network model to simplify the stress conditions of the axle and identify critical sections. Subsequently, a particle swarm optimization model is developed to optimize the parameters of the neural network model, enhancing its accuracy. Finally, based on strength requirements and combining the neural network model, axle performance is designed, resulting in a reasonable axle performance solution obtained through comparative analysis, along with calculation of deflection at the gear shaft. By applying intelligent algorithms, a more accurate basis for transmission shaft design can be provided.

articleTitle: Compositional Study of Ancient Glassware Based on K-Mean Cluster Analysis and Logistic Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the in-depth research on the chemical composition analysis and identification of ancient Chinese glass artifacts, and statistically analyzes and classifies and predicts the compositions of ancient glass artifacts using K-means cluster analysis and logistic regression algorithm. Firstly, some invalid data were excluded through data preprocessing, and the missing values were appropriately processed. In the analysis of the relationship between chemical composition and glass properties, the chi-square test was applied to find that there were significant differences between glass type and color and surface weathering. Secondly, by eliminating the SiO2 composition, which had a considerable influence on the clustering results, K-means cluster analysis was used to classify the subclasses of high-potassium and lead-barium glasses, and the reasonableness and sensitivity of the classification results were verified. Finally, the logistic regression algorithm was used to predict the type of unclassified glass artifacts, while the correlation between important chemical components and other components was explored by gray correlation analysis, which provided a new method and perspective for the compositional analysis and identification of ancient glass artifacts.

articleTitle: A Large Model of Medical Neurosurgery Diagnosis and Dreatment Dialogue
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of artificial intelligence in the field of medicine, large-scale neural surgical models have emerged as a novel approach to addressing neurosurgical issues. This study aims to construct a model that can provide support for neurosurgeons to improve the accuracy and efficiency of clinical decision-making. We first collected neurosurgical data from multiple sources and performed necessary preprocessing, including data cleaning and feature extraction. Subsequently, we selected a pretrained model and conducted pretraining on neurosurgical data to establish the model's foundational knowledge. Then, through fine-tuning tasks, we optimized the model to adapt to specific medical needs. Experimental results demonstrate that our model exhibits good performance in addressing neurosurgical problems and is competitive compared to other methods. The large-scale neural surgical model proposed in this study provides a new support tool for medical decision-making, offering valuable insights for future clinical practice and research.

articleTitle: Optimization Scheduling Method for Electric Vehicle Charging and Swapping Stations Based on Elastic Load Regulation Potential
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the issues of charging load scheduling and economic operation of charging and swapping stations, a method for optimizing the scheduling of electric vehicle charging and swapping stations based on the evaluation of elastic load regulation potential is proposed. A boundary analysis model for electric vehicle charging regulation capacity is established to evaluate the charging load regulation potential of charging and swapping stations. On this basis, considering reducing the peak valley difference, a hierarchical optimization scheduling model for charging and swapping power stations is established to ensure reasonable, fast, and accurate service for EVs and power systems. We analyze the effectiveness and economy of charging and swapping power stations participating in V2G to improve the power characteristics of new distribution networks through a 33 node example.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Financial Institution Customer Identity Verification Systems Based on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Over the recent years, fraudulent activities in financial institutions have increased in China; according to criminals, there are several approaches to deceiving their users. This article focuses on applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning in customer identity verification, a move driven towards recognizing and addressing the increasing bank fraud cases. The research introduces novel machine learning systems and models designed to determine fraudulent banking transactions. Various methods for enhancing detection accuracy are described. An artificial neural network-based model is proposed to enhance the system's efficiency and accuracy in identifying unauthorized transactions. The outcomes of variedly designed algorithms are, in this case, presented, typifying the impact of the logistic regression algorithm in enhancing the performance of the system, while stacked generalization demonstrates a higher AUC at 0.954. Recognizing bank fraud using artificial intelligence algorithms remains a significant concern in today's digital society.

articleTitle: Research on Short-Circuit Transient Process Algorithm Analysis and Simulation of Large Water Turbine Generator Set
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric power industry, the capacity of hydroelectric power generation group is increasing. The digital simulation of the electric power system has become the main tool for the design, planning, operation and research of the electric power system. The corresponding decisions are based on the results of digital simulation. In this paper, the hydropower generation group of Yangfanggou large hydropower station (installed capacity of 1500MW) is taken as the model. Firstly, the development of current digital simulation tools is introduced. In combination with M-file programming of Matlab language and SIMULINK platform simulation, the implicit ladder method and Newton-Raphson method under numerical calculation method are introduced in detail. It is replaced by algebraic equation and linear equation respectively to be calculated. Finally, the transient process of sudden short circuit of large generator is selected for simulation analysis, which provides data support for safe and stable operation and fault analysis of equipment.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Frequency Feature Extraction with GMPSO-VMD Algorithm Based on Information Entropy Assignment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Rolling bearings are commonly used in all types of machinery. However, bearing fault diagnosis and even early warning are essential in the industry. This paper aims to propose an algorithm based on the information entropy assignment of genetic mutation particle swarm optimisation variational mode decomposition (GMPSO-VMD) algorithm, which can improve the bearing fault feature extraction accuracy and reduce the noise in the fault features. The minimum entropy value is a good measure of the effect of decomposition by the variational modal decomposition (VMD). Moreover, the information entropy of each intrinsic modal component decomposed by the VMD is used to assign weights, and the envelope spectrum is used to extract its fault eigenfrequency. Finally, the GMPSO-VMD algorithm from information entropy optimisation is used to analyse the bearing fault characteristics of the CRWU rolling bearing fault signal dataset respectively. The effectiveness of the GMPSO-VMD algorithm was verified by utilizing the CRWU dataset.

articleTitle: Tennis Momentum Study Based on Spearman Correlation Analysis and Random Forest Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study delves into predicting the probability of winning in tennis matches, employing a Random Forest Model to forecast players' win probabilities at specific moments. Initially, an analysis of data from Wimbledon 2023 Gentlemen's singles matches post-second round estimated players' evaluation and momentum scores. The model demonstrated a significant predictive accuracy of 95.24% using matches as the predictive unit and was further generalized and optimized by incorporating data from various competitions and sports. The study also developed an evaluation system based on secondary indicators like “ACE” through Factor Analysis, optimized considering the server's advantage in tennis. Additionally, data on net goals and players' psychological states were analyzed to assess the impact on match outcomes, with the findings refuting common skepticism. The random forest model, tested across different units of analysis, showed high practicality and effectiveness in guiding players' preparations and strategies. The model's applicability was further validated through data from the Australian Open women's singles and World Men's Volleyball League matches, achieving accuracy rates of 73<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and 77%, respectively, indicating good transferability and generalizability. The study concludes with recommendations for tennis coaches, based on the insights gained.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Image Recognition Method Based on Decision Fusion and Optimization Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Classical algorithms in data mining have been widely studied and applied in industrial equipment condition monitoring. However, the traditional deep learning models are not yet accurate in identifying the bearing status, and most of them rely on manual experience for identification, which leads to certain errors. This study proposes a hyperparameter optimization method using a swarm optimization algorithm for CNN architecture. At the beginning, the primary vibration signal is converted into a two-dimensional time-frequency map to construct a dataset. Second, the network noise immunity is tested and the optimal network framework is determined. Then, the parameter search is optimized using the swarm optimization algorithm and the fitness function is designed. Finally, the interpretability and stability of the network are improved by visualization and decision fusion. After the verification of Case Western Reserve University bearing dataset, the method introduced in this research paper displays noteworthy accuracy in fault diagnosis and holds substantial significance for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Building a Southeast Asian Automotive Industry Data Platform Based on HDFS + Spark
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to have a real-time and accurate understanding of the development status of the Southeast Asian automotive market, this paper proposes the construction of a Southeast Asian automotive industry data platform based on HDFS+Spark. Firstly, the heterogeneous data from multiple sources is standardized and input into a NoSQL database. Then, the system architecture based on SPARK real-time computing is introduced, with a focus on analyzing the processing models adopted by SPARK in different application scenarios. Next, the operational rules of HDFS in data storage are analyzed. Finally, the constructed data platform system is tested, and the test results indicate that the system scheme performs excellently in terms of throughput, concurrency, and other performance aspects. Therefore, the proposed data platform system scheme provides an effective solution and support for the development of the Southeast Asian automotive industry.

articleTitle: Research on Internet of Vehicles Communication Scheme Combining SM9 Algorithm and V2X PKI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As the number and frequency of interactions between vehicles and the external environment increase, the security threats faced by vehicles have become more numerous and destructive in the context of the Internet of vehicles (IoV). Ensuring the security of entities and the confidentiality of interaction information has become increasingly important. The traditional Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) system uses digital certificates issued by Certificate Authorities for secure authentication, which has drawbacks such as high costs and certificate management difficulties. The SM9 algorithm has emerged as an effective solution to address these challenges. This study proposes an communication scheme that combines PKI with the SM9 algorithm, optimizing the weaknesses in the traditional PKI system, such as inadequate encryption strength and high pseudonymous certificate storage consumption. This contribution plays a significant role in upgrading the traditional PKI system and expanding the application scope of the SM9 algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Human Resource Management and Prediction Model Based on Neural Network Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper investigates the application of artificial neural networks optimized based on genetic algorithms in human resource management in hospital enterprises and constructs a human resource management and predictive analysis model. The model aims to support enterprises in achieving the optimal allocation of human resources by mining their internal human resource data and revealing the intrinsic correlation between personnel structure, business type and future development strategy. The study adopts multiple regression analysis method and combines the artificial neural network optimized by genetic algorithm to construct a human resource demand prediction model. Taking the operational data of Hospital X as an example, the model predicts the number of human resources in the hospital and analyzes in depth the demand for staff types in each department. The results show that the model has high accuracy and reliability in predicting the variables of hospital revenue, wage level, R&D investment and number of personnel, with a prediction error range between 0.09% and 1.27%. The research in this paper provides strong data support for enterprises, which helps them to realize the rational allocation of human resources and strategic transformation, and then maintain their competitive position in the market.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Carrying Capacity Prediction Based on Particle Swarm Optimization and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Urban carrying capacity prediction revolves around the optimization of proper structural developments that may be used in the achievement of sustainability. As a yardstick for the prospect of sustainability, urban carrying capacity (UCC) remains a fundamental conceptual framework used in guiding the local governments towards the promotion of sustainable urban development. Often, significant errors in the process of forecasting has often resulted in challenges towards the achievement of sustainable urban development. In light of these challenges, this research proposes an effective algorithm based on particle swarm optimization and BP neural networks in solving the issues of UCC. The results reveal how improved use of the particle swarm optimization and BP neural networks provides accurate and better effects in addressing sustainable urban development.

articleTitle: Design of an Online Teacher Training System Based on the Web and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: China faces a massive demand for quality teachers, but traditional teacher training has accessibility, customization, and scalability challenges. This paper proposes an innovative online system that utilizes web and genetic algorithms to deliver personalized and optimized training. The architecture provides remote access, intelligent content recommendation, engaging delivery, and continuous performance improvement. Detailed methodologies for learner profiling, content sequencing, and optimization engines are presented. Sample teacher data is used to showcase personalization algorithms and simulate outcomes. Results demonstrate 78% better engagement and 52% improved competency development compared to conventional methods. The system offers a framework to transform teacher qualifications at scale in China by leveraging technology-enabled, learner-centric, and outcome-focused capabilities.

articleTitle: Design of a University Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Management System Based on Web and Collaborative Filtering Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Given the significant challenges affecting college learners in regards to entrepreneurship and innovation as viewed in the traditional Chinese enterprise cooperation, the need for an innovative and entrepreneurship training program remains essential. This paper therefore seeks to design a project management system intended to improve entrepreneurship and innovation in universities. The system will be designed to run on a WEB-based operation module that relies on a mathematical and statistical model used to advance its prospects. An entrepreneurial and innovation classification system will further be incorporated into the system through the use of the CBLOF(t) concept. Computer algorithms will in this case play a critical role in the personalization and the optimization of the innovative and entrepreneurial project management system. Based on this, a monitoring function will equally be incorporated into the system to address abnormalities in the processing of innovative and entrepreneurial data. The outcomes of the systems are intended to enable university students to gain a deeper understanding of innovative and entrepreneurial projects, thus promoting the quality of project management.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Digital Rural Environmental Information Collection and Classification System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper applies LORA technology to environmental monitoring in rural areas. The algorithm is optimized by time division multiple access segmentation. The LORA-TDMA technology was used to study the rural air pollution. Then the village landform is strictly divided. The platform carries out multi-dimensional analysis of data, multi-user customization and service expansion, and brings out the functions of each system based on rural digital high-rise model, digital orthophoto, line and vector. Through rural big data management, decision analysis and mining and other means to provide personalized services for farmers, management agencies, village management, etc. The relative deviation between the measured value and the measured value is less than 5%. This method has a good application prospect in rural areas. The system can better complete the dynamic monitoring of rural environment and data collection and analysis. This enables the relevant departments to keep abreast of the environmental situation in rural areas.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Improved Genetic Algorithm in the Design of Physical Education Teaching Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In colleges and universities in China, physical education is a crucial public fundamental subject. Traditional instruction often takes place during the designated class period in the training program. The instructor imparts to the pupils the principles of physical education so that they may become proficient in sports and ultimately raise their physical and athletic abilities. To lessen the issue of the basic genetic algorithm for intelligent grouping systems' delayed convergence and partial convergence, an enhanced genetic algorithm is suggested. By consistently rejecting comparable candidates, the algorithm may quickly expand the search field and guarantee the stability and diversity of the group. As a result, this work suggests a novel approach to intelligent grouping that is based on an enhanced genetic algorithm. Compared to the conventional algorithm, the novel approach is more effective and straightforward in resolving the issue of the algorithm's early convergence. Numerous tests have demonstrated how effectively the suggested algorithm satisfies every need for physical education. Test papers with a moderate level of difficulty and a sensible structure can be automatically generated by the genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A Feature Recognition Algorithm for Automotive Mechanical CAD Models Based on Graph Isomorphism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This work aims to examine the properties of graph isomorphism-based recognition algorithms for mechanical CAD models of automobiles. A set of topological and geometric algorithms demonstrated to provide reasonable performance in our extensible feature recognition system lend credence to the subgraph isomorphism approach. Using sheet metal properties as an example, we show that the search process may be accelerated to interactive performance rates by implementing clever topological and geometric heuristics. We analyze the associated elements in the attributed adjacency graph to determine the kind of CAD part. Our technique makes it possible to identify two-sided CAD parts, such as sheet metal, tubes, and flat plates. Graph theory is used to develop the basic operations on hierarchical assembly graphs for processing CAD assemblies. We describe the instance singling approach that allows one to handle unique part occurrences in the component tree of an assembly. Our group developed several practical applications that demonstrated the accuracy and effectiveness of the concepts and algorithms supplied.

articleTitle: An Image Recognition Method for Industrial Bearing Faults Based on Network Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Bearing is the key part of mechanical equipment, and its state of health directly affects the property and safety of equipment traditional bearing health monitoring methods are usually based on vibration analysis and vibration signal processing, but there are limitations in complex working conditions and early fault warning. The rise of deep learning technology offers new possibilities for bearing health monitoring. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a deep learning method based on hyperparameter optimization for bearing health monitoring. Firstly, the bask principle of deep learning and its application in bearing health monitoring are introduced. Then, the adopted deep learning models (such as convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, etc) and their training and optimization process on bearing vibration data are described in detail. Through the experimental verification, the proposed method shows good accuracy and stability in bearing fault diagnosis and health monitoring, and provides strong support for arming health monitoring under complex working conditions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Edge Computing System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, the rise of Industry 4.0 has sparked numerous new ideas and advancements focused on digitizing modern manufacturing processes. Researchers and professionals in academic and industrial settings have explored various methods and technologies, including Edge Computing, as part of the broader shift towards decentralization in manufacturing systems. However, challenges persist in integrating decentralized computing systems into actual industries. The management and control subsystems have completed the overall architecture construction and interaction of various modules, making it easy for users to deploy and schedule edge applications and services. Additionally, front-end display for system status monitoring has been finished in terms of visualization. This helps project developers understand the real-time running status of the platform as well as provides an improved solution for IoT application deployment and maintenance by platform operators.

articleTitle: Research on Vulnerability Mining Method Based on Artificial Intelligence in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of computer technology, Internet of Things (IoT) technology has been widely used in various fields and has played an important role in various industries. The Internet of Things is responsible for information transmission and storage, and once there are network security issues, it will bring huge disasters to various industries. Detecting vulnerabilities in the Internet of Things is an urgent problem that needs to be addressed. In order to improve the efficiency of IoT vulnerability detection, this paper designs an IoT vulnerability mining solution based on the LSTM algorithm. The designed artificial intelligence IoT vulnerability mining algorithm uses deep learning for identification, and this framework includes steps such as data collection, data learning, and data detection. The results show that after comparing three models: LSTM, SeqGAN, and WGAN, the LSTM algorithm exhibits the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Myopia Auxiliary Diagnosis System Based on Improved Convolution Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology, its applications in the medical field have become increasingly widespread, particularly in the diagnosis and analysis of ophthalmic diseases. Myopia, as a common refractive error condition, requires accurate diagnosis for the development of effective treatment and management strategies. This study aims to explore the application of deep learning models in the diagnosis of myopia severity in ophthalmology by analyzing biometric data such as fundus images, corneal curvature, and axial length of the eye. We collected a set of ophthalmic examination data from patients with varying degrees of myopia and preprocessed the data, including image denoising, normalization, and feature extraction. Subsequently, we designed and trained a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) model capable of automatically detecting and analyzing features related to myopia from fundus images. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed deep learning model performs excellently in the diagnosis of myopia severity, showing a high degree of consistency with the diagnostic outcomes of ophthalmic experts. The model not only accurately identifies different levels of myopia but also distinguishes myopia from other refractive conditions. This achievement proves the effectiveness of deep learning in ophthalmic diagnosis, providing new tools for early diagnosis and treatment of myopia. Furthermore, this study also explores the potential advantages of deep learning in ophthalmic diagnosis. Compared to traditional diagnostic methods, deep learning models can process large amounts of data quickly, provide instant feedback, thereby significantly improving diagnostic efficiency. Moreover, as the model's decision-making process is data-driven, it can reduce human errors and enhance the objectivity and consistency of diagnoses.

articleTitle: Path Planning Around Submersible Based on Bayesian Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study aims at the dangerous situation that may occur in the seabed exploration, investigates the submersible's ocean-floor movement using a dynamic model. It leverages ArcGIS for 3D geographic analysis of sea conditions, and adopts a Kalman filter to simulate the submersible's trajectory in order to provide a good tourism experience for tourists while ensuring the safety of sightseeing. Besides, this study built a model based on Bayesian theory modeling in order to minimize the time of finding the missing submersible, the probability of submersible appearing in various waters after a period of time from the base point is calculated, and then combined with four different search modes. And this study draw the conclusion that the optimal mode is sea and air stereoscopic search. Based on this, the probability distribution of successful search under different search times is given. Boltzmann function is used to fit the probability of finding submersible as a function of time and cumulative search results. And excellent fit degree <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.8746)$</tex> was obtained. Above all, the novelty of this study is the combined application of Kalman filter and ArcGIS as well as giving the probability of finding submersible as a function of time and cumulative search results, which shed light on meeting the demand of the balance between tourists' curiosity and their own safety.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Traveling Wave Discharge of Tree Hidden Danger in Overhead Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The fault of transmission line tree barrier is a gradual process, which will go through a period of discharge before the fault, which is called hidden danger discharge in this paper. In this paper, the discharge process of tree hidden danger is analyzed, and the discharge process of tree hidden danger is simulated in laboratory environment, and the high frequency current waveform generated by discharge is monitored and recorded. The research results show that with the shortening of the distance between the conductor and the tree, the hidden discharge before the fault will last for a long time, and the flashover fault will not be formed immediately. During the hidden discharge, a large number of highfrequency discharge current pulses will be generated, and the current waveform generated by the discharge is scattered.

articleTitle: Design of Transportation Information Resource Systems Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study details data mining techniques in the design of transportation information system (TIS) database, which are widely used by transport companies in China. The objective is to examined how the information system is designed and operates. Association rules, which may identify common combinations of features that occur most often within a particular data set, are used with descriptive statistical approaches to evaluate data. The association rules were created using two different quantifier types: “above average” and “founded implication.” The analysis is shown with graphs and hypotheses as the outcomes.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Hover-Net in Nuclear Segmentation and Classification of Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In HE-stained images, nuclear segmentation and classification are critical tasks for disease diagnosis and prognosis, which is of great significance [1]. The high intraclass morphological variability and interclass nuclear similarity make it complicated to perform nuclear segmentation and classification tasks simultaneously on HE-stained images. We need to use advanced computer vision and deep learning technology, combined with professional knowledge, to solve these problems effectively. This paper proposes an innovative Hover-net model-STi Hover-net, aiming to improve cell nuclei segmentation and classification accuracy in histopathological images. Combined with deep learning technology, it effectively captures the subtle features and spatial distribution of the nucleus by expanding the sensing area of the nucleus. It has achieved excellent performance on several cancer-type data sets.

articleTitle: Research on Training Methods for Mixing Satellite Down-View Images with Augmented Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has been widely applied in fields such as security, medical, transportation, agriculture, and military. Due to limitations in practical conditions, real datasets suffer from problems such as small scale, poor quality, and uneven samples. Therefore, image data augmentation technology is widely used. This paper focuses on satellite down-view images of airplanes and helicopters. To address the issues with the measured datasets, such as their high acquisition cost, poor resolution, single angle, limited dataset size, and uneven sample distribution, different data augmentation methods, including grayscale conversion, Gaussian noise addition, generative adversarial networks, are used to augment a small amount of real data in order to enhance the generalization ability of the typical deep learning model. Experiments have shown that different augmentation methods can enhance the performance of the model, in which the two methods of grayscale conversion and Gaussian noise addition are especially significant. The enhancing effect of several combined data augmentation methods based on the StyleGAN2 generative model is comparable, which indicates that the StyleGAN2 generated images have good sample balance in terms of image variations.

articleTitle: A Study of Tennis Match Momentum Based on Markov Chain and Conditional Bayesian Hybrid Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the “momentum” problem of a team or player in a sports match, using a hybrid Markov chain and conditional Bayesian model to capture the dynamics of the match. Firstly, the model is used to identify which player is performing better at a particular moment of a tennis match and how much their performance advantage is; Secondly, the dynamic performance of the players is visualized, and the XGBoost model is used to qualitatively analyze the state of the players; Lastly, the Markov chain model is used to validate the correctness of the solution of the above model, and the hybrid model is used to compute the probability of consecutive wins/losses in order to show that consecutive wins/losses are not random, but are conditional on a number of factors, such as the number of players who win/lose in a given match.

articleTitle: Application Research on Large Language Model Attention Mechanism in Automatic Classification of Book Content
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The LLaMA (Large Language Model Attention Mechanism) application in automatic book content classification is receiving increasing attention. The main content of this article revolves around traditional book classification models and improved LLaMA structures, delving into the application and advantages of LLaMA in book classification tasks. Firstly, this article introduces the task description of traditional book classification models and rule-based classification methods. Next, this article elaborates on the design of improving the LLaMA structure, including introducing attention mechanisms, replacing traditional attention terms with self-attention functions, initializing word embedding set functions, and designing the overall structure of the LLaMA model. Furthermore, this article demonstrates a book classification method based on the improved LLaMA algorithm, including the LLaMA algorithm itself, the improved LLaMA algorithm, and its specific application process in book classification. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the book classification method based on LLaMA were verified in practical applications through an example analysis. This article concludes that the improved LLaMA model has significant advantages in automatic book content classification, which can improve the accuracy and efficiency of classification and provide a new technological path for the field of book classification.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Functional Data Regression Analysis in Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper delves into the application of functional data regression analysis for time series forecasting, highlighting its ability to model complex dependencies more effectively than traditional methods. Despite its innovative approach of treating time series as continuous entities, the method faces challenges such as sensitivity to outliers, difficulty in capturing long-term trends, and prediction instability due to error accumulation. To address these issues, the study proposes an integrated approach that combines robust regression to mitigate outlier effects, state space models for dynamic and long-term trend analysis, and model combination techniques to improve prediction stability and accuracy. By enhancing the method's robustness and adaptability, this integrated strategy not only showcases the unique advantages of functional data regression in time series forecasting but also provides a pathway to overcoming its limitations, offering insights into creating more reliable and accurate forecasting models.

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce Image Recognition Search Engine Optimization System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an electronic commerce system based on Java platform. The main content of the platform is to obtain the user's interest characteristics, build the model and calculate the similarity. This paper generates a preliminary proposal template and set thresholds during data processing. The vector space modeling method is used to classify different types of goods. By using the joint optimal convolutional neural network based on SoftMax Loss and Triplet Loss, a ternal embedded tag structure is constructed to realize similarity detection at each level. Using WebLogic technology and J2EE architecture to achieve all business logic and load balance. The JSP/Servlet web program has been loaded into the web container. An entity Beans is deployed in the EJB container. The results show that this method can not only achieve better classification performance, but also improve the image retrieval accuracy of different levels of label structures on fine-grained data sets. This is of great significance in the recommendation of related products in e-commerce.

articleTitle: The Design of Diagnosis Management System for Steam Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
