abstract: The steam turbine is one of the main equipment of the conventional island of the nuclear power plant, whose functional structure is complex, and its possibility of failure is high. And once the failure occurs, the losses are huge. The steam turbine fault prediction and health management technology, marked by monitoring and analysis, can effectively improve the safe and reliable operation of steam turbines. Therefore, in order to better ensure the safe operation of the steam turbine, a turbine diagnosis management system is designed here. The system can collect the dynamic mechanical signals such as rotor vibration and bearing vibration from the steam turbine monitoring instrument system, and can realize the functions of processing, analyzing, saving and replaying these signals. Through data analysis and professional graph, it can effectively help to investigate the cause of steam turbine failure, thereby reducing the losses of failure. Presently, the system has been tested and verified by the corresponding functions. Validation results show that the system can acquire mechanical vibration signals, analyze data, and draw graphs to help analyze possible mechanical failures. This system has important application value for the long-term safe operation of steam turbines.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Fixed Sun Mirror Field Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Solar energy helps to ameliorate the earth's climate change, reduce carbon emissions, and achieve clean energy goals. In this paper, Monte Carlo simulation, genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm, as well as stochastic two-dimensional point simulation and visualization model based on various influencing factors are used to establish an optimal problem solving strategy for the design of a heliostat mirror field. The combined application of these methods provides a solid methodological foundation for the optimal design of the heliostat mirror field and lays an important foundation for the future development of sustainable clean energy.

articleTitle: Integration of Geometric and Perceptual Information for Monocular Depth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the domain of deep learning, spherical deformations pose formidable obstacles, especially in intricate regression tasks such as depth estimation. Applying traditional CNN layers to distorted images often leads to a detrimental loss of crucial information. To address this challenge, our research introduces ContextFusion, a framework for 360-degree monocular depth estimation. This innovative approach transforms 360-degree images into less distorted perspective blocks, known as tangent images, which are then processed by CNNs for predictions. The block-level predictions are then synthesized into a final output. To address the discrepancies among patch predictions, which significantly impact the integration quality, we propose a novel framework with distinct components. Firstly, we introduce a geometric perceptual feature fusion mechanism that leverages both 3D geometric and 2D image features to compensate for variations between blocks. Secondly, we incorporate a self-attention-based converter architecture that enables global aggregation of patch information, enhancing overall consistency. Finally, an iterative depth refinement mechanism leverages more precise geometric features to iteratively refine the estimated depth. Through comprehensive experimentation, our method exhibits remarkable ability to mitigate the distortion problem and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmark datasets for monocular depth estimation.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on the Principle of Permanent Magnet Motor Vector Control Based on SIMULINK Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, based on the current development of permanent magnet synchronous motor and its control technology at home and abroad, the mathematical model and equivalent circuit of permanent magnet synchronous motor are derived, and the vector control principle is discussed in detail, and the id=0 control, maximum torque/current control, weak magnetic control and other control strategies are analyzed. The current well-developed digital simulation technology of power system is selected, and the SIMULINK simulation platform tool based on Matlab language is used to conduct simulation research on the vector control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor with id=0. The simulation results support the validity of the suggested control method and establish a theoretical foundation for the development of the physical motor control system. It is of reference significance to guide the daily stable operation of permanent magnet motor.

articleTitle: Design of Automated English Intelligent Translation System Under Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of globalization, communication among people has become more and more frequent. In this case, the barrier of language communication has become an important problem. In order to solve this problem, automated English intelligent translation systems have emerged. This kind of system utilizes machine learning technology and can automatically translate one language into another, helping people to communicate across languages more conveniently. To improve the accuracy of the translation system, this article explored an automated English intelligent translation system (ITS) based on CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) algorithm combined with attention mechanism. The experimental results show that the parameter size of the machine translation system based on CNN algorithm Attention is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{61.54} \times \mathbf{10}^{\mathbf{6}}$</tex>, and the training time is 1 second, which is the smallest among all models.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Elderly Care Monitoring and Prediction Model Based on Deep Learning and 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A low-cost and scalable intelligent pension system based on data-driven is designed. Using WIFI technology to build a wireless LAN, it can monitor home temperature, humidity, combustible gas concentration, dust and formaldehyde concentration in real time, and then transmit this information to the STM32 master chip. Finally, the information of the system is transmitted wirelessly to the background PC through NB-IoT to complete the analysis and processing of the collected data. When any abnormal situation occurs, the alarm will remind the user to find it in time. In addition, in order to determine whether the elderly have fallen, the geographical location of the elderly will be collected, and if there is an anomaly, the GSM system will be activated to send a text message to the elderly's relatives or guardians. Kalman filter is used to optimize the process to reduce the error of the elderly fall recognition. Experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of this method is more than 80%. This system can effectively analyze and judge the physical condition of the elderly in the elderly apartment to provide them with more accurate care.

articleTitle: Research on Data Quality Management Methods and Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, big data has become an important strategic resource for enterprises. However, with the increase in data volume, data quality issues are becoming increasingly prominent. Low data quality may lead to enterprises being unable to make accurate decisions, and even bring huge economic losses. This article first discusses the definition of data quality and the dimensions of data quality measurement, and then focuses on the measurement methods and architecture of data quality. It mainly summarizes the data quality comparison mode, technical implementation deployment, and proposes a distributed data quality audit architecture. Finally, it provides the steps and common software implementations for data quality management within the enterprise. In summary, this article aims to explore the significance, solutions, and implementation methods of data quality management, providing an effective theoretical basis for improving the data quality for enterprises.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis and Research on the Occurrence of Faults in the Box Transformer and Inverter Integrated Unit of Photovoltaic Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper describes an event that the failure of the transformer/inverter integrated unit in a photovoltaic power station caused the protection action and caused the line switch to trip. Through the analysis of the accident site, the protection action and the disassembly of the faulty integrated machine, the correctness of the protection action behavior is verified, the cause and process of the accident are accurately analyzed, and the corresponding corrective measures are formulated. The targeted measures are formulated for the operation and maintenance of the same type of equipment in operation, and also provide guidance for the improved design and manufacture of the transformer/inverter integrated machine, so as to effectively prevent the occurrence of similar accidents, provide guarantee for safe and stable operation of new energy equipment.

articleTitle: Similarity of Musical Timbres Using Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Fourier transform as a mathematical tool plays an important role in timbre recognition technology because of its ability to realize the conversion of time domain signals into frequency domain signals so that sounds can be parametrically analyzed according to their frequencies and perform timbre feature extraction to achieve timbre similarity recognition and classification. This paper analyzes and composes the principles and practical applications of Fourier transform in multi-dimensional timbre feature extraction according to the current research status. This paper will first introduce the basic theory of musical timbre similarity recognition, i.e., the definition of timbre and the main steps of timbre recognition, focusing on one of the most important steps of timbre recognition - the timbre feature extraction stage. Secondly, this paper makes a comparative study on the principle of using Fractional Fourier Transform (FRFT), Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), Short-term Fourier Transform (STFT) descriptors in the Mel Frequency Cepstrum Coefficient (MFCC), and the Infinite Impulse Response Constant Q Transformation (IIR-CQT). Then this research analyzed and compared the performance of these methods using Fourier transform to extract timbre features.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction and Center Localization Recognition of Circular Hole Based on Gaussian Pyramid Hierarchical Clustering and Hough Circle Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A drawer-type fixture for transformer assembly frame is used to collect the coordinate data of the center of circular holes. To address the issues of high misrecognition rate and weak robustness in traditional Hough circle detection methods for circular hole recognition in visual inspection, a method combining Gaussian pyramid sampling, hierarchical clustering, and Hough circle detection is proposed to reduce the sensitivity of Hough circle detection to parameters, and improve robustness and accuracy. Firstly, the image is preprocessed to obtain a satisfactory binary image, followed by Gaussian pyramid sampling to reduce data volume and minimize noise. Secondly, hierarchical clustering is conducted using the shortest distance as the metric to identify target clusters, which are analyzed based on clustering results and dendrogram. Finally, Hough circle detection is employed to extract the coordinates of the center of circular holes. Experimental validation of the proposed method shows a processing time of 3.494 seconds and a success rate of 98.68%, meeting industrial requirements.

articleTitle: A Computation Model for Proximity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs a computation cluster algorithm based on proximity. Viewing the input elements as points, it is proved that every edge of MST can help to give an unique classification based on the neighbor graph. The method solve the cluster problem by application of the delaunay and Prim algorithm. Experimental results show that the computation results are persistent with human vision perception and provide a distinct classification for the multi cluster centers cluster problem.

articleTitle: A Study on Speech Emotion Recognition Based on MFCC and KNN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Speech, as a fundamental attribute of language, plays a crucial auxiliary role in conveying the literal content of what the speaker wants to say and the emotional nuances that he or she wants to convey. Emotions are intrinsically linked to human attitudes and provide a richer and more stable evaluation and experience of physiological states. The advent of Artificial Intelligence has opened up new possibilities for speech emotion recognition. In this paper, a speech emotion recognition system using Mel Frequency Cepstrum Coefficient (MFCC) and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, speech emotion features such as prosody, spectral features and tone quality are extracted using MFCC. These features are then transformed and structured for further analysis. Subsequently, the extracted features are classified into five different speech emotion categories: anger, sadness, happiness, fear and neutrality using KNN. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves robust predictive performance, demonstrating its effectiveness in speech emotion recognition.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Cardiovascular Diseases Based on XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of cardiovascular disease prediction based on XGBoost. The study introduces the fundamental models of Decision Trees (DT) and Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDT), followed by the derivation of the objective function for the XGBoost model. Performance evaluation of the XGBoost model is conducted using a confusion matrix, along with quantitative metrics to measure its predictive effectiveness. The training set exhibits accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 values of 0.828, 0.828, 0.83, and 0.828, respectively, while the testing set shows values of 0.718, 0.718, 0.719, and 0.717, indicating the high effectiveness of the classification model. Furthermore, to demonstrate the superiority of XGBoost over other models, this study compares it with BDT, basic decision tree models, KNN, and Naive Bayes. Results obtained from SPSSPRO illustrate that XGBoost outperforms other models significantly in terms of accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 scores, indicating its suitability for cardiovascular disease classification.

articleTitle: Research on Application System of Computer Aided Design in Innovative Design of Intangible Cultural Heritage Clothing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, a semantic-based intangible cultural heritage database is constructed based on the integration of structured retrieval and the characteristics of C language, and then it is debugged and compiled, and the data is stored in the warehouse. The loopholes in the model are repaired, and finally the Han-style clothing library is constructed based on multi-view deep learning. The method of Han Fu shape measurement based on convolutional neural network is studied. A two-level convolutional neural network model is constructed. This paper improves the accuracy of the model with 2 deep transfers and repeated training. The pixel spacing of each coordinate is calculated based on image segmentation, and scaled with the plane distribution map of cultural relics provided in archaeological data and one actual measured size to obtain the scale information of the complete garment. Experiments show that the two-transfer learning convolutional networks have better convergence and learning performance. This method is used to measure the size of Han-style clothing Hanyu, and the measurement accuracy is 0.62%-5.22%. The implementation of this project will open up a new way for the restoration of ancient Chinese clothing and the measurement of cultural relics.

articleTitle: Multi-Frequency Water-Based Piston Source Superimposed Excitation Channel Equalization Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study aims to explore the application of channel equalization technology with multi-frequency water-based piston source superimposed excitation in underwater acoustic communication systems. Underwater acoustic communication is crucial for ocean resource development, but it is affected by the complexity of underwater propagation media and frequency-selective fading. The study involves QPSK signal modulation and the use of the Bellhop acoustic toolbox to simulate underwater multi-path channels, replicating real underwater communication environments. At the receiving end, a bandpass filter is employed to select the corresponding frequency of the QPSK signal, followed by coherent demodulation to restore it to baseband. To address temporal interference and frequency-selective fading, a decision feedback equalizer is introduced for temporal equalization. Through experimentation and simulation, low bit error rate reception signals are achieved, demonstrating the effectiveness of this channel equalization technology in enhancing the quality of underwater acoustic communication systems.

articleTitle: Study of Assisted Driving System Based on Multi-Sensor Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that single sensors have limitations in acquiring vehicle target information. Therefore, in this paper, a feasible decision-level multi-sensor fusion for assisted driving system is designed. The vision part uses an improved CenterNet target detection algorithm and correlates millimeter-wave radar with vision data using a visual vertebrae data correlation method. The model in this paper shows significant improvement in detection accuracy for all target categories, especially for small targets such as Pedest, Motor and Bicycle, which are improved by 6.6%, 6.9z% and 6.3% respectively compared to CenterFusion, and for larger target categories such as Car, Truck, Bus and Trailer by 1.3%, 2.4%, 3.4%, 3.4%, 3.4% and 3.3% respectively compared to CenterFusion. Ana there are 2.4 percent, 3.2 percent and 1.1 percent, respectively, for larger target categories such as Car, Truck, Bus and Trailer.

articleTitle: Research and Application Analysis of Turbo Code Decoding Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article embarks on an exhaustive exploration and in-depth analysis of Turbo code decoding algorithms, a crucial constituent in communication technology. The primary objective is to delve into the technical nitty-gritty, theoretical framework, and significant implications of Turbo codes, thereby emphasizing its centrality in modern communication systems. As a part of this analysis, the standard Turbo code decoding algorithm is meticulously scrutinized, followed by an examination of diverse optimization techniques. The study also comprises exhaustive performance assessments, encompassing aspects such as error rate performance and computational complexity. A careful evaluation of the strengths and limitations of these algorithms provides a balanced perspective on their practical efficacy. These decoding algorithms are then compared under various parameters to arrive at insightful conclusions about their relative performances. In addition, this work probes into the myriad applications of Turbo codes. Primarily, it examines their use in wireless communication systems, optical fiber communication systems, and more, shedding light on their versatility and indispensable role across numerous domains. The investigation touches upon how the strengths of Turbo codes are harnessed in these systems, while also discussing potential challenges in implementation.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Monitoring Computer Algorithm System for Occlusion of Photovoltaic Panels Developed by Machine Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-feature detection method based on graph cut for photovoltaic panels is proposed. Combined with multi-dimensional features such as optical flow field and light intensity, an interactive feature recognition method is constructed. The combination of each feature forms a pixel feature vector and is fed into a random forest classifier. The interaction information between adjacent pixel pairs is extracted. The energy function and adaptive algorithm of object-based occlusion detection are constructed. This Paper build an undirected graph. The object is segmented by the graph cutting principle. The findings from the experiments indicate that the new technique surpasses traditional methods in precision and offers enhanced responsiveness for detecting obstructions.

articleTitle: Analysis of Badminton Motion Trajectory Algorithm Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Badminton is a competitive sport with high real-time requirements. To build a badminton robot and enable human-robot sparring, real-time dynamic tracking of fast-moving badminton trajectories is essential. The tracking problem of dynamic targets is widespread in various fields, including industrial production, daily life, and military applications. Existing badminton trajectory planning algorithms face challenges in accurately tracking moving targets and evaluating the stability of badminton flight paths. To enhance the badminton trajectory planning capability, this paper presents a neural network-based algorithm for badminton trajectory prediction. Firstly, a badminton aerodynamic model is established based on the flight characteristics of a badminton shuttlecock. Then, the motion trajectory planning constraint parameters are analyzed for the parameters involved in the dynamic model. The neural network is introduced to predict the badminton trajectory and facilitate accurate tracking of the badminton path. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively track the dynamic path of a badminton shuttlecock in real-time, reduce the deviation of drop-off distances, and improve the accuracy of drop-off prediction.

articleTitle: Development of a Multi-Objective Optimization Framework for Submersible Localization and Search Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To propose an effective algorithm framework for submersible localization, a predictive modeling approach was developed. Researchers leveraged oceanographic data to construct two computational models: Model I, a grid-based system for predicting submersible location, and Model II, a multi-objective optimization strategy for search operations. Model I utilizes a discrete network and dynamic differential equations to simulate submersible motion trajectories, while Model II calculates the Cumulative Detection Probability (CDP) to optimize search efforts, with a threshold of CDP > 0.9. These models demonstrate adaptability for diverse sea areas and scenarios. A sensitivity analysis of the models revealed their robustness and the potential to significantly enhance search operations. The research culminated in a memorandum to the Greek government, detailing the models' capabilities and recommending their implementation.

articleTitle: Biological Random Dynamic Focusing Disparity Estimation Within Time-Sequence Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In traditional computer stereo vision systems, a single focus is employed for capturing and processing stereo image pairs to estimate depth. However, the inherent variability of object distances in real world stereo images imposes limitations on this method, rendering it less reliable. To tackle this issue, a novel biological random dynamic focusing theory grounded in time-sequence images is proposed in this paper. In the proposed framework, the images of different focal points are captured according to the time sequence, the target is extracted and manipulated, ultimately yielding either a single focus or multi-focus image processing output depending on the application scenario. Moreover, a biological focusing disparity estimation algorithm is proposed and this theory is subsequently extended to the domain of disparity estimation, with its foundation rooted in the Semi Global Matching (SGM) algorithm. The disparity map obtained by this algorithm exhibits a more accurate disparity values and achieves a good balance between speed and accuracy. Experimental results on real world images demonstrate that our method enhanced robustness and flexibility compared to traditional methodologies.

articleTitle: Heart Rate Prediction Algorithm of Smart Wearable Device with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the field of heart rate prediction for smart wearable devices, an innovative fusion strategy is to combine Actor-Critic reinforcement learning algorithm (AC algorithm) with convolutional neural network (CNN). Using CNN's powerful spatiotemporal feature extraction capability to process continuous heart rate sequence data, it can automatically capture and transform local correlation and hidden patterns in physiological signals into high-level abstract features. On this basis, the actor-critic framework dynamically adjusts the behavior strategy of the model, in which the Actor is responsible for output the heart rate prediction at the next moment according to the current state, and the Critic evaluates and feedbacks the action value of the Actor. The two work together to iteratively optimize model performance and introduce a new Neural Network Actor Critic model (NNAC). This integrated scheme makes full use of the advantages of CNN in the analysis of complex time series data, and combines the real-time learning and feedback mechanism of Actor-Critic algorithm to solve the accurate heart rate prediction problem under the challenges of large individual differences and changing physiological conditions. Through such technology integration, smart wearable devices can predict user heart rate changes more accurately and quickly, thus improving the practicality and intelligence level of health management applications.

articleTitle: Design of a College Student Mental Health Assessment System Based on Improved Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper emphasizes the need to design an enhanced Apriori algorithm-based mental health assessment system to address the mental health issues college students face. The article aims to assess the current mental health evaluation systems of college students and develop a framework for a mental health evaluation. It proposes using data mining algorithms, precisely the Apriori algorithm, to analyze and categorize the data. This process ultimately yields intelligent mental health evaluation results. Finally, the mental health astute assessment system's practicality and superiority are examined by targeted simulation tests. The findings demonstrate that the system described in the article effectively addresses the limitations of the existing mental health intelligence evaluation system. It enhances the precision and efficiency of mental health intelligence evaluation while ensuring system stability. Consequently, it satisfactorily fulfills college students' current mental health evaluation needs.

articleTitle: MMCL: Minimalist Multi-Layer Contrastive Learning Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The resurgence of Contrastive Learning in recommendation systems has demonstrated significant potential in mitigating data sparsity issues and enhancing recommendation performance. While graph augmentation has been widely adopted in CL-based recommendation models, our research indicates that the quality of representation learning plays a pivotal role in model performance. Nevertheless, the scalability of CL-based models remains a concern due to computational demands. To tackle this challenge, we propose Minimalist Multi-Layer Contrastive Learning Recommendation System (MMCL), which streamlines the computation process by integrating recommendation and contrastive tasks and employing multiple cross-layer contrasts instead of a final layer contrast. MMCL achieves lightweight performance comparable to traditional recommendation models. Our study underscores the significance of representation learning in CL-based recommendation systems and presents a more scalable approach for future advancements in this domain. All code is available at https://github.com/xszqxszq/MMCL.

articleTitle: Design of English Teaching Resource System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper seeks to design an English deep learning-based online teaching assistant system in this paper. The basic structure of the system is described in a web environment, which is composed of a system login module and a homework function module. It is then designed that the examinations and examination information management module reinforce its role as an online English teaching instrument. Training in deep learning networks is on the software side of system to improve quality of English online teaching resources. The results of the experiment show that training efficiency and login success rate both are higher than that in traditional systems. OK, then this system's application performance is good.

articleTitle: Modelling and Application of Vehicle Type Recognition Based on Gaussian EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The presence of highly similar features across different vehicle types can result in erroneous detection. To effectively address this issue, this paper employs the EfficientNetV2 model as the foundation for the proposed solution. The Gaussian residual module is then integrated into the base model to enhance the feature differences, leading to the establishment of the Gaussian EfficientNet vehicle recognition model. Firstly, the local Gaussian residual module compares the vehicle image features extracted by the base model with high accuracy. Then, the global Gaussian residual module merges the comparison results with the features extracted by the base model into the features with more substantial differences. Experimental results demonstrate that the model was trained only six times, with recognition accuracy reaching 97.53% and 99.75%, respectively, and compared to the vehicle type recognition model based on EfficientNetV2, the Gaussian EfficientNet model exhibited enhanced robustness in recognition, representing a highly effective vehicle recognition model.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Deep Learning Algorithm to Optimize the Fault Prediction Model of Nuclear Power Plant Emergency Feed Pump
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This project takes the typical failure forms of pumps in nuclear power plants such as abnormal vibration, friction and wear as the research object. The most readily available pump housing acceleration signal frequency domain information is used as input. The system is mainly composed of four modules: input module, convolution module, multi-head self-attention module and output module. The attention mechanism of characteristic frequency domain data based on the fusion of deep neural network and attention network is studied. At the same time, the pattern recognition model of pump faults in nuclear power plant is constructed. Compared with the existing research results, using frequency-domain data as input, using frequency-domain data attention network and other technologies can shorten the amount of input data, and make the recognition accuracy of the model up to 100% in the test set, which has obvious advantages over other fault recognition models based on deep neural networks.

Author Keywords: Water pump for nuclear power plant

articleTitle: Design of the Waste Picking Robotic Arm Based on PID Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This robotic arm that's created is useful in helping with picking up the garbage. It is handy and can be used daily, with a convenient operation by pressing different color buttons. With the waste dumped increasing in the recent years, there are more pollutions around the planet. This garbage picker would do one's best in improving the cleanse quality of our plant. It is also helpful for old people as they are not that convenient to move around. The whole machine is operated by gears and motors. The motors are mainly in the claw and the gear and the gear rack are assembled in the extending handle. These components cooperating together would result in a smooth motion of the machine. After refining my design, we can popularize this machine with the help of different organizations. For example, the government and NGOs that have the same goals. This would be able to promote the aspect of environmental protection. In conclusion, this machine is able to reach for objects as far as 21 cm away, the gear rack can be replaced with a longer one to achieve a further distance. It is able to handle a bottle of 550 ml water.

articleTitle: Momentum Prediction Model of Tennis Matches Based on LSTM and FCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Tennis is a spectator sport in which the dominant party is constantly changing, and we attribute fluctuations in dominant players to “momentum.” Studying how to measure this phenomenon is crucial for predicting athletes' performances and is also one of the important ways for big data to guide athletes' scientific training and improve their competitive level. In this article, we propose a model based on LSTM and FCNN to predict match trends by analyzing momentum. Firstly, we use the Pearson correlation coefficient method and random forest feature selection method to find key features that can better predict the trend of momentum changes in tennis matches. Then, based on LSTM and FCNN, we model the changes in match situations. The results of the two models corroborate each other, and the model's prediction accuracy can reach over 90%. Meanwhile, through experiments, we validate that our prediction model can also achieve good results in other types of sports, demonstrating good generalization.

articleTitle: Research on Airborne Wireless Pressure Testing Network System Based on Zigbee
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article focuses on the application requirements of wireless testing networks in aviation testing technology. By studying and implementing a Zigbee based wireless pressure testing network system, a Zigbee based wireless pressure sensing system is constructed, which realizes the main testing technology functions of wireless pressure testing and network data aggregation. This project aims to study the wireless pressure sensing testing network system technology under airborne conditions, and achieve core testing technology functions such as network system architecture, reconfiguration testing nodes, and network data aggregation in the airborne wireless pressure testing system. The development of this study has promoted the application research, architecture construction, and technology roadmap planning of wireless network testing technology in the aviation field, providing technical reference for building a new comprehensive testing network system that can efficiently integrate testing resources. The effectiveness of the system has been verified through flight tests, and the test data results are good.

articleTitle: Forecasting Extreme High Temperatures Based on an ARIMA-LSTM Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper employs the ARIMA model and LSTM model to forecast and compare the occurrence of extremely hot weather in the region, respectively. Addressing the issue of low precision and inaccurate forecasts in existing models for predicting extremely hot weather, the ARIMA model's forecasts are refined using the LSTM model's error predictions, resulting in the proposed ARIMA-LSTM hybrid model. The findings indicate a significant improvement in the ARIMA model's forecast accuracy across the metrics of RMSE, MAE, and goodness-of-fit <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{R}^{\mathbf{2}}$</tex>. The ARIMA-LSTM model's predictions more accurately reflect actual conditions compared to the individual ARIMA and LSTM models. Consequently, developing an appropriate ARIMA-LSTM model for forecasting extreme high temperatures, tailored to the region's specific conditions, could provide a theoretical basis for preventing hot weather and devising mitigation strategies.

articleTitle: Completion Method of Dissolved Gas Detection Data in Oil of Extra-High Voltage DC Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study proposes a new complementary method for dissolved gas data in oil of ultra-high voltage DC converter transformers based on Markov model by taking Markov theory as the basis and giving full consideration to the transfer characteristics between all the states of the system at adjacent time points. The method converts the time series of dissolved gas data in oil into a Markov chain of transfers between different states, and calculates the complementary values of dissolved gas data in oil using forward and reverse state transfer matrices. At the same time, a comprehensive evaluation system for the quality of dissolved gas data in oil is established from the perspective of data mining, evaluating the effect of data complementarity from multiple perspectives and synthesizing the evaluation results from each perspective based on the D-S evidence fusion theory to arrive at a comprehensive evaluation result. In the experiment of completing 25 groups of random missing values in the dissolved gas data of UHV DC converter transformer oil, the results show that the similarity between the completed data and the actual values can reach 99.999%. The effect of missing data of 15 groups of extreme value points and jump points is further verified, and after comprehensive evaluation, the similarity between the completed data and the actual values can reach 98.956%. The validation results show that the proposed method can accurately complete the missing values of dissolved gases in DC converter transformer oil without changing the data characteristics, which is conducive to improving the accuracy of the condition assessment method for UHV DC converter transformers.

articleTitle: Research on Drone Path Planning Problem based on Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper introduces an improved sparrow search algorithm designed for addressing the drone path planning issue. This article first provides a mathematical description of the principles of the drone path planning problem and the sparrow search algorithm. Then, in response to the problem that the sparrow search algorithm is prone to getting stuck in local optima during the iteration process, partially-matched crossover initialization of the sparrow population is introduced to ensure the diversity of the sparrow population at the initial time. And this paper introduces the 3-opt algorithm to perturb the sparrow population, improving its ability to jump out of local optima. Finally, four TSP datasets, burma14, bayg29, att48, and eil101 were selected for simulation experiments. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved sparrow search algorithm exhibits a notable improvement in both convergence speed and its ability to escape local optima compared to the conventional sparrow search algorithm. It exhibits good stability when facing datasets of different sizes and has good applicability.

articleTitle: Design of a Post-Quantum Signature Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The security of digital signatures has always been a closely watched issue in the field of cryptography. With the introduction of quantum algorithms and the development of quantum computers, traditional digital signature algorithms are threatened by being cracked. The best solution currently is to replace traditional digital signature algorithms with anti-quantum attack digital signature algorithms. Although existing anti quantum signature algorithms can effectively resist targeted attacks such as ISD and GBA, with the increasing demand for the security level of signature algorithms, the efficiency of algorithms gradually cannot meet the requirements of practical applications. In response to this issue, this article introduces a plaintext random splitting method based on Goppa codes in parallel CFS, designs and implements a fast CFS signature algorithm. Through performance analysis and comparison, it can be seen that the fast CFS signature algorithm solves the problem of multiple decoding times and low signature efficiency at higher security levels, and has smaller decoding times at the same security level, thereby improving the efficiency of signature.

articleTitle: A Study of Tennis Momentum Factors Based on BP Neural Networks and Multiple Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Owing to the intricate nature of the tennis program, pinpointing just one determinant to elucidate the game's outcomes effectively is challenging, necessitating a broader and more cohesive evaluation. This paper choses data from the 2023 Wimbledon men's final to measure the influence of various elements on the game's result, including the players' performance in the match, their personal standing, and the actual conditions. The relative importance of momentum, the validity of the model, and the importance of individual predictors were assessed based on a neural network. At the same time, the relevant factors affecting the winners and losers of the matches are analyzed as a reference for whether the players can win the matches and how the coaches set up their strategies during the matches.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Data Transmission and Signal Processing System of CIM Practical Training Teaching Platform Based on 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of “digital signal processing”, such as many common knowledge points, difficult teaching, difficult visual teaching, and so on, a software platform for “signal processing” open teaching is built based on Visual C++6.0. This system is to cooperate with the teaching content of CIM, but also to improve the practical ability of students, so that they can more easily and quickly understand some of the more complex digital signal theory. The timing of the beam position signal is optimized based on the existing down sampling method, and the digital AGC and slow application signal processing modules are completed. We need to get turn-by-turn, quick application, and track closing data simultaneously. The experiment shows that the system can obtain the multi-frequency position information including the actual running state well. The advantages of this system are easy to control parameters, easy to use, and strong expansibility. This project plans to further improve the system in the future research work so as to achieve better teaching and practical application purposes.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Inspection Image Intelligent Diagnosis System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper introduces the image diagnosis technology of power inspection based on computer vision. Image import, database access, text output and other functional modules are designed using VisualStudio2010. ADO technology is used to access and change the database. The framework and method of diagnosis result fusion based on multidimensional fusion are proposed. The fault diagnosis criterion of the system is established by using genetic algorithm. Under the premise of ensuring the optimal solution, the key information is retained and the minimum expression of knowledge is obtained, so as to realize the rapid and accurate fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that the method is effective, fast and suitable for large-scale power grid, especially for transmission lines. Low error rate and friendly man-machine interface. It can meet the needs of power line inspection. The automatic inspection of the transmission line image is realized, which standardizes the working process and greatly improves the working efficiency.

articleTitle: Processing of Speech Signals Based on MATLAB & FDAtool
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the speech signal with noise in the communication, the paper proposes a method to reduce the noise of speech signal based on MATLAB & FDAtool. FDAtool is a GUI interface, which has the characteristics of graphic visualization, intuitive and effective to analysis of the system frequency spectrum. By analysis the time and frequency domain characteristics of speech and the noise signal, it makes use of the FDAtool and window functions to design the FIR filter to process the speech signal. The design results show that the combination of window function and FDAtool can effective perform signal processing and reduce the noise.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Intelligent Laboratory Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT) and the prevalence of intelligent management modes, this paper explores the application of the Intelligent Laboratory Management System (ILMS) in university laboratories. It introduces the design concept of the ILMS and presents numerous examples aimed at addressing the fundamental challenges in traditional laboratory management, including manpower shortage, safety issues, fund utilization, and fault repair. Integrating this system into university laboratory management practices can improve the quality and efficiency of the teaching process.

articleTitle: Application of Unity Simulation System and Virtual Interactive System in the Design of Brick Making Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper aims at the problems such as low safety and poor worker participation in the safety practice teaching process of the traditional machinery industry. In this paper, a virtual simulation system of a small flying ash processing brick-making machine is developed based on Unity platform, which realizes the complete simulation of the overall appearance of the device, its disassembly process and equipment operation, which can promote workers in related industries to understand the equipment and help enterprises to train workers. At the same time, the design of simple and convenient UI interface can help workers to understand and review the operating principle and mechanical structure of the device on the computer, and provide high similarity, high safety system and dynamic simulation training means for enterprise training personnel.

articleTitle: Research on the Life Evaluation of Domestically Produced Components Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article introduces the demand for domestically produced components in key projects and the current situation of domestically produced components. It discusses the challenges faced by life evaluation technology for domestically produced components from two aspects: the limitations of traditional time-to-failure testing methods based on probabilistic statistics and the development of new materials and processes. Based on this, combined with the latest trends in life evaluation technology, it proposes research on failure mechanisms of domestically produced components, dynamic degradation testing methods based on sensitive parameters, and exploratory data analysis methods. By using computer-based Monte Carlo methods to expand and utilize existing sample information for numerical simulation analysis, it estimates the confidence limits of the lifetime distribution F(t) of the test results, breaks through certain key rapid life evaluation technologies for domestically produced components, and solves the drawbacks of long testing time and a large number of test samples in traditional life evaluation technology.

articleTitle: Study on Digital Construction System of Changbai Mountain Manchu Paper-Cut by Computer Application of Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of digital expression, content retrieval and cultural calculation of traditional Manchu paper-cut patterns in Changbai Mountain area, an XML-based information storage model was proposed. This method can not only transform paper-cut images into XML format, but also provide the basis for paper-cut content retrieval, data mining and cultural operation. The deformation technique of TPS image and the MLS transform technique based on surface are presented. Take the input decoupage as the source image, and take a photo that needs to be generated decoupage style as the target image, the source image is deformed by the deformation algorithm according to the calibrated feature points to obtain the paper-cut style painting with the characteristics of the target image. The validity and advantages of the existing cultural rule mining methods are evaluated by verifying them. The experiment proves that by adding the required structure and characteristics, the constructed database can provide support for data mining and humanistic computing. The design ideas of the model in this paper are also applicable to other non-text resources.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Operation Monitoring System for Air Supply System of EMU Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: An operation monitoring system based on digital twin technology is researched and proposed aiming at the problem that it is difficult to accurately assess the performance status of the air supply system of EMU due to insufficient historical data, lack of a standardized fault data collection mechanism and mature technical means of quality monitoring and management. Taking the digital twin five-dimensional model as the theoretical basis, the architecture system of the air supply system operation monitoring system is constructed. The geometric kinematics and dynamics are modeled to create the virtual simulation model. The digital twin system based on the joint simulation of ADAMS and AMESim is designed. The visualization platform for the operation monitoring system for the air supply system of EMU based on digital twin is developed using Python language. This study can provide reference for the design and development of the operation monitoring system for the air supply system of EMU.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection Method for Insulation Faults in Low Voltage Electrical Systems Based on Deep Confidence Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of electrical systems and the advancement of intelligence, rapid and accurate detection of insulation faults has become one of the important tasks to ensure the safe operation of electrical systems. This study proposes an intelligent detection method for insulation faults in low-voltage electrical systems based on deep confidence networks. This method collects relevant data, preprocesses the data, and extracts features. This paper utilizes deep confidence networks for feature learning and classification to achieve rapid and accurate detection of different insulation fault types. The experimental results indicate that this method can effectively detect insulation faults and ensure the safe operation of the electrical system. This method is easy to be implemented, highly reliable, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Design of Financial Risk Warning System Based on AI Algorithm and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Financial system risk warning is a crucial area of study in the financial sector. The advent of artificial intelligence technology has made machine learning-based risk warning for the financial system a popular research focus. This study examines early warnings for financial system risks using machine learning, with the goal of offering valuable insights and approaches to risk management in the finance industry. It begins by presenting an overview of the importance and relevance of financial system risk warnings, as well as the utilization of machine learning within finance. Traditional statistical methods have limitations, which has led to the development of a particle system through AI and deep learning algorithms in neural network financial distress early warning model. This model offers strong information timeliness and high prediction accuracy rates for test samples. The empirical findings demonstrate that this model provides favorable prediction effects and outperforms traditional models in terms of effectiveness. It is suggested that the particle swarm optimization BP neural network proposed in this study offers a suitable solution for discriminating and predicting enterprise financial distress.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation in Liquor Supply - Full Lifecycle Intelligent Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The paper introduces an intelligent control system utilizing industrial internet, AI, and big data technologies to digitize the entire lifecycle of liquor production. Comprising flavor recommendation, product distribution, and purchase delivery applications, it enhances customer experience and operational efficiency. The fla vor recommendation app uses data fusion and fuzzy neural networks to suggest suitable alcoholic beverage flavors, while the product distribution app manages inventory and production, improving supply chain efficiency. The purchase delivery app facilitates online sales and prompt delivery, enhancing customer purchasing experience and increasing sales revenue. These interconnected apps optimize customer experience, operational efficiency, and support the liquor industry's digital transformation.

articleTitle: Power Load Forecasting Based on CNN-LSTM Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Power load has played a crucial role in power system, and its accuracy directly affects power supply and demand balance and system stability. For the sake of enhance the accuracy of power load prediction, we propose a power load prediction model that integrates the spatiotemporal feature extraction by convolutional neural network (CNN) and the modeling of sequence data by long and short time memory network (LSTM). The model comprehensively describes the law of power load data by combining spatiotemporal information. First, the historical power load data is convolved by convolutional layer to extract local features in space. Then, the extracted feature sequence is input into the LSTM layer to form the time sequence dependence of the power load. Finally, the pre-training model is fine-tuned using the measured data, the target model is obtained and the prediction data is generated. To assess the efficacy of this model, a comparative analysis was conducted against both the BP neural network and LSTM model. The experimental findings indicate that, in comparison with the BP neural network and LSTM model, the RMSE measure of CNN-LSTM model is reduced by 16.12% and 7.57%, respectively. The correlations between the predicted values and the measured values of the three models were 0.897, 0.911 and 0.923, respectively. It shows that CNN-LSTM model has better performance than traditional forecasting methods in power load forecasting and has potential application and prospect.

articleTitle: Research on the Applicability of Modern Tram Based on TOPSIS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In addressing the question of whether modern trams are suitable for local conditions in China, a rigorous study was undertaken, exploring the applicability of modern trams through the utilization of the TOPSIS algorithm. Initially, the distinct characteristics of trams were meticulously outlined. Subsequently, using the TOPSIS algorithm, a comparative analysis was conducted, ranking modern trams alongside other modes of transportation, including subways, light rail, ART, BRT, and traditional public transportation. This comparative evaluation allowed for a comprehensive understanding of the relative strengths and weaknesses of modern trams in comparison to other modes. Furthermore, the current operational status of modern rail transit in China was thoroughly examined. This analysis encompassed an exploration of the reasons behind the dismantling of certain tram lines, offering insights into the challenges faced by this mode of transportation in the Chinese context. Finally, a focused analysis was conducted on the scenarios where modern trams could potentially be most suitable and effective. This comprehensive study not only contributes to the understanding of modern trams' adaptability in China but also provides valuable insights for future transportation planning and development.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Cutting Force Coefficient Predictions Based on the BP Neural Network in Slot Milling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Cutting force coefficient is an important parameter for dynamic cutting force obtained with the method of analytics. A prediction model for dynamic cutting force coefficient based on BP neural network is proposed. Firstly, the dynamic cutting force coefficient under typical process parameters is carried out with slot milling. The obtained results are as the sample data of the model. Secondly, a 24-node BP neural network model with double hidden layers is designed. Finally, the designed BP neural network model is used to predict the dynamic cutting force coefficients in the milling process. The prediction result shows that the errors are basically within a reasonable range. The accuracy rate of the predictions reaches as low as 20 %. The absolute error value of the prediction results is absolutely small.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization of Full Flow Test Process of Emergency Feed Pump for Nuclear Power Plant with Automatic Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Primary water supply is a core component in the second circuit of nuclear power plant, which is directly related to the safety and economy of the primary circuit. Considering the importance of the main supply pump in the power plant and the urgent vibration problem, it is urgent to study and deal with the fault of the main supply pump in order to solve the vibration warning problem that has occurred in the power plant. Effective regulation and improvement can prevent serious safety accidents caused by the spread of oscillation. This will reduce the downtime of nuclear power plants, maintenance spare parts and labor costs. In this paper, process parameters such as fluid flow and pressure are used in the process, combined with vibration state characteristics such as time domain and frequency domain, multi-parameter information with flow and pressure process parameters as working state variables is constructed, and a new method of multi-parameter fusion is constructed. This provides an early warning of the operating status of the equipment. Finally, based on the health information of equipment, this paper uses mechanical-personalized modeling to generate individualized equipment training samples. With personalized training samples as input, the diagnosis model based on deep CNN is trained to realize intelligent diagnosis of equipment.

articleTitle: Selection and Application of Mechanical Characteristics Tester for High Voltage Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the parameter definition, measurement principle, measurement parameter calculation method, and on-site testing circuit wiring method of the high-voltage circuit breaker mechanical characteristic tester. At the same time, we sort out the problems encountered in the application of the instrument and the corresponding solutions, providing technical reference for on-site testing personnel.

articleTitle: Research on Inverted Pendulum Control Based on Cascade Fuzzy Control and Neural Network Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of precise control of single-stage inverted pendulum system is deeply discussed and practiced. The dynamic modeling and simulation of the inverted pendulum system were carried out in the course of the experiment, and the whole process of the inverted pendulum control was vividly reproduced by visual means, which enhanced the intuitiveness and effectiveness of the model design and control strategy analysis. In the design of control strategy, two advanced methods of neural network control and cascade fuzzy control are combined. The neural network controller uses its powerful nonlinear mapping ability and self-learning characteristics to approximate the complex dynamic behavior of the inverted pendulum system in real time and accurately. The cascade fuzzy controller realizes the hierarchical fine control of the Angle and angular velocity of the inverted pendulum through the upper and lower two-level control system, which improves the stability and robustness of the control system. After a series of rigorous experimental testing and optimization adjustment, the control output curve and the response curve of inverted pendulum state under different control methods are obtained successfully. Through the comparative analysis of these results, the advantages of the comprehensive scheme based on cascade fuzzy control and neural network control in improving the stable equilibrium time of inverted pendulum, reducing the overthrow amplitude and enhancing the anti-disturbance ability are revealed, and the effectiveness and superiority of the control strategy are verified, providing a new idea and reference for the theoretical research and practical application of inverted pendulum control.

articleTitle: Research on the Acoustic Properties of Sandwich-Type Radial Ultrasonic Transducer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper explores deeply into the acoustic characteristics of radial ultrasonic transducers employed for detecting defects in concrete pile foundations. A simulation model, comprising three layers—a matching layer, a backing layer, and a piezoelectric layer—is constructed based on the structural parameters of sandwich-type radial ultrasonic transducers. Modal analysis yields the radial vibration model under the fourth order mode. Linear regression analysis of simulated data on transducer surface displacement reveals excellent linearity of response within the excitation voltage range of 20 to 200V. The acoustic directivity characteristics of the ultrasonic transducer are explored by calculating the acoustic pressure of sound waves in water. Diagrams of relative sound pressure level beam radiation patterns in the x-y plane and the y-z plane demonstrate omni-directional in the horizontal plane and symmetrical 90° beam angles in the vertical plane. A circular field is established, and based on the external field calculation of acoustic radiation power, a 90° axisymmetric beam is detected within the space. Experimental verification of the axisymmetric beam's acoustic properties is carried out using a pair of ultrasonic transducers.

articleTitle: A Wafer Scratch Detection Method for Correction and Completing Results of Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The complex manufacturing process of wafers often results in scratches on the wafer surface, leading to defects that can affect the electrical characteristics of packaged components. While semantic segmentation can identify these defects, it often leads to problems such as scratch incompletion and disconnection, which hinder subsequent defect tracing and other related work. This paper proposes a complementary method for detecting typical scratches to address these challenges. The proposed method filters out noise points in the semantic segmentation results using clustering, obtains the position information of the straight line scratches by fitting, and iteratively judges the endpoints of the straight line based on the fitted straight line to obtain the complete line segment. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms semantic segmentation in solving scratch detection problems, achieving excellent defect correction and completion effects.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Multi-Objective Optimization Algorithm in Dietary Collocation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the dietary collocation method based on multi-objective evolutionary algorithm will be introduced. Firstly, the dietary collocation problem based on multi-objective evolution is described, the recipe structure and food database are defined, the cost evaluation model is given, and the solution space of the recipe recommendation problem is established; then new domination strategies are defined for the food collocation problem in order to find the non-dominated solutions in the evolutionary process; the methods used for the dietary collocation updating strategy are defined based on gene mutation and crossover; finally, the algorithm used in this paper is compared with two mainstream multi-objective evolutionary algorithms to prove the effectiveness of the algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Trading Strategy Based on Long and Short Time Memory Network and Backtesting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent decades, financial quantification has emerged and matured rapidly. For financial institutions such as funds, investment institutions are increasingly dissatisfied with the situation of passively constructing investment portfolios with average market returns, and are paying more and more attention to active quantitative strategy investment portfolios. This requires the introduction of active stock investment fund management models. Currently, in my country's stock fund investment market, there are many active quantitative investment strategies, and the algorithms used vary widely, such as SVM, random forest, RNN recurrent memory network, etc. This article focuses on this trend, using the emerging LSTM-GRU gate-controlled long short-term memory network model in the field of financial stock investment as a basis to build a set of active investment stock strategies, and combining it with SVM, which has been widely used in the field of quantitative stock investment. Comparing models such as RNN, theoretically speaking, compared to SVM that simply relies on kernel functions for high-order mapping and classification of data, neural network algorithms such as RNN and LSTM-GRU have better principles and are more suitable for processing financial stock data. Then, through multiple By comparison, it was finally found that the LSTM-GRU gate-controlled long short-term memory network has a better accuracy. By selecting the LSTM-GRU algorithm to construct a trading strategy based on the Shanghai and Shenzhen 300 Index constituent stocks, the parameters were adjusted and the neural layer connection was adjusted. Finally, it has significantly outperformed the benchmark index CSI 300 over the long term. The conclusion of this article is that the research results can provide certain quantitative strategy references for financial institutions to construct active stock investment portfolios.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection and Classification Based on Image Recognition Techniques and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this study, a high-performance vehicle recognition and classification model is constructed based on convolutional neural network technology by using the image features of the license plate and Haar cascade detector to locate the location of the license plate, and it has achieved remarkable results in practical applications. The intersection and concurrency ratio of the model is as high as 0.9247, meanwhile, the recall rate reaches 0.9502, which proves that the model has a very high comprehensiveness and a low false alarm rate in detecting various types of vehicle instances. In addition, the Kappa coefficient reaches 0.9342, which further validates the consistency and accuracy advantage of the model on the classification task. This research result provides strong algorithmic support for real-time vehicle identification and accurate classification in intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: A Method for Generating Carbon Footprint Inventory of Substation Engineering Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The method for generating carbon footprint inventory of substation engineering based on knowledge graph can ensure that all entities in the inventory have effective emission factors, and that the materials and machinery in the inventory can be traced back to their respective lifecycle stages and sub projects based on the knowledge graph relationship, providing favorable support for carbon reduction in the later stage. This method takes the lifecycle process of substation engineering from cradle to gate as the object, and extracts knowledge and constructs a knowledge graph for the material entities and mechanical entities and relationships of sub projects of substation carbon footprint engineering, as well as existing emission factors. Based on the concept level seed set, whether the entities have emission factors, and the priority of emission factor attributes, entity alignment is carried out. The final layer of entities after entity alignment is completed, which is the carbon footprint list of substation engineering. Finally, the effectiveness of this method was verified using steel used in substation engineering as an example.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Optimization of Photovoltaic Distribution Network Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the case of distribution systems characterized by a significant share of grid-connected photovoltaic installations, voltage issues can arise, primarily manifested as voltage fluctuations and elevations. When the output of PV generation is higher or lower than the demand of the distribution network, it can cause voltage fluctuations in the grid, especially when the PV generation is high and the electricity load is low, potentially elevating the grid voltage beyond the normal operating range. Furthermore, the intermittency and uncertainty of PV generation add complexity to the operation of the grid, posing challenges to its stability and safety. Therefore, effective management and regulation of PV integration into the distribution network are crucial for ensuring stable grid operation. The present paper establishes a mathematical model for optimizing reactive power compensation in the distribution network of photovoltaic power stations. It aims to minimize network losses as the primary objective, taking into account limitations related to active power, reactive power, and voltage. The model accounts for the reactive power regulation capability of grid-connected PV station inverters and employs the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to solve the proposed reactive power optimization model. Finally, a typical IEEE-33 bus test case verifies the effectiveness of the proposed reactive power optimization model.

articleTitle: Precise Movement Control of Agricultural Robot Car Based on PID Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Proportional integral derivative (PID) algorithm control is the most common control method in robot control, and agricultural harvesting robots have been a very popular robot application in recent years. This algorithm can achieve precise movement of the car, thereby promoting the implementation of robot automation for picking. This article utilizes the simulation function in Simulink in Matlab software to explore the impact of different parameter choices in the PID process on control effectiveness. Based on the analysis of the results, appropriate parameters for the proportional, integral, and differential links were ultimately obtained, and ideal control effects were achieved. In the discussion section, this article gradually analyzed the role of each link in PID control and the different values of parameters that can lead to different control results. Based on the research results obtained, there are still many challenges and opportunities surrounding of intelligent agricultural robot. This article provides some suggestions for the future development and improvement of PID algorithm control, so that it can be applied to more complex situations and continue to explore new research directions and application scenarios. Through such efforts, it's believed that the intelligence of agricultural robot will become an important development direction in the future agricultural production field.

articleTitle: A High Sensitivity Capacitive Pressure Sensor Based on Inclined Column Dielectric Layer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, tactile sensors made from capacitive pressure sensors have been widely used in intelligent robots and other fields. Among them, sensitivity is one of the most important indicators of capacitive pressure sensors. In order to improve the sensitivity of capacitive pressure sensors, based on the analysis of the current research on the sensitivity of capacitive pressure sensors, we use the electromechanical module of COMSOL for modeling to simulate the response of the capacitance and displacement of different dielectric layer microstructures under external pressure. The study addresses the response to external pressure and analyzes the sensitivity for geometrical parameters of the columns (e.g., radius, height, tilt angle) and for different array distributions. This study provides a valuable theoretical basis for the design and application of capacitive pressure sensors in the future, which can help to improve the performance of capacitive pressure sensors and provide a theoretical basis for and their design and preparation.

articleTitle: Cross-Modal Hyperbolic Subspace Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
