abstract: Fault diagnosis is difficult to determine intrinsic locality relationships of multi-modal fault data. Aiming at the issue, we propose a novel cross-modal hyperbolic subspace fault diagnosis method. In the method, we construct a cross-modal hyperbolic subspace learning model by integrating local correlation theory and hyperbolic space learning, and the model can solve the local distortion of the Euclidean space manifolds. Besides, we derive analytical solutions of the model by means of Lagrange multiplier, and the cross-modal fault features with good class separability can be obtained by space projection. Experiments on the Paderborn dataset shows the effectiveness of our method in cross-modal fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Protection Technology Based on Honeypot Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this era of rapid development of information technology, more and more industries are beginning to use information systems to improve the efficiency of their own industries. Websites exposed to the Internet are also springing up like mushrooms after a rain, showing a trend of prosperity and rapid development. While informatization brings convenience to people, the risk of being attacked is also increasing day by day. In the face of possible threats, most website builders still stick to the traditional model of protection. That is, preparing protective software and passively wait for network attacks to be protected. However, as technology is constantly updated, attack methods are becoming more and more diverse. In the face of endless attack methods, just using protection software to passively protect is no longer able to fully adapt to complex network attack scenarios. This article attempts to perform protection operations from a new angle and compares it with the traditional passive protection mode to provide a new reference for network security protection in all walks of life.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Test Management Software for Large-Scale and Complex Equipment Based on ATML
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In response to the increasingly complex challenges in the development and implementation process of large-scale complex equipment testing, we have designed and implemented a collaborative testing management software based on A TML. This software, built using the Java language and SSM framework, adheres to the ATML standard to formulate XML test task descriptions, thereby providing an efficient testing management platform. Through this platform, users can easily manage equipment testing tasks, achieve collaborative execution of tasks, and centralized management of results, greatly enhancing testing efficiency and accuracy. This software not only streamlines the testing process but also provides reliable data analysis and reporting capabilities, offering reliable support and assurance for the development and implementation of complex equipment.

articleTitle: Circulation Suppression of Parallel Inverters Based on Improved Virtual Oscillator Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The grid forming control based on virtual oscillator has been widely studied and applied in the control of interconnected inverters in the parallel system. However, on the one hand, the third harmonic content in the output voltage of VOC inverters is relatively high; On the other hand, the difference in line impedance leads to circulating currents between inverters, resulting in low operational efficiency of the system. Therefore, this paper adopts an improved virtual oscillator control to reduce the third harmonic in the inverter voltage, and further introduces a virtual impedance loop to reduce the circulating current. Simulation and experiments have shown that this strategy can effectively suppress the third harmonic in the voltage and reduce the circulating current in the system.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Student Management System Based on Blockchain Technology in District Computers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Computer blockchain technology provides a possible means to enhance data security, transparency, and overall efficiency. This study focuses on the design and optimization ideas of using blockchain technology in student management systems. The architecture plan for this system was developed during the design phase, emphasizing the use of smart contracts to automate registration, classification, and authentication processes, as well as decentralized data storage and encrypted hashing of irreversible records. License blockchain can be used to provide privacy protection and access restrictions, ensuring that student data is secure and accessible to authorized parties. The goal of optimizing the solution is to improve scalability and transaction speed, while reducing the amount of energy used in traditional blockchain systems. The improvement of consensus algorithms and second layer extension technologies such as sidechain or off chain protocols can achieve faster data processing without compromising security. In addition, metadata management and advanced encryption technologies have improved system performance and minimized data to the greatest extent possible.

articleTitle: Design of Freeway Emergency Car Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Based on STM32 microprocessor, this paper designed a Bluetooth car that could call for emergency help after a car crash. The trolley could remotely control the legal and compliant installation of the tripod when the car failed. The device used camera module to collect road condition information. When the device detected a collision, it used the GSM module to send emergency call information and the longitude and latitude of the accident location to the pre-stored number. The owner could also choose to use Bluetooth to control the car, so as to realize the function of automatic installation and recovery of tripod in different weather. The device greatly ensured the timely detection of the driver's life when the traffic accident was critical, it provided convenience for the safe placement of the trig, and laid a theoretical and practical foundation for the automation and intelligence of traffic development.

articleTitle: Wearable Pressure Sensors and Their Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, people are quickly entering the information age. The situation makes the demand for accurate information stronger and stronger. Meanwhile, the expectation and idealization of the performance parameters of the measurement information range, accuracy and stability are gradually increasing, especially in some harsh environments. The requirement for gas, pressure, humidity and other information is particularly prominent. Traditional electronic strain sensors are mostly based on metal and semiconductor materials, and their portability, flexibility and wearable characteristics are poor. With the rapid development of flexible electronic materials and sensing technology, the application of flexible strain sensors in various cutting-edge tech has attracted more and more attention. With the rapid development of flexible materials, flexible pressure sensors currently have a series of advantages such as transparent, flexible, malleable, bendable and foldable, portable, wearable, good biocompatibility, real-time monitoring, and non-invasive. It shines in fields like medical devices, fitness sports, electronic skin, robotics, and aerospace.

articleTitle: Momentum Study Based on CRITIC Evaluation Method and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the evaluation and prediction of sports competition results, and uses the methods of feature extraction, CRITIC weighted analysis and machine learning algorithm to discuss and analyze. First, after data preprocessing, the dimension of column data is reduced by feature extraction and the evaluation index is obtained. These metrics are then weighted using the CRITIC method to obtain a measure of quantified performance. Secondly, the correlation analysis model is introduced to prove the existence of momentum. Finally, by comparing the performance of XGBoost, Extra Trees and Random Forest algorithm in training and prediction, it is found that XGBoost algorithm has the best performance in AUC of test set, reaching 95.05%. The XGBoost parameters were further optimized by Bayesian optimization, and the signal was reconstructed by combining wavelet analysis to improve the accuracy and robustness of the model.

articleTitle: Design and Development of VR-Based Psychological Problem Intervention System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of virtual reality (VR) technology, people have begun to pay more and more attention to its application in the field of psychological intervention. In view of the existing intervention programs for mental illness, this study designed and developed a psychological problem intervention system based on virtual reality technology, aiming to assist patients with mental illness in rehabilitation training. According to the requirements of professional psychological testing, the system conducts various behavioral tests such as psychological, physical and verbal tests for patients in a virtual reality environment, providing important guidance strategies for psychologists. This paper introduces in detail the architecture and key technologies of the psychological intervention system based on virtual reality technology, and puts forward the system evaluation and optimization strategies. Finally, the research results are summarized and the future research directions are prospected.

articleTitle: Research on Prefabricated Building Decision Support System Using Artificial Intelligence and Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper studies the intelligent aided decision making based on Web and building information modeling. Then, based on the network global information network and functional components, this paper builds a network BIM platform. Then, the new idea of energy cost increase control based on life cycle of prefabricated buildings is studied. By analyzing the cost increase of the whole process of prefabricated house construction, the corresponding increment index is obtained. The project cost is predicted by using grey system method based on the building information model. By integrating the increment index with the cost growth index, a dynamic model of cost growth is established. By using this model, the correlation rules among various cost growth indices are obtained. This method is improved to control the increase of energy consumption cost in the whole construction process. The decision results of this method are verified from the perspectives of shock resistance and value index. It is proved that the theory and algorithm proposed in this project are feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Early Warning Mechanism of Colleges and Universities Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the potential risks and early warning problems in the financial management of Chinese colleges and universities are deeply discussed. With the continuous expansion of the scale of higher education and the increasing complexity of the financial environment, the construction of a scientific, accurate and efficient financial early warning system has become an important issue in the financial management of colleges and universities. This paper first analyzes the main types and formation mechanism of financial risk in colleges and universities, and then introduces the theoretical basis and advantages of neural network model in detail, especially its powerful ability in dealing with nonlinear relations, pattern recognition and prediction, which provides new solutions and technical means for financial early warning in colleges and universities. On this basis, this paper designs and implements a college financial early warning model based on deep neural network. Through training and verification of a large number of college financial data, it realizes real-time monitoring and early warning of college financial risks. The empirical study shows that the model can effectively capture the internal correlation among various financial indicators and accurately predict the possible financial crisis, so as to provide timely and accurate risk decision-making basis for university management.

articleTitle: Lake Water Flow Optimization Study Based on NCA Algorithm and SARIMAX Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, firstly, a Great Lakes network flow model with lakes as nodes is established, and based on the multi-constraint optimization algorithm, the optimal water level of the Great Lakes for 12 months is obtained. Second, the optimal river flow scheduling model is constructed to obtain the optimal flow of each river for 12 months per year; then, the sensitivity analysis of the dam-controlled flow of the St. Mary's River and the St. Lawrence River is carried out. The results show that the control algorithm has obvious advantages. Finally, a time series prediction model was used to obtain predictions of future water levels in Lake Ontario for subsequent water level management.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Model of Feature Extraction Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Neural networks with relatively shallow layers and simple structures may have limited ability in accurately identifying pneumonia. In addition, deep neural networks also have a large demand for computing resources, which may cause convolutional neural networks to be unable to be implemented on terminals. Therefore, this paper will carry out the optimal classification of convolutional neural networks. Firstly, according to the characteristics of pneumonia images, AlexNet and InceptionV3 were selected to obtain better image recognition results. Combining the features of medical images, the forward neural network with deeper and more complex structure is learned. Finally, knowledge extraction technology is used to extract the obtained data into the AlexNet model to achieve the purpose of improving computing efficiency and reducing computing costs. The results showed that the prediction accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity of the trained AlexNet model increased by 4.25 percentage points, 7.85 percentage points, and 2.32 percentage points respectively. The graphics processing usage has decreased by 51% compared to the InceptionV3 mode.

articleTitle: Localizing Action Moments with Dual-Guidance Augmented Discriminability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Temporal action detection (TAD) aims at locating the action boundaries and recognizing their categories among video action clips. However, vague boundary predictions suffer from quick switches of short action moments. At the same time, due to the vulnerable boundaries cheated by similar video backgrounds altering instead of the motion, the model's fine-grained discrimination is highly reliant on the background. To mitigate these issues, we present a novel dual-guidance graph-based architecture, dubbed as dual-guidance self-augmented graph network (DSGN). Specifically, we first exploit an effective expansion approach, inserting a full zero gap sequence between the original feature and the enhanced feature to eliminate the effect and increase the localization accuracy of short action boundaries. Then, a relational dual-aggregation method is designed to integrate two levels of context representations, namely, the local fragment-level feature and the global video-level feature, into the target proposal-level feature, based on their attention correlations according to the self-attention mechanism, to augment the destination proposal clip. We demonstrate that our model outperforms other state-of-the-art methods experimentally on HACS, ActivityNet vI.3 and FineActions.

articleTitle: From Features to Decisions: Analysis of Transformer Frameworks for Bitcoin Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This research comprehensively evaluates the performance of eight Transformer-based frameworks in Bitcoin price prediction and backtest trading. A novel comprehensive scoring index is proposed, which combines nine key performance indicators. Each model's performance is quantified and ranked using this index. Furthermore, the impact of different feature combinations on model performance is analyzed by identifying the top 10 optimal feature combinations for each model. The Apriori algorithm is applied to mine frequent feature combinations and generate high-confidence association rules, providing valuable insights for feature selection. The results show that the Convolutional Transformer framework achieves the highest overall performance, outperforming other models in terms of annualized return, Sharpe ratio, and feature adaptability. The feature combination analysis reveals three features frequently appear in the top combinations of multiple models, highlighting their importance in Bitcoin price prediction. This research contributes to the understanding of Transformer-based models' performance and characteristics in cryptocurrency market forecasting, guiding researchers and practitioners in framework selection and feature engineering.

articleTitle: Gray Wolf Optimization Algorithm-Based Inversion Model Study of Corn Chlorophyll Content
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The chlorophyll content of corn leaves can accurately reflect the growth status of corn, thus the inversion model of chlorophyll content for large-scale field in-situ corn is particularly important for monitoring corn growth. This study focuses on field corn and investigates the chlorophyll content inversion algorithms during the jointing stage, tasseling stage, milking stage, and maturity Stage of corn. Multispectral data of corn canopies were collected using drones in the experimental field as the research data source. Twenty-one vegetation indices were calculated for the main growth stages of corn, and the primary vegetation indices affecting chlorophyll content during each major growth stage were determined through the least squares method. Combining the true measured values of chlorophyll content collected on the ground, four regression algorithms—Adaptive Boosting, Bagging Regression, Extremely Randomized Trees, and Random Forest—were utilized to construct in-situ chlorophyll content inversion algorithms for corn populations. Furthermore, the Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) was employed to optimize the regression model parameters to enhance inversion accuracy. The results indicate that the primary vegetation indices influencing corn chlorophyll content vary during each major growth stage. Bagging Regression and Random Forest Regression exhibit stable and good performance in chlorophyll content inversion using vegetation indices. The GWO algorithm has been proven effective in optimizing the parameters of the regression models, further improving the accuracy of the inversion. Therefore, by combining various primary vegetation indices obtained from drone multispectral data and the optimized regression models through the GWO algorithm, we can achieve rapid estimation of chlorophyll content during the main growth stages of corn, meeting the application requirements for in-situ monitoring of corn population growth.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Clothing Matching Recommendation Algorithm Combining Deep Learning and Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper explores an innovative intelligent clothing matching recommendation system that combines image recognition technology and deep learning methods to provide personalized clothing matching recommendations. In this paper, a CNSM model combining CNN and LSTM is proposed. First, CNSM automatically extracts key features of clothing uploaded by users through image recognition technology. These features serve as inputs to the deep learning model and are used to train the model to recognize and learn effective clothing matching rules. In terms of detailed technical implementation, the study first uses advanced image processing technology (convolutional neural network) to analyze the clothing pictures provided by users and automatically extract the key visual features of the clothing. This step is the basis for the system to understand the attributes and styles of clothing, and provides the necessary information for subsequent matching recommendations. Then, the study uses long short-term memory network (LSTM) to process the extracted features and learn the matching relationship between clothing. These models can learn complex collocation rules and user preferences from a large number of collocation data and realize personalized recommendation. Through a series of experiments, the effectiveness of the proposed system is verified. The experimental results show that the recommendation system can accurately identify clothing features and generate matching suggestions based on these features that meet users' individual needs and fashion trends.

articleTitle: Optimization Scheduling Method for Electric Vehicle Swapping Stations Based on Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The traditional scheduling strategy based on the predicted value of battery swapping demand faces difficulties in adapting to dynamic interference factors and accumulating prediction errors in practical applications. To solve the above problems, from the perspective of the exchange station operator, this paper establishes the active control capability of the standby battery pack load in the station, and proposes a recursive method for the load margin band of the battery pack in the station in the future. On the basis of meeting the demand for battery swapping, a process for formulating the charging plan of the battery swapping station operator is proposed based on the target load determined according to the operation requirements of the power grid, to achieve reasonable regulation of the charging time and quantity of the backup battery pack, and to achieve the economic and efficient operation of the battery swapping station. At the same time, utilizing the load of battery packs in electric vehicle swapping stations can achieve the balance of regional load characteristics and meet the needs of power grid operation.

articleTitle: Application Research of Image Classification Based on Convolutional Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Image classification is of great significance for subsequent image analysis and processing, mining image value information and so on. Aiming at the problem of image classification, this paper proposes an image classification model based on convolutional neural network. In this model, a CNN network structure is constructed, which includes two convolutional layers, two pooling layers and three fully connected layers. The convolution and pooling layers use the ReLU function as the activation function to avoid the vanishing gradient problem. Softmax is selected as the model classifier so that it can automate feature extraction and avoid the tedious manual feature extraction process. The experimental results on the CIFAR-10 public dataset show that the classification accuracy of the image classification model based on convolutional neural network constructed in this paper can reach nearly 80%, which is more than 20% higher than the accuracy of SVM and KNN methods.

articleTitle: Research Progress on Data Pricing Models for the Data Element Market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The data element market is a product of the digital age, in which the reasonable pricing of data is crucial. This paper reviews the research progress of data pricing models in the data element market. Firstly, the background and significance of data pricing are introduced, and the importance of data in today's digital economy is expounded. Secondly, in view of the challenges and needs of data pricing model, the research direction and main content of data pricing model are summarized. Then, several typical data pricing models are analyzed in detail, including methods based on information entropy, machine learning, query, etc. Finally, the current research status of models is summarized, the advantages, disadvantages and development trends of various models are pointed out, and the difficulties and problems that need further research are put forward. The purpose of the paper is to systematically sort out the research status of data pricing model, and provide theoretical support and methodological guidance for the development of data element market.

articleTitle: Intelligent Pick-Up of Drilling Logs Based on NLP Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Drilling logs are crucial documents in petroleum engineering that record geological information, operational parameters, and technical data. They contain a wealth of unstructured textual information, which is essential for optimizing drilling strategies, evaluating production potential, and ensuring operational safety. However, manually interpreting these documents is time-consuming, laborious, and prone to subjective bias. This paper proposes an NLP-based method for automatic analysis of drilling operation efficiency, exploring how to intelligently extract key useful information, identify critical geological features by training models, evaluate drilling efficiency, and predict drilling accident complexity through automation. Experimental results demonstrate that NLP achieves a recognition rate of 99.8% in the intelligent extraction technology of drilling logs, filling a domestic gap and having broad development prospects.

articleTitle: Research on the Around View Image System of Cable Winding Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, the demand for construction vehicles is increasing. The operating environment of open-pit mines is complex, and the cable reel truck is so large that it is difficult to ensure safety only by relying on the rearview mirror. A panoramic surround-view image system can provide real-time overlooking images around the cable reeler body, effectively eliminating the blind spot in the field of vision, and providing very effective assistance to the remote operator. This paper analyzes the background and key technologies of the panoramic surround-view image system and gives a specific implementation plan according to the actual characteristics of the cable reeling truck. The system uses six fisheye cameras to capture images around the cable reeling truck because the captured images have fisheye distortion, so the images are firstly distortion-corrected, and then the corrected images are converted to top view by perspective transformation, and finally, the six images are spliced and fused. The experiment proves that the fusion algorithm correction of gradual-in and gradual-out can meet the system requirements. It effectively reduces the algorithm's complexity and has good application prospects and value.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation and Recognition of Oracle Bone Topographies Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Image segmentation and recognition of oracle bone topography is a common challenge for in-depth study of oracle bones. The key lies in how to accurately and efficiently process and recognize the original oracle bone topography images and solve the practical problems in the research based on the image digitization results. The research of this topic helps to promote the research of oracle bone holography and the construction of digitization project. Image segmentation of oracle bone tablet is to use digital image processing and computer vision technology to extract independent text regions with distinctive image features and non-overlapping each other in the complex background of the original topographic image. The study of automatic segmentation and recognition of oracle bone characters on original topos has important social significance. In this paper, the image preprocessing model based on the channel attention mechanism is firstly utilized to initially judge and identify the interference elements present in the original oracle bone topography image. Meanwhile, a joint filtering noise reduction model is established to effectively remove the location-like noise and artificial texture in the image. Then, a fast oracle bone image segmentation model based on neural network is established, and each single character region in the image is successfully segmented out by building and training the model through deep learning. In this paper, 76 common oracle scripts and their variant scripts are trained and recognized in combination with the oracle recognition enhancement model, and a one-to-many link between Chinese characters and oracle images is established. The accuracy and efficiency of oracle bone recognition are further improved by segmenting and classifying the test set images for recognition.

articleTitle: A Study on Colour Recognition and Target Detection Based on Linear SVM and YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The problem of classifying plastic bottles for colour recognition was solved using machine learning and multi-objective detection, which would be used to aid in the recycling of plastic bottles. For a single plastic bottle image, this paper used Sobel edge detection to obtain the edge information, located it to the original image and calculate the average RGB value at the corresponding position to eliminate the effects of bottle deformation, overlaped and some noise caused by colour classification. The RGB values were used as classification labels and the bottle colours were the output of the classification model. Through model comparison, a linear SVM-based colour classification model for a single plastic bottle was finally obtained, achieving a processing speed of 0.02 sec/sheet and 99% accuracy. The multi-target detection problem for the presence of multiple plastic bottles in a single photo is solved using YOLOX, achieving an accuracy of 97.18%. Combining the colour recognition and target detection models, a complete plastic bottle colour recognition model is finally constructed.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Prediction Analysis of Passenger Flow in Underground Transportation Project Based on Improved DFM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study introduces a novel Dynamic Factor Model (DFM) that incorporates temporal correlation across individual stations to enhance short-term passenger flow predictions in subway systems. By decomposing high-dimensional time series data into common and idiosyncratic factors, the model captures both shared patterns and unique characteristics across different operational days and stations. Utilizing Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) for parameter estimation and the Kalman Filter for recursive computation, the model ensures the consistency of common factors. Additionally, a spatial feature-based prediction approach groups stations into clusters with similar characteristics using K-means clustering, allowing for more tailored predictions. An innovative residual correction method, employing the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) and Extreme Learning Machine (ELM), addresses nonlinear information in residuals, particularly during large-scale station closure events. This method significantly improves prediction accuracy and efficiency, showcasing its potential for application in urban transportation management.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Sign Recognition Based on Lightweight Multi-Scale Spatial Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of driverless technology, traffic sign recognition, as a key link in the intelligent transportation system, has attracted much attention. However, traditional traffic sign recognition methods have problems such as long training time, high model complexity and low accuracy, which are difficult to meet the needs of practical applications. To this end, this paper designs a lightweight traffic sign recognition model for this problem, which is characterized by the introduction of a new attention mechanism to achieve effective capture of key image features. The model shows satisfactory performance after being tested on the Chinese Traffic Sign Database (TSRD) dataset, achieving an optimal recognition accuracy of 99.83% with only 0.05 MB of parametric quantities (Params). The effectiveness of our proposed method is demonstrated through comparative experiments. In addition, this paper is not only in proposing an effective lightweight model, but also in providing new ideas and guidance for the research and practice in the field of traffic sign recognition, which has important theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Voiceprint Unlocking Based on MFCC—Exploration of Voiceprint Models Different from Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Based on the mel frequency inversion coefficient (MFCC), this paper explores the application of voice texture recognition technology in smartphone unlocking. Compared with traditional fingerprint unlocking, voice texture unlocking can provide a more convenient and personalized way to unlock. This paper first introduces the basic principles and methods of feature extraction of the MER frequency inverted spectrum coefficient, and then discusses the important role of speech transformation and speech migration technology in constructing a speech texture model. Through the experimental verification of the speech mode unlocking model, this paper proves the effectiveness of speech conversion and speech migration technology, and the sound pattern recognition technology is highly robust to sound interference in different environments. Especially in the smartphone unlocking system, voice texture recognition is a more practical biometric recognition technology than the traditional fingerprint recognition technology. Voice texture recognition demonstrates its unique strengths and challenges. This paper first expounds the basic theory of speech texture recognition, including the capture and analysis mechanism of individual sound features. Then, this paper also analyzes the key technical path of establishing an efficient model for speech mode unlocking, especially emphasizing the application and importance of speech recognition, speech conversion, and speech migration technology. By comparing voice texture unlocking with fingerprint unlocking in many ways, the article highlights the significant advantages of voice texture unlocking in terms of security, convenience, and environmental adaptability. Furthermore, this paper presents practical solutions and coping strategies to address the challenges that speech texture recognition may encounter in practical applications, such as the impact of ambient noise and the security threat of voice texture imitations.

articleTitle: Citizen Hotline Text Categorization Based on Short Text Extension and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The citizen hotline is characterized by short text and sparse features. This paper proposes a short text expansion method and a text classification model based on dual channel feature fusion by BiGRU and BGTC, which realizes the automatic recognition and classification of citizen hotline texts. Firstly, TF-IWF model and LDA topic model are used to build the core thesaurus; Then, Word2Vec is used to calculate the word similarity and complete the expansion of short text content and word vector features; Finally, the extended text classification is realized through the BGTC model that integrates the feature information of TextCNN and BERT BiGRU Attention channels. Through several groups of comparative experiments, the results show that the method has better performance in the text classification task of citizen hotline, with the accuracy and F1 value reaching 85.6% and 85.8% respectively.

articleTitle: Wildlife Status Study Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm and ARMIA Temporal Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents a data-driven policy project model to restrict illegal wildlife trade first, developed a combined model of the entropy weight method and the TOPSIS method, a partner is thus selected; Next, multiple linear regression analysis was established to predict project outcomes under different resource locations. The resource requirements under different project objectives are estimated; Later, this paper uses the network flow model to build a resource flow network, to find out the contribution of different resources to achieving the project objectives and the additional requirements and costs of the resources; Final, this paper developed an ARMIA time prediction model, for the amount of illegal wildlife trade in 2019–2030. And it visualizes the trade volume trend after the project implementation, to assess the impact effect of the project. Moreover, this paper obtains the correlation between each strategy and the outcome through sensitivity analysis, which is probabilistically adjusted through a comprehensive analysis such as sensitivity to maximize the likelihood of achieving the expected goal.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Converter Transformer Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Serving as a crucial component for energy transformation within the ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) power transmission framework, the converter transformer, despite its infrequent malfunctions, can incur substantial financial implications when issues arise. Continuous oversight of its operational status not only aids in the transformer's upkeep and management but also plays a pivotal role in promptly addressing any faults that may occur. Therefore, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for converter transformers based on dissolved gas in oil (DGA) using digital twin technology. The method constructs a digital twin model of the converter transformer based on the multi-physical field coupling mechanism and the principle of XGBoost algorithm, and optimizes the parameters of the XGBoost model using the sparrow search algorithm to construct a fault diagnosis model based on digital twin for converter transformers, thereby greatly improving the efficiency of transformer maintenance and fault handling.

articleTitle: Spark Collaborative Filtering Based Food Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data and artificial intelligence, the catering industry has experienced great changes, and a wealth of food information has appeared on the market, but the ability of users to collect, filter, organise and summarise information is limited, especially when dealing with a large amount of data, and it becomes extremely difficult for users to obtain usable information from it. The emergence of food recommendation systems not only solves this problem, but also improves the coverage of the information retrieved by the user and formulates the content of food recommendations. In this paper, the least squares method (ALS) is used as a collaborative filtering algorithm to train the hidden semantic model, combined with the matrix decomposition recommendation algorithm, in order to solve the data sparsity problem existing in the recommendation system, and to find the best model through parameter optimisation. In real-time recommendation, this paper introduces reward factor and penalty factor as weights to optimise the recommendation of recently rated dishes for users, which effectively improves the personalisation effect. Combined with Redis, Flume, Kafka and other big data technologies, this paper builds a powerful system that can handle large-scale data, and realises data visualisation through Echarts, providing a fully functional, efficient and stable food recommendation service.

articleTitle: Enhancing UAV Pitch Angle Measurement Through Radar Cross-Section Data and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study introduces a novel methodology for measuring the pitch angle of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) by leveraging radar cross-section (RCS) data combined with machine learning algorithms. Traditional pitch angle measurement techniques face challenges in accuracy and reliability. Our approach utilizes RCS data as a unique identifier of UAVs' interaction with electromagnetic waves, enhancing the measurement precision of pitch angles. By applying Fourier series for signal analysis and employing machine learning models for pattern recognition, this paper significantly improves the predictability and accuracy of pitch angle measurements under dynamic flight conditions. The methodology's effectiveness is validated through extensive simulations and numerical experiments, demonstrating its superiority over conventional methods.

articleTitle: A Study of New Energy Vehicles in China Using Random Forest and ARIMA Time Series Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Amidst a global pivot towards ecological sustainability and innovation, the ascendancy of new energy electric vehicles (EVs) in China marks a significant shift in transportation paradigms and energy dynamics. In this paper, the multifaceted drivers behind China's EV growth was unearthed employing descriptive statistics coupled with multiple regression models. The burgeoning EV industry against the conventional automotive sector was juxtaposed through comparative analysis utilizing difference equation models, the result shows that a gradual market encroachment by EVs predicted to capture a significant market share by 2030. The random forest regression models project a marked decrease in greenhouse gas emissions. The findings illuminate a potential annual reduction of carbon emissions by approximately 283,248 metric tons for a city with a population of one million.

articleTitle: A Study on Prediction of Match Key Factors and Player Performance Based on LSTM and XGBoost Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, potential insights are mined from given data to reveal key factors affecting players' competitive status and to predict dynamic changes in the match situation, thus providing deeper insights into the competitive nature of tennis. In order to capture the dynamic changes of the match situation and assess the performance of players, a tennis player performance prediction model was developed. After preprocessing the given data, principal component analysis (PCA) is utilized to perform dimensionality reduction in order to deal with high-dimensional features more effectively. The player's performance is then quantified and an LSTM prediction model is built. Higher weights are assigned to the features that have the greatest impact on the model. Finally, the fitted results are visualized and the whole game is analyzed. Four metrics related to scores were extracted and weighted using the coefficient of variation method to obtain quantified momentum. Data augmentation was then performed to add momentum attributes and retrain the model. The results confirmed the correlation between momentum and player performance. The correlation between player performance attributes and momentum attributes was analyzed using the Spearman correlation coefficient, which confirmed a strong positive correlation between the two. In order to capture the trend of the game, XGBoost model was constructed for time series prediction of momentum attributes. Based on this, the player's performance at a specific point in time is estimated. Comparative analysis with other attributes shows that there is a lag in the effect of player scores on momentum, which suggests that players with good momentum perform better in the next round. Finally, six metrics were selected and the weights of the metrics were determined using a multiple linear regression model, and conclusions were provided to the coaches based on physical and psychological aspects. Recall and precision were also calculated for other matches to measure the performance of the model and the errors were found to be within the expected range to further test proved the generalization performance of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Bearings-Only Passive Location of UAV Formation Based on Three-Circle Positioning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: UAVs flying in formation uses passive positioning to adjust each other's position to avoid external interference. This paper establishes a UAV positioning model based on the three-circle positioning method, and designs an adjustment scheme for the UAV formation flight process on this basis. This paper firstly analyses the geometric characteristics of the signals emitted by the three UAVs in the circular array, and introduces the law of sines on the basis of which the problem of UAV positioning is transformed into the problem of solving the trigonometric equations and obtaining the general solution of the UAV position. In addition, this paper introduces the three-circle positioning method to improve the model and simplify the calculation. In order to achieve effective positioning of UAVs, this paper discusses the number of UAVs in categories. When an UAV is added, it is discussed based on the different characteristics of the included angle formed by FY00 UAV, UAV to be tested and another UAV with accurate position. In this way, the specific number of the unmanned aerial vehicle that transmits the signal can be determined according to the specific angle received by the unmanned aerial vehicle to be tested. If the UAV is indeed in this position, it can be judged that only one more aircraft is needed by comparing the predicted value of the signal range received by the UAV to be tested with the signal actually received by the UAV to be tested. Based on the above results, a total of 3 UAVs are selected to transmit signals, and this paper takes the deviation sum of the actual position of each UAV on the circumference and the ideal position as the loss function, and iteratively calculates the positions of the other UAVs on the circumference by using the sequence traversal method, and solves the adjusted minimum deviation sum of 3.60, and the subsequent value of the loss function has a tendency to rise in a small range, but tends to be stable in general.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Sampling and Path Planning Algorithm of Static Map Based on Dubins Curve
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study is devoted to the research of optimal sampling and path planning algorithms of static maps based on Dubins curve. Dubins curve, a geometric curve with minimum path length, has been widely used in path planning for mobile robots and autonomous vehicles. This study first proposes a sampling point optimization strategy based on the curvature-sensitive algorithm. By analyzing the curvature distribution of the static map, the optimal location and number of sampling points are determined to achieve efficient coverage of the map. Then, combined with the heuristic search algorithm, we design an effective path planning method, which can use the characteristics of the Dubins curve to find the optimal path from the starting point to the target point under the premise of satisfying the constraints. By combining curvature sensitive algorithm and a heuristic search algorithm, this study not only improves the representativeness and coverage of sampling points but also optimizes the efficiency and accuracy of path planning. The experimental results show that the algorithm has achieved remarkable results in the sampling and path planning of static maps and provides strong support for the application of mobile robots and autonomous driving.

articleTitle: Study of Power Optimization Strategy of Large Scale Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous advancement of chip manufacturing technology, modern chips have been shrinking in size while improving in performance, leading to an increase in power density. However, high power consumption can negatively impact chip performance and stability, making it one of the most critical challenges in chip manufacturing. This paper presented a model for digital IC power consumption. First, it investigated the causes of static power and provided a detailed derivation process for sub threshold leakage current. Secondly, the dynamic power was investigated through the analysis and modeling of factors contributing to short-circuit power consumption and switching power consumption. Based on the proposed models for both static and dynamic power, a novel optimization method was introduced that combined low-power technologies such as the Clock Gating and multi-channel collaboration technology across all five stages of chip design-from system level to physical level-aiming to reduce overall chip power consumption. Finally, through chip power simulations comparing pre-optimization results with post-optimization results, this paper validated the correctness and feasibility of the proposed chip power optimization strategy while offering strong support for subsequent chip design and application.

articleTitle: Enhanced SVD Denoising Method Based on Hankel Matrix Decomposition for Seismic Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study introduces an improved SVD denoising method based on the decomposition of the Hankel matrix. This method denoises by analyzing the singular value spectrum of the Hankel matrix, where larger singular values typically represent components with higher coherence in the data, and smaller singular values correspond to less coherent parts. By selecting different rank reduction parameters based on the characteristics of the processed data, this method achieves noise reduction and enhances SNR. Subsequently, a two-dimensional seismic data model is constructed to validate this algorithm. The key to this algorithm is determining the truncation position of the singular value matrix (rank reduction parameter), and the optimal rank reduction parameter is efficiently found using the energy ratio. Practical case studies have shown a significant improvement in the SNR of incoherent data, effectively suppressing random noise and improving the denoising effect for non-horizontal coherent axes. Overall, the Hankel matrix construction method effectively suppresses random noise while maintaining high fidelity of the signal data.

articleTitle: A Simple and Effective Method on Extracting Class Activation Map
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Extracting class activation maps (CAMs) is commonly recognized as a crucial step in generating pseudo-masks for weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS). However, we have noticed that the commonly used binary cross-entropy loss (BCE) in CAM contributes significantly to the unsatisfactory quality of these pseudo-masks. Specifically, BCE's tendency to overclassify and merge often leads to CAM pixels responding to multiple classes within the same receptive field. As a result, when focusing on a specific class, its “hot” CAM pixels may erroneously invade regions belonging to other classes, while “non-hot” CAM pixels might actually represent part of the target class. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel and effective approach: we refine the converged CAM using BCE after employing softmax cross-entropy loss (SCE). This approach, termed BSCAM, involves extracting feature pixels for each class using CAM for a given image and subsequently training an additional fully connected layer with SCE (positioned after the backbone network) using these pixels and class labels. Once this extra layer has converged, we extract BSCAM similarly to traditional CAM. Due to the discriminative nature of SCE, pixel responses are distributed across different categories, thereby reducing potential ambiguities in the resulting masks. Evaluations conducted on the PASCAL VOC and MS COCO datasets demonstrate that BSCAM not only produces high-quality masks but also offers a versatile solution that can be easily integrated into any CAM variant with minimal additional computational overhead.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Motion Artifact Removal Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG), as an important EEG signal acquisition technique, is widely used in brain-computer interface (BCI) and other fields of research. EEG acquired in the motion state introduces a large number of motion artifacts, which leads to the degradation of EEG quality, and thus the removal of motion artifacts from EEG has become an important task in EEG research. This paper introduces the characteristics of motion artifacts interfering with normal EEG signal acquisition and the principles of motion artifact removal methods for EEG signals, focuses on seven EEG motion artifact removal methods, analyses the current status of application, and compares and summarizes the advantages and limitations of various methods. The paper also gives a response strategy to the current demand and problems faced by EEG motion artifact removal, and analyses and prospects for future research directions.

articleTitle: Random Forest-Based Analysis of Variability in Feature Impacts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Random Forest (RF) is a powerful machine learning algorithm for classification (RF-C) and regression (RF-R) problems and excels in feature importance analysis. It accurately evaluates the contribution of each feature in classification or regression, i.e., feature importance, by integrating multiple decision trees or regression trees. Previous studies have often utilized this property to help researchers understand which features are most critical to the prediction task. However, in this paper, this property is applied to the analysis of the variability of the impact of features on the aggregate, i.e., to observe whether there is a significant difference in the importance of the same feature in different aggregates; if there is a significant difference, the feature can be considered to have different impacts on different aggregates, and vice versa, the impacts can be considered to be the same. By combining the theories of feature importance and hypothesis testing in large-sample settings, this paper proposes an innovative method to realize the impact difference analysis, which is different from the traditional ANOVA. Finally, in order to verify the feasibility of the method, this study applies the above method on a real dataset and evaluates the feasibility of the final results in conjunction with one-way ANOVA. The experiment proved the feasibility of the method and demonstrated its effectiveness in analyzing the differences in the impact of characteristics on different aggregates.

articleTitle: FDAM: A Fused Dual Attention Model for Causal Emotion Entailment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Conversational Causal Emotion Entailment aims to extract potential emotion-cause pairs from unannotated emotional documents within a conversational context. Previous works ignore the impact of the distance between clauses on the matching of emotion-cause pairs. Additionally, the way they extract reasons without specifying emotions and considering speaker information is pathological. To this end, this paper proposes a Fused Dual Attention Model (FDAM) to effectively model the emotional influence of speakers in conversational history. FDAM incorporates emotion and speaker information through two distinct modules: the Emotion Attention Network (EAN) and the Speaker Attention Network (SAN). Subsequently, the interaction and fusion module integrates and exchanges the speaker's emotional information with a mutual BiAffine transformation, adaptively assigning weights to the influence of dual attention with a gating unit. Furthermore, Kernel-based relative position embedding is employed to simulate the influence of relative positions. Experimental results show that our model surpasses most baseline models in performance.

articleTitle: Short-Term and Long-Term Causal Effect Estimation with Double-Head Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Research on long-term effects plays a central role in understanding the complex impacts of any condition, particularly when these effects diverge significantly from short-term outcomes. In fields such as healthcare and economics, accurately estimating these long-term causal effects is fundamental for comprehensive assessment and effective decision-making. Although modern models utilizing advanced algorithms and short-term proxy indicators have achieved estimation success, estimating long-term causal structures still faces challenges related to data dependency and causal complexity. This paper introduces a novel dual-headed transformer model designed to address the common problem of gradient vanishing encountered with dual-headed RNNs, by adopting a transformer structure to enhance model stability and efficiency. This model specifically includes encoder and decoder modules, a design choice that aids in more accurately learning the distributional distance between treatment groups and outcomes at each timestep. Through this approach, the model aims to provide more precise estimations of both short-term and long-term causal effects, potentially transforming our understanding and interpretation of data.

articleTitle: Multi-Feature Fusion Based Sound Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Urban sound classification has a wide range of applications in noise analysis and monitoring systems. In order to solve the problem of low recognition rate of sound classification model under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, on the basis of traditional sound classification fusion model, this paper proposed a new parallel hybrid model based on MGCC and CNN-BiLSTM fusion by making full use of the anti-noise performance of each feature extraction method. Firstly, Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients and Gammatone frequency cepstral coefficients were extracted from the preprocessed sound signals, and the two sound features were input into the Bi-directional Long Short- Term Memory Network combined with Convolutional neural network (CNN-BiLSTM) model as input to further extract deeper features. And the fusion features were obtained after the fusion of the two features. Finally, the fused features were input into a deep neural network for sound classification and recognition. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the proposed method on the Urbansound 8K dataset and the NoiseX-92 noise database can reach 98.4% and the accuracy on the noise dataset can also reach more than 89.6%. Experimental results show that the proposed method still has high recognition accuracy in low signal-to-noise ratio, and its performance is better than the traditional sound fusion recognition model.

articleTitle: Voltage Level Recognition Method for Substation Live Area Power Equipment Based on Multi-Source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of power equipment and the accelerated urbanization process, the control of safe distances between live areas and operators and operating equipment has become a significant challenge in the power industry. Establishing standard safety distance thresholds is a crucial prerequisite for safe distance control. The State Grid Corporation explicitly stipulates different safety distance thresholds corresponding to different voltage levels of power equipment. Currently, the determination of power equipment voltage levels and safety distance thresholds still relies on manual judgment. The objective of this research is to automatically identify the voltage levels and safety distance thresholds of live areas' power equipment. This study proposes a voltage level recognition method for substation live areas based on multi-source data fusion. It utilizes the fusion technology of laser radar and cameras to identify and calculate the length of porcelain insulators. The State Grid Corporation explicitly specifies that different lengths of porcelain insulators correspond to different equipment voltage levels. The automatic identification of power equipment voltage levels can be achieved by calculating the length of porcelain insulators. Initially, the laser radar and camera are fixed in a relative position on a platform, and multiple adjacent preset positions are set for the platform. The overall rotation angle can reach 180 degrees, ensuring the scanning of porcelain insulators in live areas. The platform sequentially rotates to the set preset positions while synchronously collecting the laser radar point cloud and camera image data corresponding to each preset position. An improved instance segmentation algorithm is employed to identify porcelain insulators in the camera images. The three-dimensional point cloud cluster of porcelain insulators is obtained by projecting the point cloud onto the pixel area of porcelain insulators in the image. The RANSAC algorithm is then used to fit a straight-line model to the porcelain insulators. The upper and lower endpoints of the porcelain insulators are obtained through the fitted line model, and the length of the endpoints is calculated as the length of the porcelain insulator. Rule filtering and comparison with standard thresholds are applied to the calculated lengths of multiple porcelain insulators, resulting in the final length of the porcelain insulator. The corresponding voltage level of the power equipment is determined based on this length. Experimental results demonstrate that the voltage level recognition method for live areas' power equipment, based on multi-source data fusion, can automatically identify voltage levels. This method reduces the pressure of manual judgment in advance, enhances the automation level of safe distance control in live areas, and contributes to the sustainable development of the power industry.

articleTitle: Visual Quantitative Evaluation of Defects in Metal Components Based on Uniform Field Excitation Magnetic Gradient Pulse Eddy Current Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Metal components made of non-ferromagnetic metal materials such as aluminum, copper and titanium alloy are widely used in aviation equipment because of their lightweight, high strength and corrosion resistance. However, the unfriendly working environment leads to corrosion, metal aging and other damage co-existing in the metal components, which seriously affects the safety and cost of equipment operation. The uniform field excitation gradient pulse eddy current detection method has been proved to have advantages in defect detection sensitivity, boundary recognition and imaging accuracy. In order to meet the performance evaluation of metal materials after aviation equipment service, this paper carefully analyzed the response mechanism of detection signals and their characteristics to defects of aging metal components, and clarified the correlation and independence between differential magnetic field signals and magnetic field gradient signals and their corresponding signal characteristics and defect parameters of aging metal components. Through the comparative analysis of the characteristics of each detection signal, the optimality of the magnetic gradient signal and its peak value in the high precision detection of the defects of the aging metal components was finally clarified, and the high precision detection image of the defects was obtained.

Author Keywords: Uniform field excitation magnetic gradient pulse eddy current

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Image Recognition in Strong Noise Based on Optimized CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To address the problem of low accuracy and poor stability of bearing diagnostic models under strong background noise, a bearing fault image recognition method is proposed that reduces the randomness of the model by avoiding the need for artificial parameterization, which can introduce random factors. This method is based on hyperparameter optimization of the GoogLeNet convolutional neural network model and decision fusion. First of all, two-dimensional wavelet time-frequency variation of the original signal of the bearing vibration to construct an image dataset, one-dimensional classification is into a two-dimensional image problem; Secondly, three lightweight convolutional neural network architectures are selected for the noise immunity test, to get the best noise-resistant network architecture GoogLeNet; Finally, hyper-parameter optimization is performed for the network, comparing the mesh method, the progressive mesh method, and the group optimization algorithm, respectively, and getting The optimal parameters are then analyzed for decision fusion and visualization of the network. To verify the method proposed in this paper, we used the open Case Western Reserve University bearing dataset. The experimental verification demonstrates that the proposed method achieves a correctness rate of 94.33% in decision fusion under noise, with good accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Map Activation Quantization for Image Classification with Limited Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Deep learning applications in image classification often rely on extensive training data. However, in specific scenarios, obtaining a substantial amount of training data poses significant challenges. Training models with limited data often leads to overfitting and poor generalization performance. To address this issue, we propose a novel method based on map activation quantization for image classification. Our method quantizes spatial activations of latent representations, modeling the relationship between discrete representations and categories. This effectively captures variations in object properties, providing more reliable classification information and mitigating overfitting in scenarios with limited data. Furthermore, our approach seamlessly integrates with any convolutional neural network model without necessitating alterations to existing architectures or methodologies. Empirical evaluations on natural and medical image datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method in image classification under limited data scenarios, establishing a new technological benchmark. We intend to publicly release the relevant source code.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation of Lateral Lane Keeping Ability in Road Test Based on Natural Driving Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of imperfect index system for judging driver road test examination, high subjectivity and insufficient objective scientificity for judging driver road test examination hinders the prevention and control of road traffic accidents centering on safe driving. In this paper, based on natural driving data, 2926 cases of low-speed lane keeping segments with speeds lower than 30km/h are screened to extract the four indicators of lateral maneuvering evaluation, and then the thresholds of each indicator are determined by comprehensive consideration of the above indicators in combination with the Youden index, Boxplot method, and statistical measure values. In order to overcome the limitations of indicator weight distribution caused by a single assignment method, this paper proposes the subjective and objective weight combination calculation method based on the coefficient of variation to realize the scientific and reasonable allocation of evaluation index weights. According to the determined indicator thresholds and indicator weights, using the normalization method, the full score and passing score of each indicator are obtained, and created the road test lane keeping ability evaluation technique and grading standards. Finally, the effectiveness of the road test lane keeping ability grading evaluation method proposed in this paper was verified. The research results show that the road test lane keeping ability evaluation method based on natural driving data proposed in this paper can truly and objectively reflect the reality of the driver's road test, and help prevent and control road traffic accidents with safe driving as the core.

articleTitle: Boundary-Points-Based Reduction Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Support Vector Machine (SVM) is an algorithm based on statistical theory and the principle of structural risk minimization, known for its excellent generalization performance. However, with the increase in the number of training samples, the learning efficiency of SVM decreases significantly, requiring a large amount of storage space and computation during the training process, resulting in slow training speed of SVM. Meanwhile, due to the sensitivity of SVM algorithm to noisy data, the existence of noise in the training data may lead to bias in the classification results. To overcome these problems, a Boundary-Points-based Reduction Support Vector Machine (BPR_SVM) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the centered kernel alignment (CKA) method is introduced to calculate the similarity between each sample and samples of different classes, and a corresponding sample contribution formula is designed to determine whether it may be a boundary point. Then, inspired by the K-nearest neighbors method, refinement selection is carried out by computing the number of samples of the same class in each sample's neighborhood set to reduce the size of samples, removing samples in boundary set that are heavily mixed or crossed with samples of different classes and eliminating the influence of noise points and outlier points in the boundary training samples on the decision hyperplane. Finally, efficient reduction of the training samples is achieved. Experimental results on classical datasets show that, compared with similar algorithms, the BPR _ SVM algorithm speeds up the training process without the decrease of classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Path Planning and Motion Control of Robotic Arm Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses a path planning and motion control solution of Robot arm based on Robot Operating System (ROS). Based on the in-depth analysis and integration of advantages and disadvantages of RRT algorithm and its various optimization variants, this study relies on the core principle of RRT algorithm and integrates a variety of advanced methods such as dynamic step optimization mechanism, goal-oriented node expansion strategy, primary path optimization technology. Then a new path planning algorithm based on the combination of RRT and curve fitting technology-LT-RRT algorithm is developed. The algorithm is tested on the MATLAB platform for solving path nodes in two-dimensional and three-dimensional complex obstacle environments, and the effectiveness of the LT-RRT algorithm in improving performance is verified through comparative testing. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has significantly improved the obstacle avoidance performance of path planning in various obstacle Spaces, and the path smoothness has also been effectively improved. This research result provides important technical support and theoretical reference for the application of intelligent motion planning of robot arm in the field of industrial automation in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Monitoring System of Nuclear Power Plant Emergency Feed Pump Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent monitoring system based on computer big data and deep learning is designed and constructed to meet the critical equipment diagnosis requirements of emergency feed pumps in nuclear power plants. The system integrates multi-sensor data and uses ResNet architecture to construct fault diagnosis model, which effectively solves the problem of information omission caused by mechanical signal attenuation and significantly improves diagnostic accuracy and stability. In this research, STFT is used to transform vibration signals into time-frequency domain features to enhance feature extraction ability. In order to meet the challenge of CNN network training performance degradation, the improved ResNet structure is innovatively applied to dig deep into complex signal features. Experiments show that the ResN et model based on multi-sensor fusion strategy has excellent performance in rotor and motor fault diagnosis. It is not only accurate in classification, but also superior to the traditional multi-sensor CNN model and single-sensor ResNet model in terms of training convergence speed, diagnostic accuracy and anti-noise ability. This study provides key technical support for the construction of efficient and reliable intelligent monitoring system of emergency feed pump for nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: CFN-GU: A Cross-Modal Fusion Network with Gated Units for Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) has emerged as a pivotal topic in the realm of human-computer interaction, drawing escalating attention. Despite previous research achieving certain accomplishments, most approaches treat each modality equally, failing to differentiate the emotional information across different modalities and thus struggling to harness the complementary and associative information within multimodal data. To address this issue, this paper propose a Cross-Modal Fusion Network with Gated Units (CFN-GU). CFN-GU comprises two main components: the Single-Modal Transformer and the Learnable Fusion Strategy With Gate (LG-Fusion). The Single-Modal Transformer is employed to model contextual information for each unimodal feature, extracting rich contextual emotional cues. Subsequently, LG-Fusion autonomously learns the weights of each feature information for every modality, thus comprehensively understanding the contributions of different modalities to emotional information. Finally, the information from the three modalities is fused based on these learned weights. CFN-GU achieves an F1 score of 64.3% on IEMOCAP, effectively improving ERC performance and outperforming all benchmark baselines.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Algorithm Based on Low Rank Representation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, an image fusion algorithm based on low-rank representation is proposed to achieve lossy fusion of multiple input images to produce high quality composite images. First, we represent each input image as a low-rank representation and extract the main features of the image through techniques such as singular value decomposition. We then design a fusion strategy that preserves key information for each input image and eliminates conflicts between images by efficiently combining multiple low-rank representations. Finally, we optimize the fusion results by minimizing the reconstruction error to ensure the quality and consistency of the synthesized images.
