The experimental results show that our algorithm can effectively fuse multiple input images while preserving image details, and produce synthetic images with good visual effect and subjective quality, which provides an effective solution for the research and practice of image fusion.

articleTitle: Research on Student Movement Behavior Recognition Based on 3D-CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to deeply explore and make full use of 3D Convolutional neural networks (3D-CNN) to carry out efficient and accurate automatic recognition of diverse and subtle movements of students in the actual learning environment. This paper discusses the theoretical basis and practical significance of this research in detail, and emphasizes the inherent limitations of two-dimensional image processing methods commonly used in student behavior analysis in capturing and analyzing three-dimensional and dynamic behavior. In contrast, 3D convolutional neural network, due to its unique spatial and temporal dimension processing capabilities, can more comprehensively and deeply understand and capture students' continuously changing body movement information in classroom activities, thus breaking through the limitations of traditional methods. In the experimental stage, the research team carefully designed and implemented an action recognition model architecture based on 3D-CNN, input relevant data into the model, and use deep learning technology to conduct detailed training and optimization, so that the model can fully learn and extract the student behavior pattern on the given data set. The experimental results show that the proposed 3D-CNN model exhibits excellent performance in students' action and behavior recognition tasks, which is significantly superior to traditional 2D convolutional neural networks and other machine learning algorithms in terms of recognition accuracy and adaptability to complex and coherent behaviors.

articleTitle: A Retrieval Method Based on Multimodal Pedestrian Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a retrieval method based on Multimodal Pedestrian Features. This method aims to combine pedestrian attribute features, as described in text, with video images to automatically search for and recognize pedestrians with specific attributes within a video stream. The recognition accuracy is enhanced through the use of a partitioning method for problem modeling, which decomposes the video into smaller, more manageable subproblems. Keywords are extracted using encoders and decoders, facilitating the multimodal fusion of data by integrating image algorithms that process pedestrian attributes with natural language processing algorithms that interpret textual descriptions. The proposed method has potential applications in the fields of video surveillance, crowd analysis, and public safety, offering an efficient and intuitive approach to quickly locate and identify specific individuals from extensive video data, thereby improving recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: Fire Temperature Prediction Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization and the increase in population density, the frequency and scale of fires have been expanding, and fire has become one of the most important factors threatening the safety of human life and property. Fire temperature is one of the important parameters for assessing fire danger and developing fire suppression strategies. Accurate prediction of fire temperature is important for fire prevention and emergency response. In this paper, we took fire temperature as the research object and used LSTM model to analyze fire scenarios. We established a fire temperature prediction model to predict the fire temperature by combining other features and environmental factors, which improved the prediction accuracy of fire temperature. The experimental results on real fire scenario datasets have shown that the fire temperature prediction model using LSTM network had higher accuracy than traditional prediction models. It can provide more accurate references for disaster prevention and mitigation work, reducing the losses caused by fires.

articleTitle: Dual-diagnostic Method for Depression Patients Based on BERT Model and ViT Model for Audio and Text Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the face of escalating global mental health challenges, the rapid and accurate diagnosis of depression has become more crucial than ever. Depression, a pervasive mental health disorder, often goes undiagnosed due to its complex symptomatology and the limitations inherent in traditional diagnostic methods. Current approaches, relying heavily on patient self-reporting and clinical observation, fall short in capturing the multifaceted nature of depression, leading to potential delays in treatment and, consequently, exacerbated health outcomes. Addressing these shortcomings, this paper introduces a novel dual-diagnostic approach leveraging the advanced capabilities of AI, specifically through the integration of BERT and Vision Transformer (ViT) models. Our methodology utilizes BERT for the analysis of conversational text data and ViT for the examination of audio spectrograms from patients with depression, offering a comprehensive and nuanced understanding of depressive states. This dual-modality approach not only addresses the limitations of existing single-mode diagnostic practices but also significantly enhances the accuracy and efficiency of depression diagnosis. By harnessing the strengths of both textual and auditory data analysis, our proposed method stands as a testament to the potential of AI in revolutionizing mental health diagnostics, paving the way for timely interventions and personalized care strategies that are critically needed in the medical and clinical domain.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm of Image Recognition Performance Based on Convolution Neural Network Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of computer vision and deep learning technology, the application of fusion convolutional neural network (CNN) and big data technology in the field of image recognition is increasingly extensive and deep. In this paper, a fusion convolutional neural network model named CI-Net is designed to optimize image recognition performance based on CNN. The model uses the technology of integrating multi-size convolution kernel in the same layer structure to extract image features from different scales through multiple independent branches, which not only effectively broadens the width of the network to capture rich and diverse feature information, but also enhances the robustness and generalization ability of the network. In terms of model optimization, the paper abandons the traditional fully connected layer and adopts convolutional layer instead, which significantly reduces the total number of model parameters and effectively reduces the risk of overfitting. Experiments show that the structure design of CI-Net network is scientific and reasonable, and its convergence speed is faster in the training process. Under the premise of keeping the number of parameters far lower than that of similar convolutional neural network models, it can still achieve lower recognition error rate, fully demonstrating its superior performance and efficient generalization ability in image recognition tasks. This research is of great value for improving the performance of image recognition system based on computer big data technology.

articleTitle: Non-Linear Time Sequence Problems Based on GA-BP Neural Network Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the fields of image recognition and computer vision, data mining and predictive analytics, BP neural network as a kind of simple structure and powerful model has been widely concerned by scholars, and the improvement of BP neural network is very important. In this paper, we used genetic algorithm to optimize BP neural network, and optimize the selection of weights and thresholds of BP neural network through the characteristics of local optimization of genetic algorithm. Compared with the single BP neural network, the root mean square error (RMSE) of the optimized BP neural network had been reduced by 0.82%, the mean absolute error (MAE) had been reduced by 0.85%, and the coefficient of determination had been improved by 1.34%• The experimental results have shown that the optimization of BP neural network with genetic algorithm is more advantageous than the single BP neural network, and the optimized BP neural network has a strong ability to deal with the complex problems with high dimensions and multi-objectives.

articleTitle: From Passive Access to Intelligent Regulation-Optimization Design of Active Distribution Network Based on Demand Side Response
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy, the nation strongly develops renewable energy power generation, but the inherent limitations of renewable energy, such as randomness, volatility, and remote geographic position, have a profound influence on the stability and safety of the distribution network system. Faced with the problem of merging large-scale distributed renewable energy into the distribution system, the traditional distribution network relying on predetermined mode for allocation has significant limitations, which cannot accurately regulate power distribution and connection optimally, and it is prone to cause an imbalance between supply and demand. In order to solve this kind of problem, a second- order cone algorithm that can optimize and regulate distributed generation energy, energy storage system, demand side response balance, and a design was implemented for the reactive power compensation device in an active distribution network, and to validate the second-order cone algorithm's effectiveness in optimizing reactive power, the IEEE33 node distribution structure was engineered. Furthermore, considering the demand side end, the nature of load was used to distinguish three types of load, and to solve and confirm the real-time electricity price load response, the chaotic particle swarm algorithm was developed and applied. Finally, the algorithm optimization solved the reactive network loss optimization problem and improved the economic benefits of the active distribution network, respectively. Moreover, it made the power purchase cost of the users decrease, and improved the capacity to consume the renewable power generation energy, which guaranteed the reliability and security of the active distribution network's operations.

articleTitle: Optimal Linear Combination of Heuristic Strategies for 2D Rectangular Bin Packing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The 2D Bin Packing Problem (2DBPP) is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem, where common heuristic algorithms often exhibit characteristics of greedy strategy scoring during the selection of items and the determination of placement positions. However, the approach of using a linear combination of multiple greedy strategies as a scoring strategy is not common, due to the difficulty in determining the optimal combination coefficients. The method proposed in this paper effectively identifies the optimal coefficients for the strategy combination, and demonstrates that, compared to single strategies, the combined strategy offers advantages in noise resistance and robustness. This research uses the improvement process of two classic algorithms, Skyline and MaxRect, as examples. Simulation experiments with five data sets show that our proposed optimal combination strategy method significantly improves the packing utilization and robustness of such algorithms. On five different test data sets, we introduced noise ratios varying from 1% to 50% and conducted 40 repeated experiments for each scenario to ensure the reliability of the results. By averaging these repeated run results according to different data sets and noise ratios, we obtained a comprehensive set of performance data. The results indicate that, under these test conditions, the improved algorithm outperforms the original algorithm in 93% of the cases on average, with a relative average improvement of 13.88%. In addition, this study provides a new perspective on heuristic algorithm research, integrating data distribution with algorithmic approaches.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Hybrid Vision Method for Tunnel Liner Falling Block Recognition Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach to enhancing video surveillance and sound source localization within tunnel environments, specifically focusing on the detection of falling blocks. We introduce a robust background subtraction algorithm, the Adaptive Mean and Gaussian Background Subtraction (AMGBS) algorithm, which utilizes grayscale stability intervals and average grayscale values to optimize traditional methods. Additionally, we explore the application of deep neural networks for background modeling, leveraging their ability to learn from training images automatically. A multi-mode background subtraction method is also proposed, which adapts to various lighting conditions through the use of RGB and YCbCr color spaces. To complement visual data, we propose a Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA)-based algorithm for sound source localization, which is particularly effective in tunnel environments where visual detection may be impaired by lighting or obstructions. Through extensive experimentation, including simulated tunnel blockage scenarios, our methods demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy and reliability over existing techniques.

Author Keywords: Adaptive Mean and Gaussian Background Subtraction (AMGBS)

articleTitle: Research on the Whole Vehicle Intermodal Transport Model Based on Optimized Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of transportation network planning for automobile logistics enterprises, this paper initially constructs an optimization model for multimodal transport routes of complete vehicles with time window constraints. This model quantifies the uncertainty of transportation time by introducing the concepts of maximum fluctuation range and triangular fuzzy. Then, the centroid method is employed to calculate the centroid position to achieve the “defuzzification” of time. Lastly, based on the genetic algorithm (GA), this paper optimizes it and proposes an Optimized Adaptive Genetic Algorithm (OAGA). Through this algorithm, the optimal solution of the optimization model is calculated. By taking the six automobile transportation routes in the East China region of a certain automobile group in China as a case study, it is successfully verified that the OAGA can more effectively calculate the best transportation methods and routes over short, medium, and long periods compared to GA, providing a practical reference for the transportation network planning of automobile logistics enterprises in the East China region.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship Between Color Features and Painting Styles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In digital preservation of cultural heritage, collecting and classifying paintings and artworks is essential. There are notable differences in techniques and color schemes across painting styles. This study delves into image classification methods, focusing on color features. We extensively reviewed literature on color feature extraction methods in paintings, aiming to classify them by style. By categorizing and summarizing these methods, we explored the impact of various factors on classification results, including the choice of color space, the relationship between color and position, and the combination of color and non-color features. Comparative analysis revealed that methods accurately representing the color-position relationship significantly improve classification accuracy, while additional non-color features or more complex color features do not necessarily enhance it. We recommend using feature extraction methods that focus on both position and color characteristics for style classification in digital artwork collections. This emphasizes the importance of exploring color correlations and positional relationships in color image classification, offering new insights into the application of color features in artwork classification.

articleTitle: The Parallel DCNN-LSTM Model for Cloud Computing Prediction Based on an Improved SG Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: It is crucial to accurately predict the workload of large-scale cloud computing resources in order to better allocate and utilize them, but this has always been seen as a challenging task. Recently, LSTM has been widely used in the field of time series prediction, but it is not sufficient to learn complex and noisy patterns. This work aims to solve the accuracy problem of cloud data prediction and proposes a parallel dilated convolutional network. Firstly, in order to smooth and remove noise from the data, an improved SG filter that avoids future data leakage is proposed. Afterwards, this work combines LSTM with dilated convolution and adopts a parallel architecture. The purpose is to enable the model to learn patterns and potential representations of data from multiple scales, and enhance model's generalization and robustness. Finally, this work validated the performance of the proposed model on real datasets, Google Cluster Trace. Experimental results have shown that the proposed model performs better than LSTM and some widely used variants.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent System for Sports Motion Recognition Based on Data Analysis Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study is dedicated to the design and implementation of an intelligent sports motion recognition system based on data analysis algorithms, aiming to enhance the efficiency and safety of sports training and competitions. By collecting and analyzing athletes' motion data, the system is capable of recognizing and classifying various sports movements in real-time, providing coaches and athletes with immediate feedback and suggestions for improvement. The paper begins by reviewing related research in the field of sports motion recognition, particularly the application of machine learning and deep learning methods in motion recognition. Subsequently, we introduce the methodology of the system, including the detailed process of data collection, preprocessing, and algorithm selection. The system design section elaborately describes the architecture of the intelligent system, comprising hardware components and software implementation, as well as user interface design. A series of experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed system, indicating its high accuracy in recognizing a variety of sports movements. Moreover, we discuss the challenges and limitations encountered during the system implementation and propose potential directions for improvement. The results of this research are anticipated to significantly contribute to the scientific level of sports training and the performance of athletes.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Submarine Intelligent Decision Making Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Along with the accelerated evolution of submarine warfare to intelligent warfare, it has put forward brand-new requirements and challenges to command and decision-making activities such as situational analysis, scenario optimization and threat analysis, and the empirical thinking of commanders and staffs alone can no longer meet the requirements of dimensionality, accuracy, intensity and breadth in the rapidly changing warfare, we urgently need a set of intelligent submarine intelligent decision-making solutions for intelligent situational analysis and scenario optimization. Knowledge graph is a technology that transforms domain knowledge into a triad and presents it in the form of a graph through operations such as data mining, information extraction and knowledge fusion, and it has been widely used in the fields of path tracing, intelligent search and intelligent question and answer. Based on this, an intelligent decision prediction system for submarines based on knowledge graphs is proposed by combining the intelligent analysis of knowledge graphs. The system firstly adopts graphical knowledge representation to enhance the understanding and extraction of knowledge, and then uses LightGBM-assisted graphs to constitute an intelligent decision prediction method for nuclear submarines with relational networks, and finally, this paper builds a knowledge graph-based intelligent decision system for submarines by combining classical decision cases in the field of nuclear submarines. Compared with the traditional intelligent decision-making system, the advantages of this research method are that the combination of big data processing methods improves the capacity of knowledge modeling and the efficiency of decision-making, and makes the real-time processing of large-scale information data a reality; the use of knowledge representation of knowledge graph improves the accuracy and relevance of intelligent decision-making models.

articleTitle: Application Case Study Based on Greedy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The effectiveness and flexibility of greedy algorithms are comprehensively explored and proven in the current study, with an analysis of application examples in a series of optimization problems demonstrating their efficiency in solving complex issues. Based on a simple and intuitive strategy, greedy algorithms make the seemingly optimal choice at each step in the hope of leading to a global optimum solution. The core advantage of this method lies in the simplicity of its algorithmic design and its efficient execution capabilities in various situations. The study employs detailed case analyses to validate the applicability and efficiency of greedy algorithms in different scenarios, especially in resource allocation and scheduling issues. Results indicate that greedy algorithms can quickly find near-optimal solutions in a variety of problems and, in some cases, can even guarantee the absolute best solution. Through these case analyses, the research emphasizes the position of greedy algorithms as a powerful tool for solving optimization problems, while also highlighting the limitations and considerations that need to be taken into account in specific problem settings. This work provides a solid foundation and valuable insights for further research and application of greedy algorithms.

articleTitle: A Study on Pathology Speech Recognition Based on 2D-Attention-Branchformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Communication between speech-impaired and non-disabled people has always been more complex, and the development of artificial intelligence offers the possibility of solving this problem. Speech impairment mainly refers to difficulty in sound formation and aphasia due to brain or peripheral neuropathy; in addition, deafness can also lead to difficulty in sound formation, especially for deaf people who are prelingually deaf. While traditional communication relies heavily on pen on paper and verbal communication, modern technology has enriched communication by providing us with more innovative assistive features, such as speech recognition (ASR). Among these assistive functions, speech recognition technology is essential, as it can capture and recognize the characteristics of various speech signals, opening up a wide range of possibilities for future research and applications. However, speech recognition technology has encountered some difficulties and limitations in recognizing pathological articulations. To better meet the rehabilitation needs of patients, we set up a three-level classification of “light,” “medium,” and “heavy.” In this study, we introduced the 2D-Attention module and integrated the Branchformer technology. First, we utilize the SpecAugment data augmentation technique to mask the acoustic spectrograms with random time and frequency to enhance the diversity of the training data. Next, we utilize the 2D-Attention mechanism to capture better the acoustic spectrogram's time and frequency domain information. The output of 2D-Attention is then used as input to Branchformer for further processing through joint coding. This helps to help pathological speech patients correct their mispronunciations and improve their speech fluency. Experimental results on the speech disorder dataset show that the word error rate of our proposed approach is reduced by 17.7%, 1.4%, 1.6%, and 1.4%, respectively, compared to the mainstream RNN, Transformer, Conformer, and Branchformer models. This approach offers new possibilities for facilitating effective communication between people with speech impairments and others.

articleTitle: Dynamic Target Area Search Path Research Based on Rolling Online RRT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study introduces a novel approach to dynamic target tracking through a Rolling Online Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT), aimed at overcoming the challenges presented by uncertain and complex environments. Traditional path planning algorithms often fall short in dynamic scenarios, whereas the RRT algorithm, known for its efficiency in exploring solution spaces within continuous domains, serves as the foundation for the method. By incorporating probabilistic concepts, our approach better manages the uncertainty of future target states, offering a more robust solution for dynamic target tracking. The mechanism of rolling planning and online updates allows the algorithm to dynamically adapt to changes in the target's state, ensuring both the efficiency and accuracy of tracking. Specifically, the algorithm employs a probabilistic sampling strategy, utilizing predictive models of target movement to guide the RRT towards areas where the target is most likely to be found. This significantly enhances the efficiency and reliability of tracking dynamic targets, making it particularly suitable for applications in drone navigation, robotic soccer, and security surveillance.

articleTitle: Trustworthy Data Collection in Sensor Networks Based on Sinks and Enhanced Jellyfish Search
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Mobile edge users (MEUs) collect data from wireless sensing devices and report it to cloud data centers, driving many applications in sensor cloud systems (SCS). However, there is a lack of effective and efficient methods to verify the honesty of the sensing devices and MEUS involved in data reporting. When there are malicious devices in the network and are subject to gray hole attacks, how to efficiently identify the malicious devices is crucial. In order to deal with this difficulty, a new solution is proposed, which selects sink nodes and utilizes unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) for efficient data verification, with the purpose of building a safe SCS data collection platform. In the JS-UAV-TDC solution, the UAV sends data packets and check codes to the sensing device and passes them along the path. Finally, the MEUs collect and upload the data. The UAV combines cloud data center to detect the data, complete the trust assessment of the sensing device, and select the sink nodes through the trust assessment. For the path where the data packet is abnormal, the sink node completes the data collection of the suspicious node, and finally dispatches an UAV to complete the inspection of the sink node's Path planning. The simulation results show that the proposed JS-UAV-TDC scheme can effectively complete the trust assessment of sensing devices, identify malicious nodes, and collect data from suspicious nodes through sink nodes, which greatly reduces the energy consumption of the UAV's fly again.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Prediction and Maintenance of RGL System Combining Electrical and Electronic Technology and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The uninterrupted functioning of modern society heavily relies on the reliability and stability of power equipment. The integration of electrical and electronic technologies with artificial intelligence in the form of the RGL system introduces innovative concepts and methodologies for managing power infrastructure efficiently. This paper aims to study an RGL (power equipment operation management) system that combines electrical and electronic technology and artificial intelligence, focusing on its fault prediction and maintenance. First, this article provides an in-depth analysis of the structure and principles of the RGL system, focusing on its advantages in power equipment monitoring and control. By introducing advanced sensor technology and data collection methods, the RGL system can obtain the operating status data of power equipment in real time, and use artificial intelligence algorithms to perform real-time analysis to achieve early identification of potential faults. Secondly, the paper studies the application of RGL system in fault prediction in detail. By establishing a fault prediction model based on big data and machine learning, the RGL system can comprehensively monitor and analyze power equipment and discover factors that may cause equipment failure in advance. This not only helps improve equipment reliability, but also reduces the impact of sudden failures on the power system. Finally, this article explores the practical application of RGL systems in fault maintenance. By introducing intelligent maintenance strategies, the RGL system can formulate accurate maintenance plans based on the actual operating status of the equipment and predicted fault information, improve maintenance efficiency, and reduce maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Research on Seabed Slope Classification and Survey Path Optimization Based on Genetic Algorithms and Plane Fitting Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Responding to the surge in maritime exploration and the increasing need for precise seabed mapping, this paper introduces a route planning method enhanced by an optimization algorithm to improve accuracy and efficiency. We develop three route planning models: north-south, east-west, and diagonal east-west directions. Utilizing a genetic algorithm for regional optimization and a planar fitting model to determine the shortest path in each region, our analysis reveals that the diagonal east-west direction yields the shortest route. The findings indicate improvements in route length, reduced missed areas, and lower overlap rates. This study offers a potent optimization algorithm for route planning, setting the stage for future advancements in the field.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Line Fault Diagnosis Based on Decision Tree Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of economy and industry, power stability has risen to be the cornerstone of national livelihood. However, frequent transmission line failures seriously threaten the stability of power supply, so it is crucial to explore the causes and laws of the failures in depth. This paper firstly analyses the current and voltage distribution law in AC transmission lines, and reveals its cyclic characteristics over time. Subsequently, the distribution law of current and voltage is discussed in detail for different fault types, and it is found that there are significant differences between the current and voltage in the circuit under different fault types. When constructing the transmission line fault type identification model, given that the number of samples in the fault state is much less than that in the non-fault state, resulting in a highly unbalanced number of samples among fault categories, this paper innovatively adopts a stratified sampling division method to ensure that the data distribution of the training set and the test set is consistent with the overall dataset distribution. At the same time, the random oversampling technique balances the distribution of sample categories in the training set, effectively circumvents the challenge of category imbalance in the classification problem, and thus improves the classification accuracy and stability of the model. Through grid search and cross-validation, the optimal hyperparameter combination of the model is found, and a classification model with excellent performance is constructed. After comparing and analysing multiple classification algorithms, such as decision tree, logistic regression, support vector machine and K-nearest neighbour, it is found that the decision tree algorithm not only possesses interpretability, but also outperforms the other models in terms of evaluation metrics, such as balanced accuracy and recall. Therefore, the decision tree model is finally selected as the final classifier in this paper. In addition, this paper also ranked the importance of features in the model and performed visual mapping of the decision tree decision-making process, which provided a strong support for the in-depth understanding of transmission line fault type identification.

articleTitle: Statistical Research on Bistatic RCS of Floating Platforms Based on Full-Wave Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article conducts a simulation study on the bistatic and dual-polarized radar cross-section (RCS) of an aerostat at 100MHz. It explores the average value and variation trend of the aerostat's RCS under different bistatic angles and polarization modes, providing suitable research suggestions. Utilizing various mixed distribution models and traditional distribution models, the article fits the fluctuation characteristics of the aerostat's bistatic and dual-polarized RCS, and lists the distribution models that best fit the data at different specific bistatic angles. The results indicate that three mixed distribution models exhibit good and stable fitting characteristics for bistatic data with the same polarization, while the Weibull distribution model demonstrates the best overall fitting performance for cross-polarization bistatic data.

articleTitle: PSO-BP Based Prediction Study for Nonlinear Regression Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The accurate forecasting of nonlinear regression problems is essential in numerous real-world applications, and enhancing the precision of predictions in such problems is significantly important. In this study, we focus on a nonlinear regression prediction dataset available on the CSDN website and employ BP neural networks to conduct regression predictions on this data. Considering the data's characteristics, we build a regression prediction model utilizing an improved BP neural network. By integrating the strong nonlinear mapping capabilities of the BP neural network with the optimization of initial weights and thresholds through the PSO algorithm, we develop a PSO-BP neural network model to perform regression predictions on the data. Experimental results indicate that the predictions made using the PSO-BP neural network outperform and are more accurate than those from traditional regression prediction models overall.

articleTitle: Design of a Lora Internet of Things-Based Intelligent Infusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Modern science and technology have improved many facets of people's lives, but the medical field has benefited most from these advancements. The idea of “smart hospitals” was first floated in the US in 2009, and since then, the medical community worldwide has explored it at various degrees. Medical informatization and intelligentization of medical buildings are the two key threads that comprise the development of smart hospitals, as noted by Jiao Yahui, Deputy Director of the Medical Administration Bureau of the National Health Commission of China in 2023. In this work, a digital intravenous infusion nurse monitoring system based on LoRa IoT is developed with an emphasis on medical informatization. The system attempts to protect patients taking medication intravenously by integrating four modules: the Hospital Information System (HIS), LoRa gateway, infusion monitoring system, and infusion monitoring devices. It closes the medical order information gap, resolves problems like incomplete orders and valid closed-loop execution data, gives precise drug pharmacokinetic parameters, prevents patients from becoming sicker longer than necessary, and combines clinical practice and research to provide data support for the advancement of pharmacokinetics research. To provide medical staff with a straightforward interactive experience and intuitive information acquisition, this paper presents an infusion monitoring device featuring a JAVA-developed interface, a LoRaWAN protocol-based low-power wide-area network gateway, and a Core1262-868M chip as its control core.
